About the position
We are seeking a Data Engineer to join our team based in Cape Town, this is a contracting role and onsite.
The Data Engineer will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the data infrastructure necessary for our Insights team to analyze data and derive valuable insights. The Data Engineer will work with Engineering Leads, Data Architects and other stakeholders to ensure that our data is properly sourced, stored, and accessible for analysis. They will also contribute to our mission by extracting maximum predictive value from data assets.
Responsibilities
Data Pipeline Development and Management
Design, develop, test and maintain data pipelines to extract, transform, and load (ETL) data from various sources into a data warehouse or data lake
Implement data quality and validation checks to ensure that data is accurate, complete and consistent.
Optimize and scale data processing and storage to handle large volumes of data and high concurrency.
Troubleshoot and resolve data pipeline issues and perform root cause analysis
Develop and maintain documentation for data pipelines and processes.
ETL Development
Building and maintaining data pipelines using lakehouse architecture (medallion)
Extracting data from multiple sources, transforming it, and loading it into the target database
Monitoring and troubleshooting ETL jobs to ensure they complete successfully and on time.
Data Modelling and Design
Design and implement data models and database schemas for storing and querying data.
Optimize database schema and indexing for efficient data retrieval
Modernise legacy data environments, migrating from on-premises solutions to cloud-native platforms such as Databricks
Ensure database security, availability, and scalability
Perform database tuning and optimization to improve query performance
Develop and maintain data connectors and integrations with various data sources (e.g., databases, APIs, flat files)
Implement data streaming and real-time data processing technologies.
Reporting And Analytics
Designing and implementing complex reports that meet business requirements
Developing dashboards and visualizations using tools like Pyramid or other data visualization tools
Develop and maintain BI reports and dashboards
Analysing data to identify trends, patterns, and insights
Providing insights to business stakeholders based on the analysis of data
Data Governance and Security
Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations according the Data privacy policies.
Develop and maintain data governance policies, procedures, and standards
Ensure that data access and authorization policies are in place and adhered to
Monitor and audit data access to ensure data security and prevent data breaches
Implement disaster recovery and business continuity plans for data infrastructure
Collaboration and Communication
Work collaboratively with Engineering Leads, Architects, Analysts, Scrum Masters and other stakeholders to understand data requirements and provide data solutions.
Communicate data pipeline issues, status, and progress to stakeholders and project teams.
Participate in cross-functional meetings and initiatives to ensure alignment with data strategies and goals
Qualifications
Must have at least 3 years of relevant IT experience or related qualification.
3+ years experience with Data pipeline design and development experience.
Proficiency in Python and/or SQL.
RDBMS experience in technology such as SQL Server, MySQL and PostgreSQL.
Ability to use common scripting languages such as Powershell, Bash, or Python for automation.
Experience using unit and integration tests.
Experience working with production BI environments and tools such as PowerBI, Tableau or Pyramid Analytics.
Strong analytical/problem solving skills.
Skills
Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate certification.
Experience in Azure data technologies; a relevant Azure certification would be advantageous
Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD practices, Docker and containerization
Exposure to .net entity framework.
Exposure to Databricks, Delta Lake and PySpark.
Experience with data streaming or distributed processing technologies such as Kafka or Hadoop.
Experience delivering data projects in Retail, Finance, Customer or HR domains would be advantageous
Experience mentoring junior engineers would be advantageous
Behaviours
Manages Complexity - interprets and simplifies complex and contradictory information when resolving organisational problems
Strategic Mindset - thinks and plans strategically, focusing on the long-term goals and objectives of the organisation
Tech Savvy - leverages new technology to enhance productivity, improve problem solving, and support business growth
Cultivates Innovation - creates an environment that fosters and nurtures a culture of creativity which drives success
Drives Engagement - inspires, motivates and empowers individuals to go above and beyond for the benefit of the team and the organisation

About the position
The reporting is only as good as the pipeline underneath it. This role owns that layer: the ingestion, the transformations, the checks, and the support when a number downstream does not match.
It is a permanent seat in Centurion, in a retail investments technology team, reporting to the Head of Application Development. You will build and run data pipelines and the platform they sit on, so analytics, BI and the business get data they can trust. You will also set technical direction in the team. That means design calls, engineering standards, and how AI is used in the work without breaking governance.
What you will do
Deliver data engineering work inside an Agile team. Plan it, estimate it, break features into tasks, and hit the quality bar you agreed with the product owner.
Design and build ingestion and transformation pipelines across systems and domains. Batch and incremental. Error handling, monitoring, alerting, validation and reconciliation included.
Shape solutions that fit the target data platform. The environment is cloud and AWS-aligned. You will be expected to call the cost, security, performance and support impact of a design before it is built.
Coach less experienced data engineers. Give analytics, BI and data science a clear view of structures, availability and how a pipeline actually behaves.
Review code and configuration. Simplify what is already there. Use Git, automated testing, CI/CD and structured releases. Document enough that someone else can support it.
Use AI in the engineering workflow, on approved tools only. You validate the output. You do not put client or proprietary data into a public model. You stay accountable for what goes to production.
Join incident response and root-cause work when a pipeline fails, and build privacy, access control and regulatory requirements in from the start.
RequirementsWhat you need
A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related field. A relevant certification helps.
4–7+ years in data engineering, with production pipelines and platforms you can talk through.
Strong AWS data architecture experience.
Advanced Python and SQL.
Data modelling, analytics-oriented schema design and warehousing.
Ingestion from relational databases, cloud storage, APIs and files.
Git, CI/CD and automation. Agile or SAFe delivery.
You have used AI in engineering work and you know how to check it.
Power BI or a similar BI tool is useful.
You can explain a constraint to a business stakeholder and a design choice to another engineer.

Python

SAFe

Participate in testing and quality assurance of new and enhanced solutions.
SHARE KNOWLEDGE
Create technical specifications and supporting documentation.
Participate in requirements gathering and solution design.
Share technical knowledge and best practices with the wider team.
Translate complex technical concepts into language that business stakeholders can understand.

C#

Big Data technologies

Analytical – You enjoy digging into data and finding the story behind it.

About the position
ENVIRONMENT:
FILL a dual-focused role as a SQL DBA & Infrastructure Engineer wanted by a growing provider of cutting-edge Custom Cloud Solutions where you will bridge the gap between day-to-day database administration and core infrastructure support. You will act as the crucial Level 2 bridge within the team, handling routine to intermediate SQL Server DBA tasks, while stepping over to assist with general IT infrastructure, backups, and user management when database duties are complete. Roughly 50% of your time will be dedicated to core SQL DBA duties, with the remaining 50% supporting broader infrastructure, systems administration, and cloud environments. The ideal candidate must have solid foundational-to-intermediate experience as a SQL Database Administrator (DBA) with proven experience with SQL Server maintenance plans, backups, restores, and database relocations & performance monitoring and query troubleshooting. You will also need hands-on experience configuring and managing backup solutions (specifically Veeam and/or Commvault) and have working knowledge of Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID.
DUTIES:
SQL Database Administration (~50%) -
Routine Maintenance: Design, implement, and monitor database maintenance plans (index rebuilds, integrity checks, and statistics updates).
Database Operations: Handle database restores, migrations, and database moves efficiently and securely.
Performance Tuning: Troubleshoot and resolve basic-to-moderate performance bottlenecks, slow-running queries, and resource constraints.
Escalation Management: Serve as the internal Level 2 DBA Owner, resolving day-to-day issues locally and only escalating genuinely complex, high-level structural problems to third-line specialized contractors.
Infrastructure & Systems Support (~50%) -
Backup Management: Monitor, test, and manage enterprise backup environments utilizing solutions such as Veeam and Commvault.
Identity & Access Management: Administer user provisioning, group policies, and permissions within Active Directory (AD) and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD).
General IT Operations: Provide responsive support for general infrastructure tickets, system health checks, and server environment troubleshooting.
REQUIREMENTS:
Core Experience: Solid foundational-to-intermediate experience as a SQL Database Administrator (DBA) combined with hands-on systems/infrastructure administration background.
SQL Skills:
Proven experience with SQL Server maintenance plans, backups, restores, and database relocations.
Practical capability in performance monitoring and query troubleshooting (expert-level DBA optimization is not required; practical, operational competence is the priority).
Infrastructure & Tooling Skills:
Hands-on experience configuring and managing backup solutions (specifically Veeam and/or Commvault).
Working knowledge of Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID (user lifecycles, group assignments, permissions).
Soft Skills & Work Ethic: Highly organized, capable of context-switching between database workloads and infrastructure tasks, and comfortable working autonomously in a fully remote setup.

About the position
JOB PURPOSE
Apply technical knowledge and expertise to implement, monitor and enhance the level of compliance related to compliance systems, registration and data reporting requirements in accordance with the Financial Intelligence Centre Act, No. 38 of 2001, as amended (FIC Act) in order to support the overall strategic direction and objectives of the Compliance and Prevention division.
KEY PERFORMANCE AREA
Compliance Systems Design
Engage with relevant business units to understand, gather, scope and document business requirements to enhance compliance oversight within the FIC.
Implement and maintain an effective systems and reporting framework to provide technological driven solutions for risk assessment and compliance monitoring in collaboration with the Senior Systems Compliance Analyst.
Identify enhancements to improve system and data reporting for compliance oversight of the FIC and other supervisory bodies.
Assist in developing diagnostic tools and applications to facilitate the predictive analysis, monitoring, risk assessment and enforcement of the FIC Act compliance.
Develop and maintain clear Data Systems and Reporting manuals and procedures to enhance traceability of compliance solutions.
Work with ICT teams to design, implement and test system controls such as access controls, data encryption, logging and monitoring that support compliance objectives.
Develop and maintain monitoring mechanisms to track the effectiveness of compliance controls and report on key compliance metrics.
Compliance Monitoring
Monitor and report on the state of compliance by Accountable Institutions with registration and reporting obligations in terms of FIC Act requirements.
Conduct on-site and desktop system and reporting reviews of supervised institutions in terms of FIC Act requirements.
Perform goAML entity and user registrations and updates.
Verify the quality, integrity and adherence to regulations of information received by Accountable Institutions.
Assist with the provision of reporting information for compliance reviews, inspections and/or enforcement matters at the request of the FIC or Supervisory Bodies in terms of the FIC Act.
Assist with remediation tracking and processes applied to non-compliant reporting and reporting failures of Accountable Institutions, including Directive 3A remediation.
Participate in compliance risk assessments to identify and evaluate compliance risks associated with non-compliance by Accountable Institutions.
Compliance Analysis and Reporting
Compare internal- and external data, utilising relevant data collection methods, tools and data sources to ensure the integrity of information on the FIC database and to have an up-to-date registration universe.
Identify and investigate discrepancies, patterns and connections between compliance information sources to support compliance monitoring and reporting.
Prepare statistical information on registrations and reporting and prepare dashboards and graphical reports, including trends and typology reports.
Utilise advanced analytical techniques and methodologies to conduct in-depth analyses on compliance information to detect anomalies and trends regarding non-compliance by Accountable Institutions.
Profile cases and compile predictive models from compliance information to understand compliance trends and risk prone entities.
Assess supervised institutions' system capability and compliance reporting requirements within the industry sectors affected by the FIC Act.
Analyse the implications of new or updated regulations on existing compliance systems and processes in collaboration with the Data Systems and Reporting team, and communicate information to relevant stakeholders.
Extract, summarise and present compliance information in a manner that supports compliance monitoring data and systems.
Coordinate reporting on the remediation of reports by external reporters.
Compliance and Prevention Advocacy and Awareness
Provide technical input, direction and guidance to supervisory bodies and regulated institutions regarding the implementation and compliance obligations of data streams and reporting to the FIC and the need to apply appropriate control measures.
Participate in the transfer of skills to team members to enhance overall effectiveness and capacity.
Advise management of compliance reporting challenges as appropriate.
Assist in compiling reports and case studies for training purposes and benchmarking.
Stay abreast of industry trends, best practices and new technologies in data analytics and intelligence reporting.
Stakeholder Management
Conduct briefings and presentations with FIC stakeholders and Accountable Institutions to gain insight and determine requirements for compliance monitoring and reporting support.
Collaborate with national and international supervisory bodies to understand emerging trends and technologies in the monitoring and reporting of mandatory compliance aspects.
Collaborate with the various Compliance and Prevention, Forensic and ICT teams to provide compliance support as required.
Ensure continuous stakeholder interface for seeking clarities, closing gaps, and enriching the data integrity of the compliance systems and reports.
Participate in cross-functional projects when required.
Represent the organisation at working groups, meetings, conferences and seminars when required
Risk and Compliance Management
Assist in the development and enhancement of standards, processes, policies, and roles within the Compliance and Prevention division.
Provide input into tactical plans and targets when required.
Implement fraud controls, risk prevention principles, sound governance and compliance processes, and tools to identify and manage risks with the business unit.
Assist in monitoring changes in the supervisory environment and the implementation of appropriate operational controls to address new requirements.
Support and provide evidence to internal and external audit requirements when required.
Maintain quality risk management standards in line with the organisation's risk management framework.
Maintain and enforce all related Service Level Agreements to minimise business risk and ensure business continuity.
Adhere to all relevant laws, policies and Standard Operating Procedures throughout the organisation.     10%
EDUCATIONAL AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS
Degree in Information Technology, Information Systems or Computer Science    7

Knowledge of Open-Source Intelligence Collection, Scripting Languages
Technical Documentation and Procedure Development
Financial Intelligence Centre Act

ENVIRONMENT:
JOIN the team of an Online Gaming Group seeking to fill the hands-on technical role of an AI Architect/ Engineer. You will serve as one of the site’s most senior individual technical contributors including to its AI-augmented engineering model. The role exists because the transformation the site has committed to, rebuilding how software is specified, written, tested and released around AI assistance, requires deep hands-on engineering ownership that cannot be delivered from a line management position and cannot be bought in as advisory.
DUTIES:
AI Engineering Harnesses:
Accountable for the design, build, operation and lifecycle of the internal harnesses that make AI-assisted Engineering safe and repeatable: agent and assistant scaffolding, repository and domain context layers, prompt and workflow libraries, evaluation harnesses, regression and guardrail suites, and the integration of these into the Developer toolchain and CI/CD pipeline.
Decide on the technical design and implementation of these systems.
AI adoption in delivery:
Accountable for ensuring AI augmentation actually lands in the delivery teams: reference implementations, integration patterns per stack, Developer enablement, and removal of the technical obstacles that stall adoption.
Work through Heads of Engineering and Engineering Managers, who retain accountability for their teams’ delivery outcomes.
Domain and technical depth:
Accountable for holding sufficient depth in business domains — player journey, account and wallet, bonusing and promotions, game integration, payments, responsible gambling controls, regulatory reporting — to judge where AI assistance is safe, where it is not, and what a correct output looks like.
Own the domain context and knowledge artefacts on which AI-assisted work depends.
Technical standards and architecture practice:
Accountable for Engineering standards governing AI-assisted development: code provenance and attribution, review obligations for generated code, licensing and IP hygiene, secure coding under assistance, and the definition of done for AI-assisted change.
Set these standards within the group reference architecture and recommends changes to it where augmentation requires them.
Engineering telemetry and measurement:
Accountable for the technical instrumentation that makes engineering performance observable, delivery, quality and flow telemetry, and the pipelines and analysis layers that turn it into decision-grade evidence for the Managing Director and group stakeholders.
Determine the technical implementation; the measurement framework and its interpretation are agreed with the Managing Director and Heads of Engineering.
Technical evaluation and vendor assessment:
Accountable for the technical evaluation of AI platforms, models, tooling and third-party services proposed for engineering use, including capability benchmarking against workloads, security and data-handling posture, cost model and exit risk.
Recommend to the Managing Director, who holds selection and contracting authority.
Technical leadership without authority:
Accountable for raising the technical ceiling of the engineering organisation: mentoring Senior and Lead Engineers, leading design and architecture review, setting the standard for engineering craft, and building the internal advocacy that carries the augmentation model past initial resistance.
Hold no line authority over any Engineer.
Prototyping and technical risk reduction:
Accountable for de-risking novel technical initiatives ahead of committed delivery through working prototypes and spikes, and for producing a clear, evidenced recommendation to proceed, adapt or stop.
REQUIREMENTS:
Qualifications –
Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering or a related field.
Experience/Skills -
10+ Years in Software Engineering, with a sustained record of hands-on delivery at senior or staff-plus level.
Demonstrated ownership of platform, tooling or Developer-experience systems used across an engineering organisation of comparable scale.
Practical, shipped experience applying AI or Machine Learning to engineering workflows
Evidence of technical leadership without line authority across multiple teams.
Delivery accountability in a regulated, consumer-facing, high-availability environment (advantageous).

CPT

About the position
Role purpose:
The Solutions Engineer sits in the Product team and delivers small projects end to end across the company’s integrations and internal tools, from gathering requirements through to build, testing, and release. Working directly with Product Owners and business stakeholders, this role connects POS, digital ordering, payment, and back-office systems and builds tools that help the company Stores, Operations, and Finance work more efficiently. Larger initiatives are scoped by the Solutions Engineer and handed to the Engineering team.
Key responsibilities:
Requirements & solution design:
Work with stakeholders and Product Owners to gather requirements, map processes, and define acceptance criteria for small projects.
Design simple, maintainable solutions, documenting data flows, business rules, and integration touchpoints.
Assess project size and complexity, flagging work that should move to the Engineering team.
Build: integrations & internal tools:
Build and maintain integrations between Micros Simphony, aggregator platforms, payment providers, loyalty systems, and back-office platforms using REST APIs, webhooks, and file-based interfaces.
Develop internal tools and automation using Python (FastAPI), React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and n8n, querying Snowflake and operational databases where needed.
Implement secure authentication patterns, including OAuth 2.0 and key-pair authentication, and manage credentials appropriately.
Testing, release & support:
Plan and carry out testing for own projects, including API, regression, and end-to-end tests, and support stakeholders through UAT.
Release changes to production following agreed deployment and change-control processes, with monitoring and alerting in place.
Provide support for delivered solutions, resolving incidents and working with vendors on root causes.
Core deliverables:
Signed-off requirements and acceptance criteria for each small project.
Working, documented integrations and tools released to production.
Test evidence, UAT sign-off, and release notes for every release.
Monitoring, runbooks, and handover documentation for supported solutions.
Required skills & competencies:
3+ years’ software or integration engineering experience, with exposure to requirements gathering and testing; a relevant degree, diploma, or strong project portfolio counts.
Proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript, with experience building and consuming REST APIs.
Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred); exposure to Snowflake advantageous.
Ability to translate business needs into clear requirements and acceptance criteria.
Experience with test practices (Postman, automated tests), Git, Docker, and CI/CD.
Ability to leverage AI coding and productivity tools (such as Claude, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor) to speed up requirements, development, testing, and documentation, with strong judgement in reviewing and validating AI-generated work.
Exposure to POS, payment, or food-ordering platforms (Micros Simphony, Transaction Junction, Uber Eats, Mr D) advantageous.

About the position
Take the lead in transforming manufacturing performance. Driving safer operations, optimising production yields and turning engineering innovation into measurable results.
Is this you?
Precision under pressure suits you. You enjoy turning production data and operational lessons into practical improvements, while keeping safety and quality firmly in view. Comfortable leading discussions and challenging deviations, you build trust with operators, technical colleagues, suppliers and cross-functional stakeholders.
What you'll be doing (and why you'll enjoy it)
Driving each production campaign, you will analyse yield, equipment effectiveness and schedule adherence against SAP recipe baselines, then implement improvements. You will issue recipes, verify MES data, build PI Vision and Excel monitoring tools, investigate non-conformances and lead campaign reviews. The role also covers procedures, operator training, trials, change control, incident investigations and capital projects from initial scope through commissioning.
Where you'll be doing it
Within a technical chemical manufacturing environment, safety, consistent production and First Pass Quality are central to daily decisions. You will be based at their plant in Richards Bay and reporting to the Production Manager, you will work across production, quality and project activities, translating plant insight into stronger systems, clearer work instructions and more predictable performance.
What you'll need
A BSc in Chemical Engineering or an equivalent qualification is essential, supported by at least 3 years of experience in a production or technical environment, preferably within the chemical manufacturing industry. Familiarity with ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and OHSAS 18001 is required. A postgraduate qualification would be advantageous, alongside practical capability in process analysis, continuous improvement and capital project delivery.
What you'll get
You'll receive a competitive salary and benefits package that includes a basic salary, 65% medical aid company contribution for employee, spouse and up to 3 kids, pension fund, risk benefit, bargaining council, funeral scheme and skills development levy. The real draw is the breadth of influence across safety, quality, production performance and plant investment. You will gain hands-on exposure to commissioning, cross-functional problem-solving and manufacturing improvement, with Green Belt training and the opportunity to help Yellow Belt colleagues strengthen their improvement capability.

About the position
Role overview:
The DevOps and Platform Engineer implement and maintain the hosting platform: the virtual machines and services that run the company's applications in Private Hosted Environments, and public cloud services where the business needs them. The role keeps that environment patched, secure, monitored, recoverable and well documented, and builds and maintains the automation (pipelines and infrastructure as code) that gets applications onto it reliably and repeatably.
The role reports to the Platform and Engineering Manager, who sets the hosting standards and assists where needed. The engineer implements and maintains the environment to those standards and is the main hands-on owner of the platform day to day.
Key duties
Hosting infrastructure:
Implement, configure, operate, and maintain the hosting virtual machines and services in Private Hosted Environments, to the standards set by the Platform and Engineering Manager.
Implement and maintain public cloud services on AWS and Azure where the business needs them, to the same standards.
Carry out routine maintenance, including patching, upgrades, certificate and credential renewals, and lifecycle management.
Provision and decommission development, test, and production environments in a consistent, repeatable way.
Maintain an accurate inventory of hosted systems, environments, and their dependencies.
Automation and delivery pipelines:
Build and maintain the CI/CD pipelines used by the development team.
Define infrastructure as code so environments can be rebuilt from source control rather than by hand.
Automate repetitive operational work and reduce manual steps in deployment and maintenance.
Support developers in deploying and running their applications correctly in each environment.
Security and hardening:
Apply hardening baselines, network segmentation, and firewall and access rules across hosted environments.
Manage access to hosting environments on a least-privilege basis, review it regularly and remove it promptly when no longer needed.
Manage secrets, keys and certificates so that no credentials sit in code or repositories.
Run dependency, container image and configuration scanning in the pipelines, and act on the results with the Platform and Engineering Manager.
Remediate hosting-related security and risk findings assigned by the Platform and Engineering Manager within agreed timelines and provide evidence of the fix for independent verification.
Backup, recovery and resilience:
Implement and operate backups for hosted systems, aligned to the agreed RPO/RTO and system classification.
Test restores on a regular schedule and records the results.
Maintain recovery runbooks and contribute to disaster recovery and business continuity planning.
Monitoring and incident response:
Implement monitoring, alerting and log collection for hosted systems, and keep alerts actionable.
Respond to hosting incidents, restore service, and document the root cause and follow-up actions.
Take part in out-of-hours support for hosted systems.
Change control:
Raise hosting changes through the IT Operations change process and implement only approved changes.
Record what was changed, when and why, so changes can be traced and reversed.
Cost awareness:
Right-size and tag resources, and flag unused or underused resources.
Provide the Platform and Engineering Manager with consumption data so spend can be tracked and motivated.
Documentation and knowledge sharing:
Maintain runbooks, architecture diagrams, and procedures so another team member can operate, restore and rebuild the environment in the engineer's absence.
Work with the Platform and Engineering Manager and the senior developers so that at least one other person can perform critical tasks such as restoring from backup, rotating credentials, and deploying to production.

Scripting ability in Bash, PowerShell, or Python.

Willingness to take part in out-of-hours support.

About the position
MID–SENIOR AGENTIC SOFTWARE ENGINEER
Build software differently. Engineer with AI. Shape what comes next.
Are you a software engineer who doesn't just want to use AI — but wants to engineer alongside it?
We're looking for Mid–Senior Agentic Software Engineers to join a next-generation digital transformation programme, where traditional software development meets AI-powered, agentic engineering.
This is an opportunity to help redefine how enterprise software gets designed, built, tested and delivered.
You’ll bring your strong software engineering foundations and combine them with AI development agents, intelligent workflows and human engineering judgement to deliver secure, scalable and production-ready solutions at speed.
THIS ISN'T JUST ABOUT WRITING CODE
You'll work with AI as your engineering partner.
You'll use tools such as enterprise AI platforms, GitHub Copilot and Claude to:
Direct AI agents to build real software
Turn user stories, Figma designs and business rules into working solutions
Create and refine prompts, AI Skills and instruction files
Review and challenge AI-generated code
Identify security, performance and architectural risks
Build reusable AI-enabled engineering workflows
Continuously improve how AI contributes to software delivery
The AI writes code. You provide the engineering judgement.
WHAT YOU'LL BE BUILDING
This is full-stack, end-to-end engineering.
You could find yourself working across:
Frontend applications
Mobile and cross-platform experiences
Backend services
APIs and integrations
Cloud-native platforms
Data and persistence layers
CI/CD and DevSecOps
Automated testing
Observability and performance
The technology landscape will evolve, so we're looking for engineers who can learn fast, adapt quickly and aren't tied to a single framework or language.
THE AGENTIC ENGINEERING MINDSET
We're looking for engineers who are:
AI-NATIVE
You know how to use AI to dramatically increase your productivity — without outsourcing your engineering judgement.
CURIOUS
You enjoy experimenting with new tools, frameworks and ways of building software.
FRAMEWORK-AGNOSTIC
React Native today? Flutter tomorrow? .NET MAUI next? You can adapt.
CONSTRUCTIVELY SCEPTICAL
AI-generated code isn't automatically good code. You know how to question it, test it and improve it.
SYSTEMS-THINKING
You understand how individual components fit into larger, complex enterprise systems.
QUALITY-OBSESSED
Security, scalability, performance, testing and maintainability aren't optional extras.
CONTINUOUSLY LEARNING
You're excited about where software engineering is heading — and want to help shape it.
RequirementsWHAT YOU'LL BRING
We're looking for 4–8 years of professional software engineering experience, with strong foundations and a clear trajectory toward senior-level capability.
You'll ideally have:
Strong full-stack software engineering experience
Experience delivering complex enterprise applications
Frontend, backend, API and cloud experience
Understanding of distributed systems and modern application architecture
Strong software design and engineering principles
Commercial mobile/cross-platform development experience
React Native and/or Flutter experience highly advantageous
Experience with .NET MAUI, Swift, Kotlin or Ionic advantageous
Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools
Exposure to AI agents, prompts, instruction files or AI engineering workflows
The ability to recognise when AI-generated code is incorrect, insecure or poorly designed
ENGINEERING EXCELLENCE STILL MATTERS
AI may accelerate development — but engineering standards don't change.
You'll be expected to understand and apply:
Software Architecture • Secure Coding • SOLID • Design Patterns • TDD • DDD • API Design • CI/CD • DevSecOps • Distributed Systems • Cloud-Native Engineering • Observability • Performance • Accessibility • Technical Debt Management
WHY THIS ROLE?
Because software engineering is changing.
This isn't a traditional Software Engineer role — and it isn't simply an AI Engineer role either.
It's a role for engineers who want to sit at the intersection of software engineering and agentic AI.
You'll have the opportunity to:
Accelerate how software is built
Work directly with AI development agents
Develop next-generation engineering practices
Influence how AI is used across enterprise delivery
Work across evolving technologies and frameworks
Build production-grade enterprise software
Help shape the future of software engineering
The programme's goal is to establish a new standard for AI-enabled software delivery, and you'll be part of building that capability.
Ready to engineer what comes next?

Network Gateway (BNG) management, capacity planning across IP Transit (IPT) and Internet Exchange
Points (IXPs), and complex escalation handling. Additionally, strong operational expertise in Linux-based
Open-Source Support Systems (OSS) is required to support core automation and network monitoring
infrastructure.
Critical outputs:
Peering and transit operations:
Manage end-to-end public peering at major IXPs and establish bilateral private peering agreements.

Maintain and update regional internet registry data (AFRINIC) including IP allocation, ASN management, and WHOIS records.

OSS and Linux infrastructure support:
Maintain, support, and customize Linux-based OSS tools (e.g., netflow collectors, syslog servers, monitoring stacks like Prometheus/Grafana, or custom network automation scripts).
Develop lightweight Linux/Python tools and scripts to automate registry updates, session monitoring, and operational workflows.

Experience

: Proven track record supporting Linux-based OSS platforms, system administration, and shell scripting/automation.

Linux Professional Institute (LPIC) or RHCE

Our client is looking for a Technical Delivery Manager to lead delivery across multiple agile software development squads, ensuring teams deliver valuable outcomes predictably, sustainably, and transparently.  This role sits at the centre of the software delivery lifecycle, partnering closely with Product Managers, Technical Leads, Engineers, QA, Designers, and business stakeholders. Given the depth of technical collaboration involved, we are prioritising candidates with a strong technical or software development background who can build credibility with engineering teams, follow technical discussions in depth, and operate effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Manage competing expectations and communicate delivery impacts clearly.
Ensure dependencies and risks are identified early and actively managed.
Facilitate alignment and decision-making across complex initiatives involving multiple teams.

Drive continuous improvement of delivery practices, processes, and team effectiveness.
Foster a culture of experimentation, learning, and evidence-based decision making.

Champion the adoption and effective use of AI and agentic tools to improve productivity, planning, communication, reporting, analysis, and team efficiency.

The Business Analyst is responsible for investigating business needs, analysing, and improving processes, and translating approved business problems and opportunities into clear requirements for technology and operational improvement initiatives across the company and its associated brands. The role acts as a bridge between business stakeholders, the PMO, Technology & Innovation, technical teams and vendors, ensuring that the underlying problem is properly understood before a solution is
designed or selected.
The role will facilitate discovery sessions, document current and future-state processes, prepare business and functional requirements, perform gap and impact analysis, support solution evaluation, and maintain traceability from the original business need through design, testing, and implementation. change readiness where required.
Role purpose:

Execute testing where required.

About the position
Our client, a leading International Logistics company based in Johannesburg, is looking to fill the position of Overland Logistics Manager.
Purpose of the Role:
Reporting to the General Manager. The Logistics Manager is responsible for planning, directing, and controlling all warehouse and distribution operations within a 3PL environment to ensure efficient, safe, compliant, and cost-effective service delivery to clients. The role oversees inventory management, warehousing, transport coordination, customer service, staff leadership, and continuous improvement to meet contractual service levels and profitability targets. The incumbent is accountable for maintaining high standards in operational execution, client satisfaction, people management, statutory compliance, and performance reporting across the warehouse and distribution function.
Key Responsibilities:
Operational Management:
Manage the day-to-day operations of the warehouse and distribution function.
Ensure inbound, storage, inventory control, order picking, packing, dispatch, and outbound distribution activities are executed efficiently.
Oversee route planning, load optimisation, vehicle utilisation, and delivery scheduling in line with customer requirements.
Ensure all client SLAs, KPIs, and operational targets are achieved.
Monitor productivity, turnaround times, stock accuracy, on-time dispatch, and delivery performance.
Coordinate with clients, transporters, suppliers, and internal departments to ensure seamless service delivery.
Drive execution consistency across receiving, put-away, replenishment, picking, staging, dispatch, and proof of delivery processes.
Warehouse Management:
Ensure warehouse layout, capacity utilisation, and storage methods support operational efficiency and stock integrity.
Manage stock handling processes to minimise damages, losses, and shrinkage.
Oversee cycle counts, stock takes, reconciliations, and inventory investigations.
Ensure adherence to FIFO/FEFO and product-specific storage requirements where applicable.
Maintain strong housekeeping and warehouse organisation standards.
Distribution and Transport Coordination:
Coordinate vehicle scheduling and delivery planning to achieve on-time and in-full (OTIF) performance.
Ensure fleet or subcontractor performance is monitored and managed effectively.
Manage transport costs, fuel usage, route efficiency, and service provider performance.
Resolve delivery issues, route deviations, claims, and customer escalations promptly.
Ensure proof of delivery and delivery exception management processes are controlled.
Client and Customer Service Management:
Serve as the primary operational contact for client-related logistics matters.
Build strong relationships with clients through regular communication and operational reviews.
Ensure client reporting is accurate, timely, and action oriented.
Address service failures and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
Support contract implementation, new business onboarding, and operational start-ups.
Financial and Cost Management:
Manage warehouse and distribution costs in line with budget.
Monitor labour costs, overtime, transport spend, damages, claims, and consumables.
Identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising service or compliance.
Support budget preparation, monthly forecasting, variance analysis and monthly flash.
Ensure operational activities contribute to margin protection and profitability.
People Management:
Lead, coach, and develop warehouse and distribution teams to achieve operational excellence.
Manage workforce planning, staffing levels, shift structures, attendance, discipline, and performance.
Conduct performance reviews and ensure training and development needs are addressed.
Drive a culture of accountability, teamwork, customer focus, and continuous improvement.
Manage employee relations matters in line with company policy and South African labour legislation.
Compliance, Risk, and Safety:
Ensure compliance with company policies, customer requirements, and all relevant South African legislation.
Maintain a safe working environment in line with the Occupational Health and Safety Act.
Ensure compliance with transport, dangerous goods (if applicable), food safety (if applicable), and security requirements.
Engage with internal SHERQ Team / Management
Lead incident investigations, risk assessments, and corrective action implementation.
Ensure adherence to quality, audit, and governance standards.
Systems, Reporting, and Continuous Improvement:
Use WMS, TMS, and reporting tools to monitor and improve operational performance.
Analyse operational data and generate daily, weekly, and monthly management reports.
Drive process improvements, standardisation, and productivity initiatives.
Support implementation of new systems, technologies, and process enhancements.
Develop and maintain SOPs, work instructions, and process controls.
Qualifications and Experience:
Grade 12 Senior Certificate
Diploma or Degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Transport Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Management, or related field
A relevant postgraduate qualification will be advantageous
Minimum 5-10 years' experience in logistics, warehousing, and distribution
At least 5 years in a management role within a warehouse/distribution environment
Experience in a 3PL environment is essential
Proven experience managing client service levels, warehouse operations, and transport coordination
Experience with multiple customers, high-volume operations, and performance-driven environments preferred
Technical Knowledge:
Knowledge of warehouse operations, inventory control, and distribution planning
Strong understanding of 3PL service models and client contract execution
Knowledge of WMS, TMS, ERP, and Microsoft Office (especially Excel)
Understanding of South African labour legislation, OHS requirements, and transport compliance
Knowledge of budgeting, cost control, and operational reporting
Sound understanding of bond stores
Functional Competencies:
Warehouse and distribution management
Inventory and stock control
Route and transport planning
SLA and KPI management
Cost and budget control
Process improvement
Client relationship management
Risk and compliance management
Key Performance Indicators:
The Logistics Manager may be measured against the following:
On-time dispatch rate
On-time in-full (OTIF) delivery performance
Inventory accuracy %
Order picking accuracy %
Warehouse productivity rates
Vehicle/fleet utilisation %
Cost per case/order/km delivered
Labour productivity and overtime control
Claims, damages, and losses
Safety performance (LTIs, incidents, near misses)
Client SLA/KPI achievement
Customer complaint resolution turnaround
Budget adherence and cost savings delivered

About the position
High-level role overview:
The Software Quality Assurance Analyst will act as the company’s internal software-quality specialist, providing structured and independent testing across the software development and implementation lifecycle.
The role will review requirements for completeness and testability, develop test strategies and test plans, prepare detailed test scenarios and scripts, execute functional and integration testing, manage defects, perform regression testing and support business users during User Acceptance Testing.
The role will also establish consistent QA standards, templates, quality gates, and reporting across projects. The analyst will provide project teams and decisionmakers with clear visibility of test coverage, open defects, quality risks and release readiness before systems are implemented.
The role must determine testing depth, test priorities, risk coverage, defect severity, regression scope and whether the available evidence supports a release-readiness recommendation. These decisions can affect release timing, project cost, operational continuity, financial controls, customer experience, and the level of risk accepted by the business.
Role purpose:
The Software Quality Assurance Analyst is responsible for establishing and executing structured quality assurance and software testing practices across the company’s technology and digital transformation projects.
The role ensures that software applications, integrations, workflows, reports, and digital solutions meet approved business requirements, operate reliably across interconnected systems and are sufficiently stable for implementation. The Software Quality Assurance Analyst will work closely with project managers, business analysts, developers, vendors, technical teams and business stakeholders to identify quality risks, develop testing strategies, execute testing, manage defects, and provide evidence
based release-readiness recommendations.
The role will support applications across the company and its associated brands, including web and mobile applications, internally developed systems, vendor solutions, Microsoft Power Platform applications, POS integrations, transactional platforms, reporting solutions, and operational systems.
.
Key responsibilities:
Quality assurance strategy and planning:
Develop and maintain appropriate test strategies, test plans, test schedules and quality-assurance approaches for technology projects and software releases.
Define the scope, objectives, types, environments, resources, dependencies, risks, entry criteria and exit criteria for each testing cycle.
Estimate testing effort and provide realistic input into project plans, sprint plans and release schedules.
Apply risk-based testing principles to prioritise high-impact business processes, financial transactions, security controls, integrations, and customer-facing functionality.
Ensure testing activities are aligned with the approved project scope, business requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
Identify required test environments, devices, system access, test accounts, data and technical dependencies before testing begins.
Requirements review and testability:
Review business requirements, functional specifications, user stories, process maps, business rules and acceptance criteria to confirm that they are clear, complete, consistent, and testable.
Identify gaps, ambiguities, conflicting requirements, edge cases, control weaknesses, and quality risks before development is completed.
Work with the Business Analyst, Project Manager, developers, and business stakeholders to clarify expected results and resolve requirement uncertainty.
Contribute to requirement and solution walkthroughs from a quality-assurance perspective.
Ensure that expected results and quality standards are sufficiently defined before test cases are prepared.
Test case design and test preparation:
Design and maintain test scenarios, test cases, test scripts, checklists, and test data requirements.
Ensure testing covers positive, negative, boundary, exception, validation, and end-to-end business scenarios.
Link test cases to the relevant requirements, user stories, or acceptance criteria.
Maintain reusable regression test packs for key platforms and business processes.
Test execution:
Execute manual functional, system, integration, end-to-end, regression, smoke, sanity, usability, and compatibility testing.
Validate that software functionality meets approved business and functional requirements.
Test complete business processes across applications, databases, APIs, workflows, notifications, reporting tools, POS systems, and third-party platforms.
Test software across relevant browsers, devices, operating systems, and user roles.
Record actual test results and retain appropriate screenshots, logs, extracts or other supporting evidence.
Perform exploratory testing to identify issues not covered by predefined test cases.
Integration and transactional testing:
Test integrations between internal systems, vendor platforms, APIs, POS systems, payment services, databases, Microsoft 365 services, and reporting platforms.
Validate successful and unsuccessful transaction paths, including error handling, retries, timeouts, cancellations, duplicate transactions, and interrupted processes.
Confirm that data is transferred correctly between systems and that statuses remain synchronised.
Test reconciliation, audit and reporting outputs arising from integrated transactions.
Identify whether defects originate within a specific application or at the boundary between integrated systems.
Pay particular attention to financial, voucher, payment, loyalty, customer, reporting and other high-impact transaction flows.
Defect management:
Log defects with clear titles, descriptions, reproduction steps, expected results, actual results, evidence, environment details, and business impact.
Classify defects according to agreed severity and priority definitions.
Facilitate defect-triage sessions with developers, business analysts, project managers, vendors and business representatives.
Track defects from identification through investigation, resolution, retesting, and closure.
Reproduce reported issues and provide clear supporting evidence to technical teams.
Retest corrected defects and perform appropriate regression testing to identify unintended consequences.
Regression testing:
Develop and maintain regression packs for business-critical applications and recurring release cycles.
Identify existing functionality that may be affected by new development, configuration changes or defect corrections.
Execute regression testing before significant releases and after material changes.
Ensure that new functionality does not negatively affect existing processes, integrations, controls or reporting.
Recommend suitable candidates for test automation based on frequency, stability, risk and repeatability.
Track regression coverage and outstanding gaps across releases.
User acceptance testing support:
Work with the Business Analyst, Project Manager and business stakeholders to prepare the User Acceptance Testing approach.
Assist with translating business requirements and acceptance criteria into business-focused UAT scenarios.
Confirm that the UAT environment, user access, test data, and supporting information is ready.
Brief business testers on the UAT process, expected evidence and defect-logging requirements.
Support users during execution and help distinguish defects from requirement changes, training needs, configuration issues, or new enhancement requests.
Track UAT progress, defects, decisions and sign-off.
Ensure that outstanding defects and accepted risks are clearly communicated before business approval is requested.
Minimum qualifications:
A diploma or degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering or a related discipline.
ISTQB Foundation
Minimum experience

Five to ten years' experience in software quality assurance, software testing, test analysis or a comparable role.
Demonstrated experience preparing test strategies, test plans, test cases, test scripts, and regression packs.
Experience testing web applications, mobile applications, enterprise systems, or transactional platforms.
Experience performing functional, system, integration, end-to-end and regression testing.
Experience managing defects through the complete defect lifecycle.
Experience working directly with developers, business analysts, project managers, business users and external vendors.
Experience working in Agile, Waterfall or hybrid development environments.
Experience producing clear testing reports and presenting quality risks to stakeholders.

Experience within QSR, retail, hospitality, franchising, or multi-site operations.
Experience testing POS, voucher, loyalty, payment, ordering or other high-volume transactional systems.

Experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power Automate, SharePoint and Dataverse

Software Testing Lifecycle

About the position
Position open to all races
Financial planning and analysis (FP&A) entails planning, forecasting and analysing the organisation's financial performance and position, focusing on the entity's liquidity, and mitigating its financial, operational, and reputational risk. The scope includes budgeting, forecasting, corporate modelling, cash management, and debt covenant compliance.
The role owns and builds three corporate financial models, leads cash forecasting and scenario planning, and presents this work directly to the Executive Committee
QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE:
5+ years of experience in financial planning and analysis, financial modelling or corporate finance, including significant leadership experience.
Strong understanding of cash management, debt covenant compliance, and interest rate risk.
Experience managing financial models and cash management systems in a corporate finance setting.
Experience in the Investment/Equity markets or financial services sectors (preferred).
Qualiffied CA(SA) or similar
NON- NEGOTIABLE:
Proven, hands-on experience building and owning corporate financial models - including cash forecasting and scenario planning - with the ability to demonstrate this via a technical assessment or portfolio review.
Advanced financial modelling and Excel skills - self-reported proficiency alone is not sufficient; evidence of formal modelling training, certification, or a portfolio of models built is required.
Demonstrated experience presenting financial models and forecasts directly to a Board or Investment/Audit Committee.
CORPORATE MODELLING & CASH FORECASTING
Own and build the organisation's three corporate financial models end-to-end, keeping them accurate, well-structured, and fit for decision-making.
Leas cash forecasting and scenario planning, stress-testing liquidity under different business and market conditions.
Translate model outputs into clear insights and recommendations for the CFO and senior management.
Continuously improve model design, assumptions, and controls to ensure integrity and auditability.
STRATEGIC FINANCIAL PLANNING
Implement financial plans aligned to the finance function and to support company goals.
Prepare business plans, reports, and portfolio reporting.
Lead the annual budget and rolling forecasts, including variance analysis against budget.
Assess market trends, drives financial risk management, and finds ways to maximise cash flow.
Manage finance projects, including identifying the best options for investing cash or issuing financial instruments.
Advise the CFO on finance, compliance, cash, and consolidation activities.
BOARD REPORTING & PRESENTATION
Present corporate models, cash forecasts, and scenario analysis directly to the Board, in a clear and decision-ready format.
Develop financial reporting dashboards appropriate for various stakeholders and tracks KPIs.
Create clear, methodical financial reporting packs for senior stakeholders and the Board.
CAPITAL STRUCTURE MANAGEMENT
Manage the business's capital structure to ensure optimal cash flow for the organisation.
Continuously review and evaluate different sources of capital, such as debt and equity, to find the best financing options.
Optimise the capital structure to reduce financing costs and support shareholder value while maintaining the organisation's ability to grow.
Develop the reporting and modelling capabilities required to support short-term and long-term liquidity forecasting, working closely with the CFO.
Oversee the organisation's financial assets, liquidity, and risk to ensure sound cash flow, stability, and profitability.
CASH OPERATIONS & DEBT COVENANTS
Manages day-to-day cash operations, including cash disbursements, collections, reconciliations, and reporting.
Manage compliance with relevant regulatory requirements, internal controls, and accounting standards.
Manage activities relating to financial reporting, tax compliance, and cash management planning.
Serve as the primary contact with investment advisors and money market providers, ensuring alignment with investment policy and reviewing performance.
Monitor debt covenant compliance and prepares related calculations and certificates in accordance with debt agreements.
Forecast covenant headroom under different scenarios and flags any risk of a breach to the CFO early.
Manage foreign exchange and interest-rate risk, including hedging to mitigate currency and interest rate fluctuations.
CASH MANAGEMENT
Manage cash for daily operations and long-term planning to ensure the business has sufficient funds to operate.
Manage excess operating cash, including money market investments, to obtain optimum interest revenue.
Oversee daily cash positioning, including liquidity management, cash position reconciliation, and bank reporting.
Serve as the primary contact with commercial banks on cash management services and day-to-day banking needs.
FINANCIAL RISK & TAX MANAGEMENT
Ensure the business is well-placed to respond to changes in industry, law, tax, and global finance.
Structure the organisation's assets for short- and long-term tax efficiency, in line with cash flow needs.
Assesses market risk, and interest rate risk, and its impact on forecasts and debt covenants.
STAKEHOLDER RELASTIONSHIP MANAGEMENT
Maintain banking relationships and relationships with senior lenders and financial analysts.
Keep up to date with industry trends and new financial products and services that can benefit the organisation.
Track banking fees and performance to ensure the best banking services at the lowest cost.
FINANCIAL REPORTING & COMPLIANCE
Contribute to financial reporting in line with accounting standards, including IFRS, such as supporting disclosures and schedules for the annual financial statements.
Work with auditors on internal and external audits, particularly on models, forecasts, cash and covenant calculations, and advises on complex financial transactions.
Provide sound, up-to-date data and financial health assessments for senior leaders' decision-making.

About the position
South African Sugarcane Research Institute (SASRI)
a division of the South African Sugar Association (SASA) has a permanent vacancy for a
Plant Breeder - Irrigated Region
, at their
SASRI Pongola Research Station
, based in
Pongola.
The opportunity
Irrigated sugarcane growers in Pongola, Komatipoort, Malelane and beyond rely on varieties bred for their conditions. We are looking for a Plant Breeder to lead SASRI's irrigated breeding programme from our Pongola Research Station, close to the trials, the fields and the growers the work is for.
You will take ownership of the programme that develops SASRI's "N" varieties, bred specifically for irrigated production. These varieties are grown across South Africa's irrigated region and licensed to sugarcane estates elsewhere in sub-Saharan Africa, so your work will reach well beyond our borders.
This is a hands-on, field-based role with real influence. The decisions you help make about which varieties move forward will shape what growers plant for years to come.
About SASRI
The South African Sugarcane Research Institute (SASRI) is the research division of the South African Sugar Association (SASA). Our Breeding and Field Resource Unit develops high-yielding, pest- and disease-resistant sugarcane varieties for each of the industry's growing regions, combining field selection with complementary research.
What you'll do
Lead the irrigated breeding programme
Manage selection activities and variety trials at the Pongola and Komatipoort research stations, at grower sites across the irrigated region, and at the newly established trials on Eswatini sugar estates.
Plan, place and evaluate selection trials, making sure they are well designed and produce reliable data.
Analyse trial results, document how each genotype performs, and make sound recommendations on which varieties to advance and release.
Manage seedcane and seedcane bulking for the programme.
Lead and develop the Pongola team
Supervise, mentor and support the Selection Officer and selection staff based at Pongola.
Set clear standards for trial planning, implementation and data quality.
Work closely with growers and colleagues
Coordinate the trial network with Research Station Managers.
Engage regularly with Extension specialists and growers, so that what we breed reflects what growers need.
Work with the breeding team at Mount Edgecombe and contribute to SASRI's wider breeding programme.
Look for new technologies and methods that make the programme more efficient.
Manage, report and share
Manage project budgets and allocate resources to meet programme goals.
Share results through reports, peer-reviewed publications and conferences, and connect with the international sugarcane breeding community.
What you'll bring
Essential
A PhD in Plant Breeding and Genetics, Quantitative Genetics or a related field.
Practical experience in a plant breeding programme, including running field trials.
A strong grounding in field breeding methods, experimental design and the statistical analysis of trial data.
Confidence with databases, spreadsheets and statistical software.
Experience supervising or leading staff.
A track record of managing projects and meeting milestones.
Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to speak comfortably with scientists and growers alike.
A valid driver's licence and willingness to travel regularly across the irrigated region and to Eswatini.
An advantage
Knowledge of sugarcane, especially sugarcane breeding or production under irrigation.
Experience in a commercial breeding programme.
Experience with multi-environment trials and genotype-by-environment analysis.
Familiarity with quantitative and statistical genetics, selection theory, and family, parent and breeding-value evaluation.
Knowledge of molecular markers, genomic tools or introgression breeding.
Who you are
You are self-motivated, organised and careful with detail. You enjoy fieldwork and practical problem-solving, and you are comfortable working independently at a regional station while staying closely connected to a wider team. You build good relationships easily, whether with your own staff, colleagues at head office or growers in the field.
Why join us
Lead a programme whose results growers see directly in their fields.
Build and guide your own team at Pongola.
Join a research institute with a long record in sugarcane breeding, and colleagues who are generous with their expertise.
SASRI offers a market related package and relocation support to the selected applicant.
Our recruitment process includes formal assessments of cognitive ability and behavioural style, carried out by an internationally recognised assessment provider.

About the position
Background:
The MRC/Wits Rural Public Health and Health Transitions Research Unit (Agincourt) is an exceptional Health and Population Research Centre in the Wits School of Public Health
The Unit supports a major research infrastructure underpinned by a health and socio-demographic surveillance system (HDSS), covering a substantial portion of the Bushbuckridge sub-district of rural Mpumalanga Province, in operation since 1992, coupled with observational and interventional studies along the life course
The Southern Centre for Inequality Studies (SCIS) is a multi-partner Research and Policy Centre at Wits focused on understanding and addressing inequality in the global South, with a particular emphasis on research conceived in and for the global South
The Agincourt Unit and SCIS are co-leading Aspire Africa, a three-year research grant-funded programme
Aspire Africa is a multi-country study investigating youth economic inclusion and resilience across four Health and Demographic Surveillance System (HDSS) sites in South Africa, Kenya, Ethiopia and Ghana
The programme combines secondary analysis of existing longitudinal HDSS data with new qualitative data collection, generating evidence to support policies and interventions that improve employment and economic outcomes for youth — particularly young women and other vulnerable groups — in rural and transitioning communities
The programme is implemented through a consortium of four leading African research institutions: the SAMRC/Wits-Agincourt Research Unit (South Africa), the Kaloleni Rabai HDSS at Aga Khan University (Kenya), the Dabat Research Centre at the University of Gondar (Ethiopia), and the Navrongo Health Research Centre with the Regional Institute for Population Studies (Ghana)
The successful candidate will join a talented and committed team addressing some of the most pressing challenges facing African youth and contributing to a growing body of evidence on poverty, inequality and resilience in sub-Saharan Africa
The successful candidate will enjoy unparalleled opportunities across all stages of the research process, including ethics and public engagement, field science, research data management, research-to-policy engagement, analysis, write-up and publication
The position will be based in either Bushbuckridge sub-district, Mpumalanga Province, where Wits offers various accommodation options, or the Wits School of Public Health in Johannesburg with travel to the SAMRC/Wits-Agincourt campus in Bushbuckridge

About the position
About the Role
An established and growing national trade publication serving the construction, plumbing, artisan and broader trade markets is looking to appoint a highly driven Sales & Business Development Executive. This is a genuine new-business development role for someone who enjoys prospecting, opening doors, building relationships and converting commercial opportunities into revenue. The publication is approximately two years old and has already demonstrated strong commercial potential without previously having a dedicated salesperson or formal sales function. Advertising sales of approximately R155,000 have been achieved in a single month, despite sales historically being handled by existing team members alongside their primary responsibilities. The business is now investing in a dedicated sales function for the first time and is looking for someone who is excited by the opportunity to build, structure and grow the commercial side of the publication. This is not an account-management role where the successful candidate will inherit a mature book of business. The successful candidate will be expected to proactively generate opportunities, develop a pipeline and help build a professional, structured sales process.
The Opportunity
The successful candidate will have access to:
An existing prospect and contact database.
Historical sales information.
Active and warm opportunities already in the pipeline.
An established advertising rate card.
Existing industry contacts and market intelligence.
Sales and marketing material.
Support from management, editorial and the wider team.
However, proactive prospecting, cold outreach and building a personal pipeline will remain fundamental to the role. The business believes there is significant untapped opportunity within the market and is looking for someone who sees the potential in building towards meaningful long-term revenue growth.
Key Responsibilities
New Business Development
Proactively identify and develop new advertising and commercial opportunities.
Conduct cold calling, outbound prospecting and direct outreach to prospective advertisers.
Build relationships with companies operating within construction, plumbing, manufacturing, trade, industrial and related B2B markets.
Engage with marketing managers, business owners, commercial leaders and other relevant decision-makers.
Convert prospects into new advertising clients.
Develop new relationships with industry partners and commercial stakeholders.
Identify new sectors and advertiser categories that align with the publication's audience.
Pipeline Development & Management
Build and maintain a healthy, qualified sales pipeline.
Work existing prospect and industry databases while continuing to generate new leads independently.
Maintain consistent follow-up with prospects.
Manage opportunities through the full sales process from initial contact through to close.
Maintain accurate information relating to:
Prospects.
Opportunities.
Follow-ups.
Expected revenue.
Forecast close dates.
Conversion activity.
Help establish a more structured and professional sales process within the business.
Contribute towards developing reliable data around sales cycles, conversion rates and pipeline performance.
Advertising & Commercial Sales
Present advertising opportunities and commercial packages professionally.
Clearly communicate the value and reach of the publication to prospective advertisers.
Understand client objectives and recommend suitable advertising solutions.
Prepare and present proposals and advertising options.
Negotiate professionally while protecting commercial value.
Close new advertising business.
Identify opportunities for repeat campaigns and longer-term advertising relationships.
Account Development
While new business is the primary focus, the successful candidate will also:
Maintain strong relationships with customers once business has been secured.
Encourage repeat advertising.
Identify upselling and additional commercial opportunities.
Maintain regular contact with advertisers.
Develop long-term relationships that contribute to recurring revenue.
Sales Reporting & Forecasting
Maintain disciplined records of sales activity.
Produce accurate sales forecasts.
Track conversion and pipeline progression.
Report regularly on:
New prospects.
Meetings.
Proposals.
Pipeline value.
Sales closed.
Expected revenue.
Identify market feedback, competitor activity and commercial opportunities.
Ideal Candidate Profile
We are looking for a genuine new-business salesperson, rather than someone whose experience is predominantly account management or servicing existing customers.
The ideal candidate will:
Have a strong hunter mentality.
Enjoy cold prospecting and opening new doors.
Be commercially minded and results-driven.
Have proven ability to generate their own pipeline.
Be confident engaging with business owners and senior decision-makers.
Be highly organised and disciplined with follow-up.
Demonstrate strong relationship-building capability.
Be comfortable working independently.
Take ownership of commercial outcomes.
Be motivated by uncapped earning potential.
Be excited by the opportunity to help build a sales function rather than simply inherit an established portfolio.
Experience
Relevant experience could include:
B2B sales.
Media sales.
Advertising sales.
Sponsorship sales.
Exhibition or event sales.
Business development.
Construction industry sales.
Plumbing or trade-sector sales.
Manufacturing or industrial sales.
Other commercially focused B2B environments.
Experience in media or publishing would be advantageous, but strong sales ability and proven new-business development capability are the priority.
Key Skills & Competencies
Proven new-business development ability.
Cold calling and outbound prospecting.
Lead generation.
Pipeline management.
Strong closing ability.
Commercial negotiation.
Excellent written and verbal communication.
Relationship management.
Proposal presentation.
Strong administration and follow-through.
Forecasting and reporting.
Ability to work independently.
High levels of resilience and persistence.
Strong commercial judgement.
Comfortable working towards clear revenue targets.
Working Arrangement
The role operates on a four-day working week, Monday to Thursday.
Fridays are generally kept free for personal administration and appointments, providing an attractive additional benefit alongside the basic salary and uncapped commission structure.
What Success Looks Like
The successful candidate will help establish a structured and sustainable sales function by:
Growing monthly advertising revenue.
Building a strong pipeline of qualified opportunities.
Generating consistent new business.
Converting existing warm prospects.
Increasing repeat advertising revenue.
Developing new industry relationships.
Introducing disciplined pipeline management and follow-up.
Establishing reliable forecasting.
Tracking conversion rates and sales-cycle performance.
Helping the publication materially grow its commercial market share.
Why This Role Will Appeal
This is an opportunity to join a young and growing trade publication at a point where it is investing properly in sales for the first time. The successful candidate will have an existing foundation to work from, including market traction, active prospects, historical sales information, a rate card, industry contacts and management support. At the same time, there is significant opportunity for the right salesperson to build something meaningful, establish a professional sales function and directly influence the commercial growth of the business. It is particularly well suited to an ambitious salesperson who wants ownership, uncapped earning potential, a four-day working week and the opportunity to build rather than simply maintain an existing sales portfolio.
***Salary - R25,000 CTC + Commission (Negotiable - Based on experience, skill & in relation to your current package)

New business development.
Prospecting and lead generation.
Client relationship management.
Account growth and retention.
Pipeline management.
Industry networking.
Commercial reporting.

New Business Development

Yacht chefs.
Chief stewardesses.
Interior crew.

Develop relationships with prospective clients before they return to work in the Mediterranean.

Crew training academies.
Yachting networks.
Industry events.
Professional referrals.
Social media.
Direct outreach.
Present the company's provisioning services and value proposition professionally.
Convert qualified prospects into first-time customers.

Maintain a disciplined approach to lead management and conversion.
Existing Client Management

Maintain regular communication with customers through WhatsApp and other appropriate channels.
Communicate:
Seasonal offers.
Product information.
Service updates.
Order follow-ups.
Maintain strong relationships throughout the yachting season.
Encourage repeat orders and increased account activity.
Identify opportunities to grow revenue from existing customers.
Support customer retention and long-term loyalty.
Networking & Industry Development
Build a strong presence within the South African yacht-crew community.
Develop relationships with training academies, crew networks and relevant industry stakeholders.
Attend key yachting events and networking opportunities where required.
Identify emerging trends and opportunities within the yacht-crew market.
Position yourself as a trusted point of contact for clients and prospective customers.
