Provide weekly sales reporting against agreed targets.
Monitor:
New prospects generated.
Pipeline activity.
Conversion.
New clients secured.
Existing account performance.
Provide feedback on market trends and competitor activity.
Share relevant customer insights with the wider business.
Ideal Candidate Profile
Sales Experience
The most important requirement is strong sales capability.
The successful candidate should demonstrate:
A strong hunter mentality.
Proven ability to generate new business.
Persistence and resilience.
Strong relationship-building skills.
Commercial confidence.
A track record of achieving sales targets.
Ability to prospect, pitch and close new customers.
Confidence managing both new and existing client relationships.
Yachting & Industry Experience
Previous exposure to the yachting industry would be advantageous but is not essential.
Relevant backgrounds could include:
Yacht crew.
Interior crew.
Galley or culinary environments.
Yacht provisioning.
Hospitality.
Luxury services.
Industry training and support will be provided to the successful candidate.
Existing relationships within the South African yacht-crew community would be advantageous.
Skills & Competencies
Excellent spoken and written English.
French-language ability would be advantageous but is not required.
Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills.
Confident using WhatsApp as a professional client communication channel.
Comfortable working with CRM and basic digital sales tools.
Strong prospecting and business-development skills.
Excellent follow-up and organisational ability.
Comfortable working independently.
Reliable and accountable in a remote-working environment.
Able to manage their own diary, pipeline and priorities.
Comfortable communicating with international colleagues and customers.
Strong commercial awareness.
Professional and customer-focused approach.
Working Arrangements
Fully remote position based anywhere in South Africa.
The successful candidate must be willing to travel to key yachting hubs, crew events and industry activities as required.
Some working hours will need to overlap with European business hours to support clients and international operations.
Employment will be managed locally through a compliant Employer of Record arrangement.

New Client Acquisition
Number of validated new clients secured during each Mediterranean yachting season.

Contribution towards collective revenue targets through both new and repeat orders.

Number of qualified prospects generated.
Pipeline activity and progression.
Conversion of qualified prospects into active customers.

Retention of existing customers.
Repeat-order activity.
Growth in revenue from managed accounts.
Successful re-engagement of inactive customers.

The Opportunity
A well-established financial institution is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Audit Manager to join its Internal Audit function in Durban. This is an opportunity to play an important role in strengthening governance, risk management, regulatory compliance and the internal control environment across the organisation.
The Internal Audit function provides independent assurance to Executive Management and the Board Audit Committee regarding the effectiveness of governance, risk management and internal controls.
Purpose of the Role
The Audit Manager will plan, lead and execute risk-based internal audits across the organisation. The position provides independent assurance on the adequacy and effectiveness of governance, risk management, internal controls and regulatory compliance.
The successful candidate will supervise audit assignments, manage senior stakeholder relationships, develop audit team members and contribute to the ongoing improvement of the Internal Audit function.
Key Responsibilities
Audit Planning and Execution
• Lead and manage end-to-end internal audit engagements across multiple business areas.
• Develop risk-based audit programmes, scopes and testing strategies.
• Evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of key controls.
• Use data analysis to identify emerging risks, trends and potential control weaknesses.
• Ensure audit assignments are completed within agreed timelines and budgets.
Audit Reporting
• Prepare clear, high-quality audit reports for Executive Management and the Board Audit Committee.
• Articulate audit findings, root causes, risk implications and practical recommendations.
• Present audit observations and conclusions to senior management.
• Maintain consistency and quality across audit documentation and working papers.
Stakeholder Management
• Build credible and constructive relationships with business and support functions.
• Participate in management discussions concerning governance, risk and control matters.
• Provide advisory support on control design and regulatory requirements when requested, while maintaining Internal Audit's independence and objectivity.
Audit Quality and Team Development
• Ensure compliance with the organisation's Internal Audit methodology and applicable Global Internal Audit Standards, including the IPPF.
• Maintain high standards of audit quality, evidence and documentation.
• Review audit working papers prepared by audit team members.
• Coach, mentor and support the professional development of auditors.
• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the Internal Audit function.
Regulatory and Compliance Assurance
Assess compliance with relevant legislation, regulations and internal requirements, including:
• Banking regulations and regulatory guidance.
• South African Reserve Bank requirements.
• Prudential Authority requirements.
• The Financial Intelligence Centre Act and related obligations.
• Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing requirements.
• Internal policies, procedures and control standards.
• Monitor regulatory developments and assess their potential impact on the organisation and its control environment.
Follow-Up Reviews
• Monitor the implementation of agreed management actions.
• Conduct follow-up reviews to verify that findings have been appropriately remediated.
• Report overdue actions and significant control weaknesses to management and the Board Audit Committee.
Minimum Requirements
Qualifications
A bachelor's degree in one of the following or a closely related field:
• Internal Audit
• Accounting
• Finance
• Risk Management
• Commerce
Professional Certification
One or more of the following professional certifications would be advantageous:
• CIA - Certified Internal Auditor
• CA(SA) - Chartered Accountant South Africa
• CISA - Certified Information Systems Auditor
Experience
• A minimum of five years' Internal Audit experience.
• A minimum of three years' management or supervisory experience.
• Experience within banking, financial services, regulatory compliance or risk management environments.
• Strong working knowledge of AML/CFT, FICA and banking regulations.
• Proven experience engaging with Executive Management and Audit Committees.
Knowledge and Technical Skills
• Risk-based internal auditing
• Internal control frameworks
• Corporate governance
• AML/CFT and financial-crime controls
• Regulatory compliance
• Data analytics
• Audit report writing
• Root-cause analysis
• Process mapping
• Risk assessment methodologies
The Ideal Candidate
You are a commercially aware and principled audit professional who can balance independent challenge with constructive stakeholder engagement. You communicate complex risk and control matters clearly, maintain rigorous quality standards and enjoy developing others. You are equally comfortable working at a detailed technical level and presenting meaningful assurance to senior decision-makers.

Risk assessment methodologies

Audit execution

Role Overview
The SOC Engineer is responsible for security monitoring, incident triage and after-hours first-line service delivery for the company managed service clients.
The role combines security operations with managed service delivery, ensuring that security events and technical issues are identified, assessed, documented, progressed and escalated appropriately.
The SOC Engineer operates as part of the wider Service Delivery function, working closely with Service Desk Engineers and Service Delivery Management to provide reliable 24/7 support for contracted clients.

Security alerts are monitored, assessed and responded to appropriately.
Security incidents are accurately identified, documented and escalated.
24/7 clients receive consistent and professional after-hours support.
Tickets and incidents have clear ownership and progression.
Escalations contain sufficient technical context to enable efficient resolution.
Security trends, recurring issues and risks are identified and reported.

Review security alerts and determine appropriate action.

Escalate security concerns according to defined processes

Perform initial investigation and impact assessment.

Escalate incidents requiring additional expertise or authority.

Set the standards, lead the people and build facilities systems that work nationally.
Is this you?
You're an assertive, highly organised facilities leader who communicates with confidence and gets to the point. Detail matters, but so does the bigger operational picture. You're proactive, commercially astute and comfortable holding regional teams and suppliers accountable. Strong systems, accurate reporting and permanent solutions are how you operate.
What you'll be doing (and why you'll enjoy it)
This newly created role puts you at the helm of facilities, technical infrastructure, security and operational readiness across a growing multi-site property portfolio. Rather than doing the maintenance yourself, you'll lead regional facilities teams and suppliers across CCTV, access control, security, maintenance, utilities, compliance and preventative maintenance. You'll be joining a trailblazing organisation that is redefining the property landscape with its innovative serviced logistics parks. Strong multi-site facilities experience within commercial, industrial or logistics property is key, with Matric as a minimum. You'll need solid exposure to IT/networking, CCTV, access control, OHS, building infrastructure, supplier management and compliance. Project management exposure, particularly around new sites or infrastructure delivery, is important, alongside budgeting, CAPEX and the ability to read technical information. ENVIRONMENT:
A leading Retailer is looking for a Regional Financial Controller who is responsible for ensuring that financial and stock-related controls are consistently applied, enforced, and maintained across all branches within the region (12-15 branches per region). This role operates as a regional control and governance function, bridging Central Finance, Supply Chain, and Branch Operations to protect the business through robust compliance, accurate financial processes, and effective stock governance.
DUTIES:
Financial Control & Governance
Enforce strong financial controls across the region, ensuring compliance with company policies and audit requirements.
Manage and review emergency payments and buyouts, ensuring appropriate authorisation and supporting documentation.
Review and approve petty cash submissions for all regional sites prior to submission to Central Finance.
Audit petty cash floats across branches.
Oversee document flow to Accounts Payable, ensuring completeness, accuracy and timely submission.
Administer insurance claims and FNB/WesBank fleet card management.
Maintain accurate filing and recordkeeping in accordance with company and audit standards.
Stock Control & Stocktake Management
Provide oversight and leadership of the regional stock control environment, ensuring the integrity, accuracy and completeness of inventory records.
Lead the planning, coordination and execution of regional stocktakes in accordance with company standards, timelines and audit requirements.
Ensure stocktake systems and scanners are appropriately configured, controlled and fully operational.
Monitor stocktake progress and review results with relevant teams.
Investigate and resolve stock variances, ensuring corrective actions are implemented and reported.
Oversee the Goods in Transit process, including accurate tracking, reconciliation and resolution of outstanding balances.
Strengthen stock control processes and internal controls to safeguard inventory assets.
Review scanner administration, stock count validation, variance investigations and corrective actions to maintain stock accuracy and reporting integrity.
Asset Management & CAPEX Control
Review and verify fixed assets, ensuring physical assets are accurately recorded.
Prepare CAPEX forms with the required approvals and supporting documentation.
Maintain accurate asset registers.
Ensure compliance with asset management policies and controls.
Financial Processing & Transaction Oversight

Ensure compliance with procurement and financial policies across regional transactions.
Process transactions, reconciliations, expenses and financial adjustments across allocated finance portfolios.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax legislation, statutory and regulatory requirements, company policies and governance frameworks.
Perform end-to-end financial administration, accounting, reconciliations and reporting for allocated finance portfolios.
Manage finance activities relating to alternate sales channels, regional commercial activities, third-party platforms, supplier funding programmes and shared-service cost allocations.
Investigate and resolve financial exceptions and reconciliation discrepancies.
Prepare and maintain complete supporting documentation, working papers, reconciliations and audit trails.
Prepare, review and submit financial, statutory, management and ESG-related reports and supporting schedules.
Ensure financial information is accurate, complete and submitted within required reporting deadlines.
Liaise with internal and external stakeholders, including auditors, to resolve queries and support audit requirements.
Support continuous improvement of financial processes and internal controls.
Manage the administration and governance of contracts and related documentation with Finance personnel.
Maintain complete, current and audit-ready hardcopy and electronic records.

Assist with audit preparation and respond to audit queries accurately and timeously.
Ensure financial compliance with company policies and procedures across all regional sites.
Escalate systemic issues, material financial risks and control weaknesses to Central Finance.

About the position
ENVIRONMENT:
A manufacturing and distribution company an Accountant who is responsible for managing the full bookkeeping and accounting function of the business up to trial balance level. The role ensures the accurate and timely processing of financial transactions, bank reconciliations, debtor and creditor management, inventory accounting, payroll reconciliations, statutory compliance, month-end reporting, and management accounting support. The incumbent is required to provide accurate financial information to management, ensure strong financial controls are maintained, and support business operations through effective financial administration and reporting.
DUTIES:
Financial Accounting and Bookkeeping
Maintain the integrity and accuracy of the General Ledger.
Process journals, accruals, prepayments, provisions and reversals.
Ensure all financial transactions are accurately recorded and allocated.
Prepare monthly balance sheet reconciliations.
Maintain accounting records up to Trial Balance.
Assist with annual financial statement preparation and external audits.
Ensure compliance with company financial policies and procedures.
Bank and Cash Management
Perform monthly bank reconciliations for all company bank accounts.
Process daily bank transactions.
Reconcile bank accounts and investigate reconciling items.
Allocate customer receipts accurately.
Follow up on unidentified deposits and outstanding items.
Liaise with banking institutions regarding discrepancies.
Inventory and Stock Control
Process and reconcile monthly stock counts.
Perform weekly stock count reconciliations.
Investigate stock variances and discrepancies.
Process stock adjustment journals.
Ensure inventory balances agree to the General Ledger.
Maintain inventory control schedules.
Maintain Bills of Materials (BOMs) in Sage.
Process and reconcile inventory-related transactions: donations, trading samples, stock write-offs, damaged stock, promotional stock, inventory transfers, and production variances.
Month-End Close Process
Take ownership of the monthly financial close process and ensure all deadlines are achieved.
Prepare and review monthly sales reports, export sales reports, profitability analysis, management reporting packs and financial reporting schedules.
Prepare monthly accruals for sales incentives, transport costs, staff transport, truck allowances, storage and distribution charges, bonuses, royalties, overtime, insurance, rental expenses, audit fees, and other operational expenses.
Prepare and process sales, tax, depreciation, commission, payroll, inventory, accrual, reversal and intercompany journals.
Management Reporting
Prepare and analyse monthly sales performance reports, customer growth reports, gross profit analysis, inventory reports, export profit & loss reports, cost centre reports, variance analysis and financial manager reporting packs.
Taxation and Statutory Compliance
Prepare monthly VAT calculations and reconciliations.
Assist with provisional tax calculations.
Prepare tax journals and supporting schedules.
Ensure statutory deadlines are met.
Assist with SARS audits and queries.
Maintain tax and statutory filing records.
Payroll Accounting and Reconciliations
Review payroll information for accuracy.
Perform wage testing and payroll validation.
Process payroll journals.
Reconcile payroll clearing and control accounts.

The Customer Account Manager is responsible for managing a defined portfolio of existing customers and ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction, retention and revenue growth.

Identifying and closing upselling and cross-selling opportunities.

Customer Relationships and Retention
Act as the primary point of contact for an assigned portfolio of customers.
Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including doctors, practice managers and administrators.
Proactively manage customer retention by identifying at-risk accounts early and taking appropriate action to stabilise and retain them.

Ensure consistent customer engagement and the development of meaningful, long-term relationships.
Account Management and Revenue Growth
Take responsibility for the revenue performance of the assigned portfolio, with a clear focus on:
Retaining existing revenue.
Growing revenue through upselling and cross-selling.
Understand each customer's business, use of the company's products and future requirements to identify relevant upselling and cross-selling opportunities.

Follow up with customers to confirm that issues have been resolved and that they are satisfied with the outcome.
Capture customer feedback and insights and communicate them to the relevant internal stakeholders, including Product, Marketing, Sales and Support.
Identify opportunities to improve internal account-management processes and customer-engagement practices.

Customer retention rate within the assigned portfolio.
Adherence to the agreed customer-engagement schedule, including the number and quality of customer visits and contacts compared with the planned activity.
Upselling and cross-selling revenue generated from existing customers compared with the monthly revenue target.
Customer Relationship Management system discipline, including:
Percentage of customer activities recorded.
Completeness and accuracy of customer data.
Revenue pipeline coverage.
Accuracy and quality of forecasts.

Experience in account management, customer success or relationship management, preferably within a business-to-business, professional services or technology environment.
Exposure to the healthcare industry or experience selling to and servicing professional practices, such as doctors, specialists and practice managers, will be a strong advantage.
A proven track record of:
Retaining customers and stabilising at-risk accounts.
Growing revenue from an existing customer base through upselling and cross-selling.
Comfortable working towards monthly revenue targets and account-level performance indicators.
Experience using a Customer Relationship Management system to manage customer activities, revenue pipelines, sales opportunities and forecasts.
Skills and Competencies
Relationship Management and Customer Retention
Able to build and maintain long-term, trust-based relationships with busy professionals.
Skilled in conducting structured customer visits and engagements, both in person and virtually.
Able to hold meaningful, value-driven conversations with customers.
Capable of identifying early warning signs that a customer may be dissatisfied or considering leaving.
Able to implement proactive actions to retain customers and strengthen relationships.
Commercial and Revenue-Growth Focus
Understands how to connect customer needs and product usage with relevant upselling and cross-selling opportunities.
Confident in presenting and positioning additional company products and services to existing customers.
Able to manage a portfolio-based revenue pipeline.
Capable of prioritising activities that support customer retention and revenue growth.
Comfortable negotiating and closing additional sales opportunities.
Consultative and Educational Approach
Possesses strong questioning and active-listening skills.
Able to understand customer challenges and translate them into suitable solutions.
Provides clear product guidance and helps customers gain maximum value from the solutions they use.
Positions themselves as a trusted advisor rather than a transactional salesperson.
Able to explain technical or complex product information clearly and professionally.
Organisation and Customer Relationship Management Discipline
Highly organised when planning customer visits, follow-ups and engagement schedules across a portfolio.
Diligent in recording all customer activities and maintaining complete, accurate and current information within the company's Customer Relationship Management system.
Maintains accurate customer records, revenue pipelines and forecasts.
Uses customer and account information to plan activities, prioritise accounts and manage pipeline health.
Able to manage multiple accounts, responsibilities and deadlines effectively.
Collaboration and Customer Advocacy
Works effectively with internal teams such as Support, Implementation, Sales, Marketing and Product to resolve issues and provide a seamless customer experience.
Communicates customer feedback, concerns and insights effectively to the relevant internal stakeholders.
Advocates for customers while balancing their needs with the company's commercial objectives.
Contributes positively to cross-functional teamwork and information sharing.

Customer-focused and service-orientated while remaining comfortable with commercial targets.
Proactive and self-driven, taking full ownership of the assigned customer portfolio.
Does not wait to be prompted before contacting customers or addressing potential concerns.
A clear and professional verbal and written communicator with strong interpersonal skills.

Resilient and adaptable, with the ability to manage difficult conversations, objections and changing customer requirements.
Accountable, dependable and committed to delivering consistent results.
Commercially aware and able to identify opportunities that benefit both the customer and the company.

Department:

GM: Network Systems
Job purpose:
Our client is seeking a Senior 5G Systems Engineer to lead the deployment, integration, and operational
support of Private 5G Standalone (5G SA) enterprise solutions. Positioned at the entry to mid-range of
their Senior engineering track, this hands-on role bridges Linux systems engineering, enterprise
networking, and 5G cellular core architecture.
You will be responsible for taking Private 5G networks from initial deployment to steady-state operations,
performing deep-stack troubleshooting—from the underlying Linux OS and transport layer up through the
gNodeB and 5G SA Core services.
Critical outputs:
Deployment and Integration
: Install, configure, and commission Private 5G SA Core and RAN components across customer sites and edge environments.
Full-stack troubleshooting
: Diagnose complex, end-to-end performance issues across the entire stack—from Linux kernel/OS networking parameters, IP routes, and firewall rules up to gNB connectivity, 5G SA Control Plane protocols (NGAP, NAS), and User Plane performance (UPF).
Systems administration
: Manage and optimize Linux-based hardware and virtualized runtime environments supporting 5G network functions (including containerized/K8s or virtualized deployments).
L2/L3 network configuration
: Configure, maintain, and support Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking infrastructure, VLANs, routing protocols, VPNs, and enterprise security integrations (firewalls/NAT) tied to the 5G transport network.
Operations and support:
Provide tier-3 escalation support for private cellular installations, ensuring maximum network uptime, strict SLA adherence, and prompt issue resolution.
Documentation and handoff
: Maintain accurate topology diagrams, configuration archives, deployment scripts, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for site installations.
Minimum requirements:
Must-haves:
Experience:
5+ years of hands-on experience supporting and maintaining systems within a mobile/telecom environment, with direct exposure to 5G Standalone (5G SA) architecture.
Linux systems engineering
: Proficiency in Linux OS administration (Ubuntu/Debian, RHEL/CentOS), including system diagnostics, shell scripting, process management, and networking configuration (iproute2, iptables/nftables, systemd).
L2/L3 enterprise networking
: Strong foundational understanding of switching, routing (OSPF, BGP, static), VLANs, Subnetting, IPsec/VPNs, TCP/IP, and packet analysis using tools like Wireshark or tcpdump.
5G SA domain knowledge
: Practical familiarity with 5G SA core network elements (AMF, SMF, UPF, NRF), RAN interfaces (N1, N2, N3), and session management workflows.
Education:
Grade 12 / Matric Certificate.
Mobility:
Own reliable transport and a valid driver’s license (required for potential customer site visits and deployments).
Advantageous / nice-to-haves:
Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes/K8s) or cloud-native infrastructure platforms (OpenShift, MicroK8s, AWS EKS).
Exposure to Private Wireless/Enterprise LTE/5G vendor hardware and software solutions (e.g., Celona, Druid Software, Aarna, Athonet, Ericsson, Nokia).
Vendor or industry certifications (e.g., CCNA/CCNP, Linux Foundation CKA/LFCS, or cellular-specific training).
Technical and personal attributes:
Methodical troubleshooting:
A structured, analytical approach to isolating network vs. OS vs. application layer faults.
Self-starter:
Ability to drive field deployments and resolve production outages with minimal supervision.
Clear communicator
: Strong technical writing and verbal communication skills for interfacing with client IT teams and internal engineering leads.

Compliance & Certification Management -
Lead and coordinate all activities associated with:
SOC 2 Type II Compliance and Audits
CMMC Level 2 Certification and Maintenance
ISO/IEC 27001 Certification, Surveillance Audits, and Continuous Improvement

Coordinate internal and external assessments, audits, and certification engagements.

Participate in customer security discussions and explain the organization's security and compliance posture.
Support contract reviews involving Cybersecurity requirements and obligations.

Facilitate periodic Cybersecurity risk assessments across business processes, systems, applications, cloud environments, and third-party vendors.
Identify, assess, document, and prioritize Cybersecurity risks using established risk methodologies.
Develop and maintain risk scoring frameworks and risk treatment processes.
Coordinate with risk owners to establish mitigation strategies, compensating controls, and remediation plans.
Track remediation activities and monitor residual risk levels.

Coordinate annual policy reviews and control effectiveness assessments.

Promote continuous improvement of Governance, Compliance, and Risk Management practices.

Bachelor's Degree in Information Security, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Risk Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline is preferred. An equivalent combination of education, professional certification, and relevant experience may be considered.

SOC 2
ISO/IEC 27001
CMMC
NIST 800-171
Internal or external audits.
Security certification programs.
Experience managing compliance documentation, evidence collection, and audit coordination.
Experience conducting risk assessments and maintaining risk registers.
Experience responding to customer Cybersecurity questionnaires and security assessments.
Proficient with Microsoft 365 productivity and collaboration tools, including Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.
Comfortable with governance, risk, compliance, policy management, reporting, and documentation platforms.
Able to read and interpret business cases, project plans, risk reports, policies, procedures, training materials, and audit documentation.
Able to prepare clear written summaries.

Collaborate with production, quality, supply chain, and procurement teams, and engage with external suppliers, contractors, and regulatory bodies

About the position
Our client, a leading pharmaceutical company is looking for a Responsible Pharmacist to join their team in Midrand.
Job Purpose
To fulfil the statutory and professional responsibilities of the Responsible Pharmacist as appointed by the Site Manager for the licensed pharmaceutical facility and to provide independent oversight of activities thereby safeguarding medicine safety, quality and efficacy, medicines control, licence compliance and regulatory compliance.
The role is responsible for ensuring compliance with the Pharmacy Act, Medicines and Related Substances Act, SAPC requirements, SAHPRA requirements and applicable GMP & GPP standards, and for escalating significant regulatory and compliance risks through the appropriate governance structures.
The Responsible Pharmacist is accountable for ensuring that the licensed pharmaceutical facility operates in compliance with the Pharmacy Act, Medicines and Related Substances Act, SAPC requirements, SAHPRA licence conditions and applicable GMP & GPP requirements.
The Responsible Pharmacist is responsible for maintaining oversight of medicines and scheduled substance control, product release and rejection activities where appropriately delegated, licence compliance, supervision of pharmacists and personnel performing functions requiring pharmacist oversight, and the implementation of controls necessary to ensure the lawful and compliant operation of the pharmaceutical facility.
The Responsible Pharmacist serves as the primary liaison with SAPC, SAHPRA and other regulatory authorities on matters relating to pharmacy practice, licence compliance, medicines control, inspections, regulatory commitments and reportable events within the scope of the Responsible Pharmacist role.
The role has the authority to challenge, stop, reject or escalate activities that may adversely affect product quality, patient safety, medicines control or regulatory compliance.

About the position
South African Sugarcane Research Institute (SASRI), a division of the South African Sugar Association (SASA), is seeking to appoint a Research Farm Manager: Pongola Research Station on a permanent basis. The position will be based at SASRI's Breeding and Field Resource Unit (BFRU) in Pongola.
Pongola is SASRI's largest research station, and much of the work done there shapes the future of irrigated sugarcane in South Africa. It is home to our irrigated plant breeding programme, as well as smut, ripener and tawny rust trials and the evaluation of international varieties. Growers in Pongola, Komati and Malelane depend on the new varieties that come out of this work.
We are looking for an experienced Farm Manager who knows irrigation inside out and can give our researchers the well-run, well-watered station their trials depend on.
About the role
The Research Farm Manager runs the day-to-day operation of the station. The job is to create the best possible conditions for field experiments, run the station as a productive commercial unit, and look after the land for the long term. You will lead a team of about 61 people (39 permanent and 22 seasonal), supported by an Assistant Farm Manager, and report to the Research Stations' Manager.
Irrigation: central to this role
At Pongola, research simply doesn't work without reliable irrigation. You will be fully responsible for the station's irrigation system. That includes:
Planning and running irrigation schedules that meet the needs of each trial and the commercial crop.
Understanding how the system works, from pumps and mainlines to in-field infrastructure, so that faults are spotted early and fixed properly.
Setting up and managing a preventative maintenance programme for all irrigation infrastructure to avoid damage, water loss and downtime.
Managing water use responsibly and cost-effectively.
What else you'll be doing
Drawing up and carrying out long-term plans so that conditions suit research trials, from land preparation and planting through to cane husbandry and harvesting.
Following breeders' and researchers' instructions accurately and arranging the resources needed to establish their trials.
Allocating staff, equipment and inputs cost-effectively, in line with research priorities.
Keeping all farm assets in good repair through regular servicing and preventative maintenance.
Maintaining strict soil conservation practices in line with SUSFARMS principles and other industry standards.
Running the station as a commercial unit, recovering cane efficiently and delivering it to the mill once research needs have been met.
Preparing and managing the station budget and providing monthly variance notes.
Chairing bi-monthly meetings with Shop Stewards of the recognised trade union, reporting back at quarterly meetings, and taking part in annual wage negotiations.
Building good relationships with staff, neighbouring farms, suppliers, growers and other industry stakeholders.
Implementing and complying with all Health and Safety regulations.
What you'll need
A Diploma or BSc in Agriculture.
Proven, hands-on experience managing irrigation systems, including scheduling, maintenance and troubleshooting. A minimum of 3 seasons experience.
Experience supervising farm staff and operations, preferably including at least 18 months at management level.
Sound crop management experience.
Good mechanical knowledge.
A valid driver's licence.
It would be a plus if you have
A Senior Certificate in Sugarcane Agriculture.
Experience growing sugarcane under irrigation.
Experience in budgeting and labour relations.
Working conditions
On-site accommodation is provided for the successful candidate and their family. The role requires working farm hours (6 am to 3 pm), after-hours and weekend work when needed, and standby duty every second weekend.

descriptions.title: Data Engineer
descriptions.description:
Duties & Responsibilities

We are seeking a Data Engineer to join our team based in Cape Town, this is a contracting role and onsite.
The Data Engineer will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the data infrastructure necessary for our Insights team to analyze data and derive valuable insights. The Data Engineer will work with Engineering Leads, Data Architects and other stakeholders to ensure that our data is properly sourced, stored, and accessible for analysis. They will also contribute to our mission by extracting maximum predictive value from data assets.
Responsibilities
Data Pipeline Development and Management
Design, develop, test and maintain data pipelines to extract, transform, and load (ETL) data from various sources into a data warehouse or data lake
Implement data quality and validation checks to ensure that data is accurate, complete and consistent.
Optimize and scale data processing and storage to handle large volumes of data and high concurrency.
Troubleshoot and resolve data pipeline issues and perform root cause analysis
Develop and maintain documentation for data pipelines and processes.
ETL Development
Building and maintaining data pipelines using lakehouse architecture (medallion)
Extracting data from multiple sources, transforming it, and loading it into the target database
Monitoring and troubleshooting ETL jobs to ensure they complete successfully and on time.
Data Modelling and Design
Design and implement data models and database schemas for storing and querying data.
Optimize database schema and indexing for efficient data retrieval
Modernise legacy data environments, migrating from on-premises solutions to cloud-native platforms such as Databricks
Ensure database security, availability, and scalability
Perform database tuning and optimization to improve query performance
Develop and maintain data connectors and integrations with various data sources (e.g., databases, APIs, flat files)
Implement data streaming and real-time data processing technologies.
Reporting And Analytics
Designing and implementing complex reports that meet business requirements
Developing dashboards and visualizations using tools like Pyramid or other data visualization tools
Develop and maintain BI reports and dashboards
Analysing data to identify trends, patterns, and insights
Providing insights to business stakeholders based on the analysis of data
Data Governance and Security
Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations according the Data privacy policies.
Develop and maintain data governance policies, procedures, and standards
Ensure that data access and authorization policies are in place and adhered to
Monitor and audit data access to ensure data security and prevent data breaches
Implement disaster recovery and business continuity plans for data infrastructure
Collaboration and Communication
Work collaboratively with Engineering Leads, Architects, Analysts, Scrum Masters and other stakeholders to understand data requirements and provide data solutions.
Communicate data pipeline issues, status, and progress to stakeholders and project teams.
Participate in cross-functional meetings and initiatives to ensure alignment with data strategies and goals
Qualifications
Must have at least 3 years of relevant IT experience or related qualification.
3+ years experience with Data pipeline design and development experience.
Proficiency in Python and/or SQL.
RDBMS experience in technology such as SQL Server, MySQL and PostgreSQL.
Ability to use common scripting languages such as Powershell, Bash, or Python for automation.
Experience using unit and integration tests.
Experience working with production BI environments and tools such as PowerBI, Tableau or Pyramid Analytics.
Strong analytical/problem solving skills.
Skills
Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate certification.
Experience in Azure data technologies; a relevant Azure certification would be advantageous
Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD practices, Docker and containerization
Exposure to .net entity framework.
Exposure to Databricks, Delta Lake and PySpark.
Experience with data streaming or distributed processing technologies such as Kafka or Hadoop.
Experience delivering data projects in Retail, Finance, Customer or HR domains would be advantageous
Experience mentoring junior engineers would be advantageous
Behaviours
Manages Complexity - interprets and simplifies complex and contradictory information when resolving organisational problems
Strategic Mindset - thinks and plans strategically, focusing on the long-term goals and objectives of the organisation
Tech Savvy - leverages new technology to enhance productivity, improve problem solving, and support business growth
Cultivates Innovation - creates an environment that fosters and nurtures a culture of creativity which drives success
Drives Engagement - inspires, motivates and empowers individuals to go above and beyond for the benefit of the team and the organisation

Desired Experience & Qualification

Data, Engineer, ETL, SQL, Python, Lakehouse, Retail, Contract, Onsite, Cape Town

descriptions.title: Data & AI Engineer (JHB Hybrid)
descriptions.description:
DataFin was established in 1999. We pride ourselves on the fact that we have established relationships with industry leaders and a vast majority of our business is repeat business.

Duties & Responsibilities

ENVIRONMENT:
A provider of tailored Financial Solutions seeks a Data & AI Engineer to build, maintain, and improve reliable pipelines and curated datasets that feed the company’s analytics, reporting, and AI workloads, and you will help run the governed in-house AI platform that sits on top of them. This is one combined role, not a Data Engineer with an AI paragraph bolted on. Data flows from SQL Server and Azure SQL sources into Fabric, through bronze, silver, and gold layers, and out to the semantic, reporting, and AI consumption layers the business depends on. Expect the work to sit at roughly two-thirds Data Engineering and one-third applied AI in the first year, shifting further towards AI as adoption grows. Both halves run inside the same established standards, which cover metadata-driven, incremental, idempotent ELT, source control, gated deployment, and human review of anything AI-generated. You will grow into full ownership of production data and AI assets end-to-end: build it, document it, support it.
DUTIES:
Data Engineering: Governed pipelines and the estate -
Develop and maintain batch and incremental ELT pipelines that ingest, transform, and deliver trusted datasets across our SQL Server / Azure SQL / Microsoft Fabric estate.
Write and optimise T-SQL transformation logic, stored procedures, views, and reconciliation queries, following our standards (CTEs over subqueries, idempotent and metadata-driven patterns).
Build and maintain Fabric pipelines, Dataflow Gen2 flows, and Lakehouse / Warehouse data assets.
Support data modelling: dimensional models, medallion (bronze / silver / gold) layer design, partitioning, and performance optimisation for analytics workloads.
Operate the estate: orchestration, scheduling, monitoring, logging, alerting, and methodical incident resolution for data jobs and platform processes.
Implement data validation, reconciliation, row-count and parity checks so reporting outputs can be trusted and prove it with evidence.
Applied AI: The governed AI platform -
Build and maintain the curated, documented datasets, retrieval indexes, and interfaces that governed AI platform and AI-assisted use cases consume.
Help run the in-house AI platform: content ingestion, indexing, configuration, access control, and routine health checks.
Develop Python automation for AI workloads, covering data preparation, embedding and indexing jobs, evaluation harnesses, and approved API integrations.
Build and evaluate AI use cases such as search, summarisation, classification, extraction, and workflow automation, measuring each against defined success criteria with human-review checkpoints built in.
Enforce data minimisation and anonymisation on every AI path: no personal information, credentials, or production data into unapproved tools, and no uncontrolled egress of data.
Record AI evaluation evidence, including what was tested, what the model produced, what a human reviewer changed, and why, so that AI-assisted output stays traceable and auditable.
Shared: Governance, delivery, and documentation -
Work the governed delivery flow: Git / Azure DevOps source control, feature branches, peer-reviewed pull requests, and gated environment promotion (Dev → UAT → production).
Produce and maintain documentation: pipeline design notes, source-to-target mappings, runbooks, AI use-case and configuration notes, and support procedures.
Collaborate with Analysts, the Head of Data & AI, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into governed, supportable data assets, without business logic drifting into unmanaged reports.
What you’ll work with –
Azure SQL and on-premises SQL Server, which form the core transactional and reporting estate.
The wider Fabric surface, including mirroring and CDC ingestion, deployment pipelines, and capacity management.
Python for transformation, automation, and tooling; DAX exposure on the BI side.
Azure DevOps for repos, boards, CI/CD pipelines, and gated deployments.
Power BI and SSRS as the consumption layer you feed.
The governed in-house AI platform, which covers agent tooling, retrieval and indexing, and the controls that make it safe to use on sensitive data. You will help run it, not just use it.
AI-assisted engineering under policy, meaning sanitised inputs, human review of generated code, and traceable output. It is how the whole team works, and how you will work too.
Evaluation and human-review workflows, which are how we decide whether an AI output is good enough to use and how that decision is evidenced.
REQUIREMENTS:
Minimum 1-year hands-on experience in Data Engineering, ETL / ELT, analytics engineering, database development, applied AI, or a closely related production-oriented role.
Solid SQL Server and T-SQL. You should be confident with joins, aggregations, CTEs, and multi-step transformation logic, and able to debug and reason about query performance.
Demonstrable Microsoft Fabric experience. You have built, supported, or substantially prototyped at least one of the following: a Fabric pipeline, a Lakehouse or Warehouse solution, a Dataflow Gen2 flow, or a Fabric notebook. Work, internship, or serious project evidence all count.
Understanding of data warehousing and pipeline design concepts (staging, incremental loads, dimensional modelling).
Working Python. You can read, write, and modify scripts for data preparation, automation, and integration, because the AI half of the role runs on it.
Practical, sceptical familiarity with modern AI tooling. You have used LLM or AI-assisted tools on real work and can explain where they got things wrong, not just that they were useful. No formal Machine-Learning or Data-Science background is required.
Familiarity with source control (Git or similar) and structured, reviewed ways of releasing changes.
Genuine care for data quality, security, least privilege, and confidentiality, including the discipline never to put sensitive data into an unapproved tool.
Advantageous –
Python or PySpark depth for data transformation at scale.
Dataflow Gen2, mirroring / CDC, and Fabric deployment pipelines.
Power BI semantic model and DirectLake awareness; SSRS report development.
Experience with APIs, file feeds, or enterprise source systems.
Retrieval-augmented generation, vector or semantic search, and embedding concepts.
Azure AI services, prompt and evaluation frameworks, agent tooling, or MLOps exposure.
DP-700 (Fabric Data Engineer Associate) or another relevant Microsoft certification. These are valued rather than required and are achievable after appointment.
Relevant qualification (Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related) or equivalent practical experience.
Experience in a regulated financial-services or similarly controlled environment.
ATTRIBUTES:
You want to learn, so you ask good questions, absorb feedback, and close the loop.
You verify before you trust, and that includes AI output above all.
You take ownership end-to-end: build it, document it, support it.
You have a quality mindset, so you check your work and raise issues early rather than hoping.
You are comfortable with sensitive data and disciplined governance; process is a feature to you, not friction.
You keep composure in a delivery-focused environment and communicate honestly about progress and blockers.
Integrity and values, with the ability to handle sensitive and confidential information.
Attention to detail and a results-driven quality mindset.
Strong problem-solving; composure in a fast-moving, dynamic environment.
Works well in a team and independently; communicates openly.
Growth mindset, actively wanting to learn and develop

Desired Experience & Qualification

descriptions.title: Data Engineer (FMCG / Food / Retail industry experience)
descriptions.description:
Reference: CPT002358-CW-1
The Data Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, maintaining and improving the organisation's data infrastructure and data pipelines to ensure that accurate, reliable and accessible data is available for reporting, analytics and business decision-making.
The role supports the Business Transformation function by integrating data from multiple operational systems and creating scalable, automated data solutions that enable the organisation to better understand and improve its Retail, Logistics, B2B Sales, Finance, Merchandising, Supply Chain and other business operations.
The Data Engineer works closely with Enterprise Architecture, Data Insights, IT, Business Process Management and functional business teams to ensure that data is effectively captured, integrated, structured, governed and made available for business use.

Duties & Responsibilities

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Data Integration & Pipeline Development
Design, develop and maintain reliable ETL/ELT data pipelines across multiple business systems.
Integrate data from systems such as ERP, TMS, WMS, finance, CRM, supply chain, HR and other business applications.
Reduce reliance on manual data extraction and manipulation through effective automation.
Ensure data pipelines are scalable, efficient and appropriate for the organisation's future data requirements.
Work closely with Data & Systems Architecture to ensure engineering solutions align with broader technology and architecture standards.
Data Quality, Integrity & Reliability
Implement automated data-quality checks and validation controls.
Assist with the implementation of MDM across the organisation.
Identify and investigate inconsistencies, missing data, duplication and other data-quality issues.
Work with system owners and business stakeholders to address root causes of data-quality problems.
Monitor data pipelines and integration processes to identify failures or performance issues.
Troubleshoot and resolve data-processing and integration errors.
Ensure that data used for reporting and analysis is accurate, complete, consistent and available when required.
Support the development of a trusted organisational data environment.
Analytics & Business Intelligence Enablement
Develop and maintain analysis-ready datasets for Data Analysts, Analyst Developers and other authorised business users.
Support the development of reliable data models for dashboards, management reporting and business intelligence solutions.
Assist analysts with complex data extraction, transformation and integration requirements.
Ensure that commonly used business information is sourced from controlled and consistent datasets.
Enable greater self-service, democratized analytics through well-structured and governed data.
The Data Engineer's primary responsibility is to build and maintain the data foundation rather than own business reporting or interpretation of business performance.
Automation & Continuous Improvement
Review existing data flows and recommend improvements.
Optimise database queries, pipelines and processing routines to improve performance.
Proactively identify opportunities where improved data integration can simplify business processes.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within Business Transformation.
Migrate data warehouse, data lake or similar data structures where applicable.
Business Transformation & Systems Projects
Participate in business transformation, systems implementation and process-improvement projects.
Assess data requirements when new systems, processes or technologies are introduced.
Support data migration, cleansing, mapping and validation during system implementations.
Work with Business Process Management to understand how information moves through business processes and identify opportunities for improved automation.
Provide technical data expertise during solution design and project implementation.
Support testing and implementation of new data solutions.
Assist with post-implementation troubleshooting and optimisation.
Data Governance, Security & Compliance
Apply organisational data governance standards across data engineering solutions.
Ensure appropriate access controls are implemented for sensitive and confidential information.
Work with IT and relevant stakeholders to ensure data solutions comply with information-security requirements such as POPIA and ISO27001.
Maintain appropriate controls around the extraction, transfer, storage and use of organisational data.
Support the establishment and maintenance of data stewardship, definitions and governance practices.
Documentation & Technical Support
Maintain accurate technical documentation for data pipelines, integrations and data structures.
Develop and maintain data-flow diagrams, integration specifications and data dictionaries where appropriate.
Maintain appropriate change records for data solutions.
Provide technical support and troubleshooting for data-related issues.
Ensure that critical data processes are sufficiently documented to reduce dependency on individual knowledge.
Artificial Intelligence & Agentic Capability
The Data Engineer is expected to be a user, implementer and support resource for the organisation's artificial-intelligence and agent-assisted capabilities, applying them to data engineering, data quality and business-process outcomes within approved governance and security controls.
Use AI-assisted and agentic development tooling in day-to-day engineering work — pipeline and integration development, code generation and review, test creation, documentation and troubleshooting — and validate all generated code, SQL and configuration before it reaches a governed environment.
Apply AI and machine-assisted techniques to business-process analysis, ETL/ELT development and data-quality optimisation, including anomaly detection, record matching and de-duplication, classification and rule suggestion, with human review before production use.
Build and maintain the semantic and metadata foundations that make organisational data usable by AI and agent-based tools — business glossaries, data dictionaries, ontologies and taxonomies, and governed data-product contracts — so that natural-language questions return consistent, explainable and permission-aware answers.
Support the implementation of AI-enabled platform capabilities together with Data & Systems Architecture and external technology partners, including configuration, integration, testing, user enablement and post-implementation optimisation.
Apply AI within the organisation's data-protection and information-security requirements: confidential, personal or business-sensitive data may only be processed by approved AI services, consistent with the governance requirements in 2.6.
Understanding of code harnesses and agentic coding tools, large language model behaviour, prompt engineering and retrieval-based approaches will be favourable.
KEY PERFORMANCE AREAS (KPA’S):
CORE COMPETENCIES:
Analytical Thinking
Able to understand complex data structures, identify relationships and systematically resolve data problems.
Problem Solving
Approaches technical and data-related challenges logically and focuses on identifying sustainable solutions rather than temporary fixes.
Attention to Detail
Maintains a high level of accuracy when working with large datasets, integrations and business-critical information.
Business Understanding
Develops an understanding of how the business operates and ensures technical data solutions support practical business requirements.
Collaboration
Works effectively across technical and non-technical teams and is able to translate business requirements into appropriate data solutions.
Ownership
Takes accountability for the reliability, quality and performance of assigned data solutions.
Continuous Learning
Keeps abreast of developments in data engineering, cloud technology, automation and analytics.
Communication
Able to explain technical concepts clearly to stakeholders with different levels of technical knowledge.
Futuristic and Open Mindset
Ability to rapidly change and pivot
QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE:
A relevant tertiary qualification in one of the following or a related field: Computer Science / Information Systems / Information Technology / Data Engineering / Software Engineering
Relevant industry certifications in data engineering, cloud platforms or database technologies would be advantageous.
Experience
Approximately
5-7 years' relevant experience
in data engineering, database development, systems integration or a similar technical data role. At least two of these years should include systems or data integration, or the exchange of data between internal and external systems.
Experience developing and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines.
Proven experience in developing data projects using Python.
Strong practical experience working with SQL and relational databases.
Experience with data modelling and data warehouse concepts.
Experience working in a BI, analytics or reporting environment.
Experience designing, building or consuming API-based integrations (REST/JSON), including authentication, pagination, error handling, retry and idempotency behaviour.
Experience with file-based and batch integration to and from external parties, including scheduled transfers, secure file transfer (SFTP), and file validation, quarantine and reconciliation.
Experience publishing or consuming versioned, governed datasets or data products for downstream and third-party consumers, including schema change management and backward compatibility.
Experience delivering data or integration artefacts through source control (Git) and promoting them across development, test and production environments.
Experience monitoring and supporting production integrations, including failure detection, error triage, reprocessing or replay of failed records, and root-cause resolution.
Experience in a multi-site Retail, FMCG, Wholesale, Logistics or Supply Chain environment would be advantageous.
Experience supporting system implementations or business-transformation projects would be advantageous.
Experience with event- or message-driven integration (webhooks, publish/subscribe or streaming platforms such as Kafka), including at-least-once delivery, idempotency, replay and dead-letter handling, would be advantageous.
Experience with an integration or middleware runtime — for example Apache Camel, Azure Integration Services, Boomi, MuleSoft or a comparable iPaaS/ESB — would be advantageous.
Experience with master data management, data cataloguing or business glossary tooling would be advantageous.
Experience exchanging data with external trading partners, suppliers or service providers under defined data-sharing, security and privacy controls would be advantageous.

DevOps or automated deployment practices — including environment promotion across development, test and production
Microsoft 365 & Co-Pilot
Data integration patterns: batch, file-based, API-based and event-driven integration; incremental loads and change data capture; source-to-target reconciliation.
API and data-contract concepts: interface specifications (OpenAPI/Swagger), schema definition, versioning and backward compatibility.
Secure file transfer (SFTP) and structured file handling (CSV, fixed-width, JSON, XML).
Credential, key and secret management, and least-privilege access to data and integration endpoints.
Integration and pipeline observability: logging, monitoring, alerting, error handling, retry, dead-letter and replay.
Master data management, data cataloguing and metadata concepts, including business glossaries, data dictionaries and lineage.

Microsoft Foundry

Pascal Script
OData 4.01 and other standards-based data-access protocols
Containerisation and orchestration fundamentals (Docker, Kubernetes)

Observability tooling and standards (for example OpenTelemetry)
EDI and trading-partner exchange formats used in Retail, FMCG and Logistics
Ontology, taxonomy and semantic-layer modelling concepts

Introduction

The Data Analyst – Data Migration & Data Quality will be responsible for the analysis, cleansing, manipulation, transformation, standardisation and validation of data received from DMPR regional offices to ensure that data is complete, accurate, consistent and conforms to the approved data structures, templates and business rules required for migration into the new Mining Licence/Cadastre System.
The position will work closely with the Project Team, Regional Data Capturers, GIS Specialists, Database Administrators and DMPR business representatives to ensure that regional data is converted into validated, migration-ready datasets.
The role is critical to ensuring that poor-quality, incomplete, or incorrectly formatted legacy data does not compromise the migration, implementation, and operation of the new system.

Duties & Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities:
Data Assessment and Profiling:
Receive and assess data submitted by the different DMPR regions.
Profile datasets to identify Missing or incomplete information, Duplicate records ,Incorrect or inconsistent values, Invalid data types, Incorrect dates and formats, Inconsistent naming conventions, Incorrect or incomplete identifiers, and missing relationships between records.
Analyse the quality and completeness of each regional dataset.
Produce data quality reports identifying issues requiring remediation.
Maintain a record of data received, data processed, and data outstanding per region.
Data Validation & Pre-migration Preparation:
Perform pre-migration validation of all datasets.
Clean and manipulate source data to conform to the approved migration requirements.
Validate data against approved business and technical rules.
Conduct completeness, accuracy, consistency, uniqueness, and validity checks.
Validate mandatory fields and accepted values.
Perform cross-field and cross-record validation where required.
Identify records that fail validation and return them for correction where necessary.
Support post-migration validation and reconciliation of migrated records.
Remove duplicate records in accordance with approved business rules.
Standardise names, codes, statuses, dates, identifiers and other relevant fields.
Identify and resolve incomplete or incorrectly captured information.
Perform data transformations required to align legacy data with the new system's data model.
Apply approved business rules to determine how legacy values should be represented in the new system.
Maintain an audit trail of significant data manipulation and transformation activities.
Migration Template Management:
Ensure that all regional data is captured in the approved migration templates.
Ensure that mandatory fields are populated before datasets are submitted for migration.
Ensure that field names, formats, data types, codes, and values comply with the approved migration specifications.
Identify fields requiring transformation before migration.
Maintain and update data mapping documentation.
Ensure that revised templates and migration specifications are consistently applied across all regions.
Data Quality Reporting:
Develop and maintain regular data-quality reports showing:
Number of records received, processed, and records successfully validated.
Number of records rejected & Number of records requiring correction.
Number of outstanding records.
Number and type of data-quality errors.
Migration readiness by region.

Bachelor’s Degree/National Diploma in IT, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Statistics, Informatics or related field.
3–5 years’ experience in data analysis, data cleansing, manipulation and migration.
Strong Advanced Excel and SQL skills.
Experience in data validation, standardisation, transformation and reconciliation.
Experience preparing large datasets for system implementation/migration.

Advanced Excel, SQL.

descriptions.title: ADVANCED EXCEL EXPERT & DATA ANALYST WANTED!
descriptions.description:
Introduction

Boksburg | Full-Time Position
Do spreadsheets excite you? Can you turn raw data into accurate reports, meaningful graphs and easy-to-understand dashboards? Do you know Microsoft Excel like the back of your hand?
If formulas, figures, systems and statistics are your strengths, INTRO REAL ESTATE wants to hear from you!
ABOUT INTRO REAL ESTATE
Established in 1982, INTRO REAL ESTATE is an award-winning residential property agency with more than 40 years of experience. We are proud to be a trusted market leader serving Benoni, Boksburg, Kempton Park and Edenvale.
Our success is driven by a passionate, professional and high-performing team—and we are looking for an exceptional Sales Data Analyst and Administrator to join us.
THIS IS MORE THAN A DATA-CAPTURING POSITION
You will play an important role in keeping our sales information accurate, current and meaningful. You will work with multiple spreadsheets, databases, reports, applications and team members to convert daily activity into reliable statistics that assist management with tracking performance and making informed business decisions.
If you enjoy working with numbers, identifying discrepancies, improving spreadsheets and creating order from large volumes of information, you could be exactly who we are looking for.

Duties & Responsibilities

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Capture, update, verify and analyse daily, weekly and monthly sales statistics.
Maintain advanced Excel spreadsheets, formulas, graphs, reports and performance dashboards.
Compile statistics relating to agent performance.
Calculate and monitor averages, percentages, trends and performance ratios.
Reconcile information across different spreadsheets, databases, reports and applications.
Identify missing, duplicated or inconsistent data and ensure that errors are corrected promptly.
Extract, import and organise data from property systems and databases.
Prepare accurate month-end reports, graphs and supporting documentation.
Maintain structured digital records and complete regular backups.
Liaise patiently and professionally with management, consultants and administrative staff.
Manage multiple recurring deadlines without compromising accuracy.
ADVANCED EXCEL EXPERTISE IS NON-NEGOTIABLE
Applicants must be genuinely confident working with:
Advanced formulas and nested formulas
IF, IFS, SUMIF/SUMIFS and COUNTIF/COUNTIFS
XLOOKUP, VLOOKUP and INDEX/MATCH
PivotTables and PivotCharts
Graphs, dashboards and statistical reports
Sorting, filtering and managing large datasets
Conditional formatting and data validation
Percentages, averages, ratios and trend analysis
Linking and reconciling information across multiple worksheets
Importing, cleaning and checking data
Troubleshooting and correcting spreadsheet errors
Experience with Power Query, macros, automation, database applications, reporting tools or integrations between different applications will be a strong advantage.
Please do not apply if your Excel experience is limited to basic data entry, formatting or simple calculations.
Shortlisted applicants will be required to complete a practical Excel competency assessment.

Desired Experience & Qualification

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
You are:
Highly analytical and naturally comfortable with figures and statistics
Exceptionally accurate, fast and detail-orientated
Tech-savvy and confident learning new applications and systems
Organised and able to manage several projects and deadlines simultaneously
A proactive problem-solver who uses initiative
Reliable, conscientious and accountable
Cool, calm and collected under pressure
Patient when assisting and following up with multiple team members
A clear and professional communicator
A committed team player with a positive attitude
Passionate about improving processes and producing excellent work
Professionally presented
MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS
Proven advanced Microsoft Excel skills—non-negotiable
Strong Microsoft Word and general computer skills
Previous experience in data analysis, statistical reporting, data capturing, sales administration or a similar office-based role
Strong administrative and organisational abilities
Experience working with databases and extracting relevant information
Excellent written and spoken English
Accurate typing and data-capturing skills
Professional telephone manner and client-relations experience
Valid driver’s licence and own reliable vehicle—non-negotiable
Willingness to work one Saturday half-day per month

Interested?

descriptions.description:
Introduction

We are seeking an experienced
Senior Data Analyst
to join a strategic ERP transformation programme within the financial services environment.
The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting the end-to-end data analysis lifecycle, with a strong focus on
data discovery, profiling, quality, information management and business process analysis
. The role will contribute to business process re-engineering and the implementation of a modern financial planning and reporting solution.
The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in
Business Analysis and Information Management
, strong analytical and facilitation skills, and the ability to translate complex business and data requirements into practical, well-documented solutions.
This is an
18-month contract opportunity
for a highly experienced professional who can operate effectively in a complex, enterprise environment and work collaboratively with business, technology and data stakeholders.

Duties & Responsibilities

Conduct data discovery activities to identify and document relevant data assets within defined business processes and data domains.
Analyse data assets in the context of business value drivers, business processes and data products.
Conduct data profiling to assess:
Data sensitivity
Data quality
Data context and usage
Data ownership and handling requirements
Relevant legislative and regulatory considerations
Establish relationships and dependencies between data elements and assess their impact on business processes and outcomes.

Agile methodology
.

data discovery and data profiling
.

Data Management certification, such as

financial services, banking or other highly regulated environments
.

ERP transformation or implementation programmes

descriptions.title: Business Intelligence & Insights Manager
descriptions.description:
Turn data into direction. Transform insights into impact.

We’re looking for a commercially minded and experienced
Business Intelligence & Insights Manager
to lead our insights function in Durban.
In this role, you’ll lead a team of BI and Insights professionals, partnering with senior stakeholders to transform complex data into actionable recommendations that improve customer experience, operational performance and business results.
This is an opportunity to move beyond traditional reporting and build a proactive insights function that influences decisions, identifies improvement opportunities and delivers measurable business value within a large-scale customer operations environment.
Location:
Durban, KwaZulu-Natal
Employment type:
Permanent

What you will do in this role

Drive strategic insights:
Develop the BI and Insights roadmap, aligning analytical initiatives with business priorities and commercial objectives.
Turn data into action:
Lead root cause analysis, trend analysis, forecasting and performance diagnostics to identify opportunities to improve productivity, quality, customer experience and financial performance.
Oversee reporting and analytics:
Guide the development of dashboards, KPI frameworks and automated reporting solutions using Power BI, SQL, Excel and Power Query.
Lead and develop your team:
Coach and mentor BI and Insights professionals, build analytical capability and establish best practices that promote quality, innovation and accountability.
Influence stakeholders:
Partner with Operations, Quality, Training, Workforce Management, Finance and client stakeholders to translate findings into clear recommendations and drive informed decisions.
Drive continuous improvement:
Improve data quality, reporting efficiency and dashboard adoption while exploring opportunities to leverage automation, AI and emerging analytics technologies.

Your qualifications and experience

Essential requirements
Minimum
5 years’ progressive experience
in business intelligence, analytics, insights or a related field, including
1–2 years in a leadership role
.
Proven experience leading and developing analytical or insights teams.
Strong proficiency in
Power BI, SQL, Excel, Power Query and data visualisation
.
Experience in dashboard design, KPI development, data modelling, forecasting, trend analysis and root cause analysis.
Demonstrated ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations and measurable improvements.
Strong communication, storytelling and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders and explain complex findings to non-technical audiences.
Strong commercial acumen and experience connecting insights to operational and financial outcomes.
Knowledge of structured problem-solving methodologies such as Lean Six Sigma or DMAIC.
High proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
Advantageous
Experience in a contact centre, BPO, customer experience or similarly complex operational environment.
Familiarity with Python, R, predictive analytics or machine learning.
Exposure to data architecture, reporting automation, AI or low-code/no-code solutions.
Client-facing experience in a service-oriented environment.

What will make you successful?

Strategic thinking:
You look beyond the numbers to identify what is driving performance and what needs to change.
Business impact:
You turn insights into practical recommendations that deliver measurable results.
Leadership:
You build a capable, high-performing team and encourage continuous learning.
Influence:
You communicate clearly, challenge existing thinking and gain stakeholder buy-in.
Technical expertise:
You can guide analytical delivery while keeping business priorities at the centre.
What will success look like?
Within your first 6–12 months, you will be expected to establish a proactive insights function, improve reporting automation and dashboard adoption, strengthen team capability, and deliver actionable recommendations that drive measurable improvements in operational, customer and financial performance.

What’s in it for you?
