descriptions.title: BI Developer
descriptions.description:
Introduction

Amazing chance to join a Software Development company that develops software for the insurance industry. They are a medium size company that look after their staff and give recognition. They have been around for over 25 years and have an international footprint in London. They have a branch in London, Stellenbosch and Rosebank. They are extremely people orientated and offer a fun dynamic working environment.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Power BI Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the reporting and analytics solutions that turn platform data into insight for our clients, covering both new client implementations and the ongoing maintenance and enhancement of reporting for existing clients.
The role spans client-facing insurance reporting built on the platform (policy, premium, claims, and book-of-business analytics for insurers, MGAs, and brokers) as well as internal management information that supports decision-making across the company.
Reporting is delivered directly against the operational data model rather than a data warehouse. Dashboards are sourced from a dedicated non-production SQL Server reporting instance, where T-SQL stored procedures, views, and functions form a curated reporting layer that shapes, joins, and aggregates the data before it reaches Power BI. Strong T-SQL is therefore as important as strong Power BI in this role. The successful candidate will be equally comfortable writing and tuning set-based queries at the database and building the semantic models, DAX measures, and visualisations that sit on top of them.
Because dashboards are consumed by external clients as well as internal teams, controlling what each user can see is a core design responsibility rather than an afterthought. The Power BI Developer owns the access model behind every report: how users are authenticated, how client and tenant data is isolated, how row-level and object-level security are applied within the semantic model, and how workspace and app permissions govern distribution. Note that the gateway connects to the source SQL Server using a single least-privilege service account, so per-user entitlement cannot be enforced by database permissions and must be designed and proven within the semantic model.
Working closely with development, implementation, and business stakeholders, the Power BI Developer builds robust semantic models, well-crafted DAX measures, and performant, intuitive dashboards, ensuring that every report is accurate, secure, and trusted as a single source of truth.
KEY PERFORMANCE AREAS
1. Report & Dashboard Development
Design, develop, and maintain interactive Power BI reports, dashboards, and semantic models for both client-facing insurance reporting and internal management information. Translate business and client requirements into clear, intuitive visualisations that make complex insurance data easy to understand and act on.
2. SQL Development & the Reporting Data Layer
Write, optimise, and maintain the T-SQL stored procedures, views, and functions that supply the dashboards from the non-production SQL Server reporting instance. Push joins, aggregation, and business logic down to the database so that Power BI consumes clean, report-ready result sets, and maintain this reporting layer as a stable contract that insulates dashboards from change in the underlying platform schema.
3. Semantic Modelling & DAX Development
Build and maintain robust, reusable semantic models, shaping normalised operational data into report-friendly star schemas. Develop accurate, well-structured DAX measures to support analysis of policy, premium, claims, and operational data, and select the appropriate storage mode (Import, DirectQuery, or composite) for each requirement.
4. Data Access, Security & Authentication
Design, implement, and test the access model that determines what each user can see. This covers authentication and identity through Microsoft Entra ID or, where reports are embedded in the   platform, service principal authentication with embed tokens and an asserted effective identity. It also covers dynamic row-level security driven by an entitlement model that reflects insurance access hierarchies such as broker, agency, branch, class of business, and delegated authority; object-level security to conceal sensitive tables and columns such as commission terms or claimant personal data; and least-privilege credentials for the gateway service account. Access control must be demonstrably tested before every release, not assumed.
5. Refresh, Deployment & Power BI Service Administration
Manage workspaces, on-premises data gateways, scheduled and incremental refresh, and the promotion of content across development, test, and production environments. Apply the correct workspace and app roles for internal and client audiences, recognising that elevated workspace roles bypass row-level security. Schedule refresh windows to respect the load profile of the source SQL Server, monitor refresh reliability, and resolve failures promptly.
6. Data Quality & Governance
Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of all reporting outputs. Apply data minimisation so that personal and sensitive data is only brought into a model where it is genuinely required for reporting, support sensitivity labelling and data residency requirements across UK and South African client bases, and support compliance with POPIA, GDPR, and   data governance standards.
7. Stakeholder Engagement & Requirements Analysis
Work closely with clients, implementation teams, and internal stakeholders to gather, analyse, and refine reporting requirements, including who is entitled to see what. Provide estimates, communicate progress clearly, and support users in adopting and getting value from reporting solutions.
8. Performance Optimisation, Documentation & Continuous Improvement
Monitor and optimise query, refresh, and report performance, from execution plans at the database through to visual render times in the report. Maintain clear documentation of the SQL reporting layer, semantic models, measures, and the access and entitlement model, follow and enhance BI standards and best practice, and stay current with the evolving Power BI and Microsoft Fabric ecosystem.

Desired Experience & Qualification

Bachelor’s degree or National Diploma in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
3 to 5 years’ experience in a BI development or data-centric role, with strong hands-on Power BI experience across Desktop and the Power BI Service.
Strong T-SQL development skills on Microsoft SQL Server, including writing and maintaining stored procedures, views, functions, and complex set-based queries against normalised transactional schemas.
Practical query tuning ability: reading execution plans, understanding indexing and query cost, and writing reporting queries that perform well without adversely affecting the source system.
Proven ability to shape normalised operational data into report-friendly models, applying star schema and dimensional modelling concepts within the Power BI semantic model.
Strong proficiency in DAX for measures and calculations, including filter context, time intelligence, correct handling of ratios, and security expressions, together with working knowledge of Power Query (M).
Practical understanding of Power BI storage modes (Import, DirectQuery, and composite models) and their implications, including the constraints that apply when a model is sourced from stored procedures.
Hands-on experience implementing row-level security, including dynamic RLS driven by an entitlement or bridge table and the use of functions such as USERPRINCIPALNAME and CUSTOMDATA, and the ability to test it credibly.
A working understanding of Power BI access and sharing mechanics: Microsoft Entra ID identity, workspace and app roles, and which roles enforce or bypass row-level security.
Sound security instincts around credentials and data access: least-privilege service accounts, secure storage of gateway and data source credentials, and awareness of what an export or a shared link can expose.
Experience administering the Power BI Service: workspaces, on-premises data gateways, scheduled refresh, row-level security, and deployment pipelines or an equivalent controlled promotion process.
The following are strongly preferred and will carry material weight in selection:
Experience delivering reporting within the insurance industry, whether at an insurer, MGA, broker, or insurance software vendor.
A working understanding of insurance data and terminology: the policy lifecycle (quote, bind, endorsement or mid-term adjustment, renewal, cancellation), premium, claims, commission, and reinsurance, together with the measures built from them such as gross written premium, earned premium, loss ratio, claims frequency and severity, retention, and new business conversion.
Comfort with effective-dated and point-in-time reporting: producing a correct view of the book as at a given date from a live transactional schema, including the treatment of mid-term adjustments and pro-rata earned premium.
Experience designing entitlement models for external users, particularly across broker, agency, and delegated authority hierarchies where a user may see their own book, their agency’s book, or a ceded share only.
Experience delivering reporting in a multi-tenant environment, and a view on when to isolate clients into separate workspaces and semantic models versus sharing a model secured by row-level security.
The following will be an advantage but not a minimum requirement:
Microsoft PL-300 (Power BI Data Analyst) certification.
Experience with Power BI Embedded and the app-owns-data pattern: service principal authentication, embed token generation, and passing an effective identity so that security is enforced for users who hold no Power BI licence.
Object-level security, dynamic data masking, or comparable techniques for concealing sensitive columns and tables.
Experience with Power BI paginated reports (Report Builder / RDL) or SSRS, for operational and pixel-perfect outputs such as bordereaux, statements, and schedules.
Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels, Power BI audit and activity logging, tenant settings, and periodic access reviews.
Awareness of data residency and cross-border transfer considerations across UK and South African client bases.
Version control of Power BI artefacts (PBIP / TMDL in Git) and use of tools such as Tabular Editor, DAX Studio, and the Best Practice Analyzer.
Exposure to the Azure data stack (Azure SQL, Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric), as the reporting architecture is expected to evolve over time.
Experience in a SaaS or software implementation environment supporting multiple concurrent clients
SKILLS AND BEHAVIOUR REQUIRED
Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, with attention to detail and data accuracy.
Ability to translate business and client requirements into effective technical BI solutions.
Pragmatic about where logic belongs, with sound judgement on whether a calculation is best solved in T-SQL, Power Query, or DAX.
A security-first mindset, treating client data confidentiality as non-negotiable and defaulting to least privilege rather than convenience.
Clear communicator, able to present data insights and explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Mindful of the operational impact of reporting workloads on shared infrastructure, and disciplined about query cost and refresh timing.
Strong time management, able to prioritise and deliver across multiple concurrent projects and reporting requests.
Collaborative team player who works effectively with development, implementation, database, security, and client-facing teams.
Self-managed and proactive, with sound judgement on when to escalate risks or blockers.
High personal accountability and ownership.
Curious and committed to continuous learning across the BI and analytics landscape.

descriptions.title: MACHINE LEARNING ENGINEER - George (Hybrid negotiable)
descriptions.description:
Introduction

Our client is building the next generation of data, analytics and AI capabilities for the group. They believe technology should create Soft Landings: making work simpler, decisions smarter and businesses stronger.
Looking for a ML Engineer to be the dedicated engineering partner for their Data Science team. This is a dual-discipline role sitting at the intersection of data engineering and machine learning operations — purpose-built to ensure our Data Scientists have the data they need to build models, and that those models reliably reach production.

Duties & Responsibilities

PLEASE READ THIS CAREFULLY BEFORE APPLYING
This is not a platform maintenance role.
You'll work directly alongside three Data Scientists building feature pipelines, productionising models and establishing the engineering standards that make AI work in a regulated insurance environment. If you're a engineer who's comfortable moving between data infrastructure and ML delivery, and who thrives when their work creates measurable business outcomes, we'd love to hear from you.
This role supports the Data Science team
— not the core Data Engineering function
Your primary stakeholders are  Data Scientists. You are their dedicated engineering partner. You will collaborate with our Data Engineering team on platform standards and shared infrastructure, but you are not responsible for the core data modernisation delivery backlog. That boundary is intentional and will be maintained.
Structure
60% Data Engineering
— building and maintaining the pipelines, feature datasets and Snowflake data assets your Data Scientists need to train and validate models.
40% ML Ops
— taking models from experimentation into production: deployment, versioning, monitoring and drift detection. Both disciplines serve one team: Data Science.
01  Data Engineering for AI & Data Science
You'll build and own the data infrastructure that powers the Data Science team  ensuring they always have clean, reliable, well-structured data to work with.
Design and build feature pipelines and training datasets that support model development and validation
Build and maintain high-quality data assets in Snowflake that serve AI and analytical workloads
Collaborate with Data Engineering to align on platform standards without absorbing core modernisation backlog
Develop scalable feature engineering capabilities and contribute to feature management best practices
Ensure data pipelines supporting model training and inference are reliable, monitored and well-documented
Apply awareness of data governance and regulatory obligations (POPIA, FAIS, TCF) when building and managing data assets used in AI systems
Validate data quality and ensure model inputs align with agreed business definitions
02  ML Ops & Model Productionisation
You'll close the gap between data science experimentation and production  ensuring models built by the team reach the business reliably and at scale.
Partner with Data Scientists to productionise machine learning models and AI solutions
Design, build and maintain ML deployment pipelines and model serving infrastructure
Implement CI/CD practices for machine learning workflows and automated model delivery
Manage model versioning, experiment tracking and reproducible deployments
Monitor deployed models for performance, data drift, reliability and operational health
Ensure model outputs, data lineage and deployment decisions are documented and auditable
Contribute to responsible AI practices — explainability, monitoring and model risk controls
Troubleshoot production issues and continuously improve model and pipeline performance
03  Engineering Standards & Collaboration
You will help establish the engineering rigour that makes AI work trustworthy and sustainable — across the Data Science team and the broader Data & AI function.
Help establish ML engineering standards and best practices for the Data Science team
Contribute to the architecture of our growing AI ecosystem across Azure and GCP environments
Work with Analytics Engineers to integrate ML outputs into analytical and operational data products
Identify opportunities to improve automation, tooling and delivery velocity across the AI workstream
Proactively flag data, model or infrastructure risks before they become production issues
We're not building another data team. We're building a modern AI and data organisation where engineering, science and business knowledge come together to solve real problems in a regulated, commercially meaningful environment.
You'll have the opportunity to:
Be the go-to engineering partner for a high-performing Data Science team
Work with modern technologies including Azure, Snowflake, Python and dbt
Help shape our ML platform and productionisation standards from the ground up
See your engineering work translate directly into production AI that creates business value
Influence our AI ecosystem architecture as it scales across two insurance entities
Continuously learn and grow as AI and ML engineering evolve
Help build intelligent systems that improve how an insurance business operates every day
If you want a generalist platform role with no clear ownership, this probably isn't it.
If you want to be the engineering engine behind a Data Science team building real AI in insurance — we'd love to hear from you.
The division exists to accelerate sustainable growth through intelligent technologies, delivering Soft Landings for businesses, people and communities. They combine business expertise, data engineering, analytics, automation and AI to help organisations make smarter decisions, move faster and grow with confidence.
Intelligent Growth — build learning systems that scale wisely
Collaborative Intelligence — connect people, systems and insights to make better decisions
Trust by Design — create solutions that are explainable, ethical and reliable
Soft Landings — use technology to make change feel supported, safe and sustainable
Location & Working Arrangement
On-site | George, Western Cape — Hybrid Negotiable
This role is primarily based on-site at our George office. We're a collaborative, high-energy team and in-person presence is core to how we work. Hybrid arrangements may be considered for the right candidate — this is a conversation we're open to at offer stage. Applicants based in or willing to relocate to George are strongly encouraged to apply.

Desired Experience & Qualification

5+ years' experience in ML Engineering, Data Engineering or a combined role
Proven track record taking ML models from experimentation into production
Strong Python skills for pipeline development, ML workflows and automation
SQL proficiency for data investigation, transformation and validation
Experience with Azure cloud services and infrastructure
Snowflake or equivalent cloud data warehouse
CI/CD pipeline development and version control (Git)
Docker and containerisation for ML and data workloads
Model monitoring, drift detection and observability practices
Feature engineering building datasets that reliably serve model training
Awareness of data governance and regulatory requirements (POPIA, FAIS context)
Strong software engineering fundamentals and production development practices
Advantegious
Exposure to dbt for data transformation workflows
Databricks
Feature store design and management
API development and ML model serving endpoints
Insurance or financial services experience
Looking for someone who is:
Senior enough to hold two disciplines simultaneously without dropping either under pressure
A builder who takes ownership and follows work through to production
Collaborative and comfortable working as the dedicated engineering partner to a Data Science team
Pragmatic someone who finds the right solution for the problem, not the most complex one
Naturally curious about AI, ML and emerging engineering technologies
Proactive in flagging risks and unblocking teammates before issues escalate
Interested in the business and commercial context behind the technology
Committed to engineering quality, reliability and documentation in a regulated environment

Package & Remuneration

Mid level position with market related salary

descriptions.title: AI Engineer
descriptions.description:
Introduction

Most AI roles are a proof of concept that dies in a slide deck. This one is not.
Learning Online Group is an online education company operating across Australia, Canada, the UK and New Zealand. Over 100 staff, a portfolio of brands spanning beauty, photography, animal care and tattooing, and a growing amount of the business quietly running on systems our AI function built. We already have a South African team working alongside our Australian operation, and we are growing it.
This is not aspirational. We already have LLM-powered document automation, AI-assisted grading and chatbots in production around Salesforce, n8n and Postgres. What comes next is planned and funded: a Google Cloud data platform on BigQuery, and a multi-agent orchestration layer powering tutoring, student service and analytics agents across every brand.
Somebody has to build that. We are hoping it is you.
One thing to be clear about upfront: this is a fully remote role working with our Australian team, which means an early start in South Africa. Be honest with yourself about that before you apply, because the hours are the part people underestimate.

Duties & Responsibilities

You are an engineer first. Not research, not data science. You write tested, typed Python, ship behind CI/CD, and own what you run in production. When it breaks you are the one reading the logs.
You will work across Google, Salesforce, Vonage, Customer.io and WordPress, connected through n8n and custom apps, and increasingly through AI agents and tools like Claude Code and Antigravity.
Depending on where you land in the range, the job looks like this:
Build and operate production LLM applications: RAG over governed knowledge bases, tool and function calling, structured outputs, and multi-agent orchestration where a supervisor agent coordinates specialists
Own evaluation and observability: golden datasets, automated evals for non-deterministic behaviour, tracing, cost and latency monitoring. If you cannot prove it got better, it did not
Build integrations and semantic data layers across Salesforce, our LMS and finance platforms, with event-driven automation and APIs that other people can actually use
Stand up our Google Cloud AI stack: BigQuery, Cloud Run services in Python (FastAPI), vector search, and the Claude, OpenAI and Gemini APIs
Implement guardrails and responsible AI controls: least-privilege access, prompt-injection defence, privacy-safe data handling
Monitor production, triage failures, and keep the runbooks honest
The first six months are already mapped: take ownership of the live automation estate, ship internally scoped features, take our internal knowledge assistant from design to production in Slack, and lay the BigQuery foundations for the agent roadmap.

Desired Experience & Qualification

We have deliberately advertised one role with a wide band, because we would rather meet good people than argue about titles. Where you land depends on what you have actually shipped.
To be in the conversation at all:
Solid Python, with Git, and enough SQL to check your own results
You have called REST APIs and handled JSON and webhooks in something you built
You have built at least one thing with an LLM API and can explain, in detail, where it breaks. Personal projects count. Hackathons count. "I read about RAG" does not
A degree in computer science, software engineering, AI or data, or the equivalent proven in work
To be at the top of the band:
5+ years software engineering, including 2+ years running LLM or agentic systems in production, where "production" means real users and real consequences
Hands-on RAG: embeddings, vector databases, retrieval design, and the evals that prove quality
Enterprise integration depth: REST, webhooks, OAuth or JWT. Salesforce experience is a real advantage
Cloud engineering with Docker and CI/CD. Google Cloud preferred, AWS or Azure welcome
You have set engineering standards for other people and are happy mentoring a less experienced engineer
You can sit with a non-technical department head in another country, work out what they actually need, and translate it into a system
Nice to have at either end: multi-agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI), Model Context Protocol, FastAPI, education sector experience, and previous remote work with an international team.
Some of our strongest applicants come from South African software houses and product teams (Entelect, BBD, DVT, Synthesis, Dariel), local scale-ups and fintechs (Takealot, Yoco, Luno, JUMO, Prodigy Finance, Lula), data and engineering teams inside the big insurers and banks (Discovery, Old Mutual, Standard Bank, Momentum), or from remote contracting for overseas clients.
What matters most:
Self-directed. Remote work makes this non-negotiable. Nobody is going to stand behind you
Motivated by impact. You want to watch the thing you built change how a business operates
Comfortable with ambiguity. This function is still being defined and you get a say in it
Commercially minded. You ask whether the build is worth the time before you start it
Fast learner. The tooling moves weekly and you enjoy that rather than resenting it
Remote setup requirements:
A private, quiet home workspace
Uncapped fibre internet with a mobile data backup
Backup power (inverter, UPS or generator) able to cover your full working day through load shedding
Your own machine capable of doing real development work

Package & Remuneration

R60,000 to R110,000 per month
, and we mean the whole range.
That is deliberately wide, so here is exactly what it means:
Around R60,000 to R70,000
is for someone early in their career who has genuinely built with LLM APIs, can work through an integration without hand-holding, and wants to grow fast. You will work alongside senior engineers, ship with review, and take on more as you prove you can
Around R85,000 to R110,000
is for someone who has run production AI systems before, can own the architecture, set the standards, and mentor someone more junior. You take the function and you run it
If you are somewhere in the middle, apply. We will work it out together.
Paid monthly in ZAR
Fully remote, work from anywhere in South Africa
Hours aligned to Australian business hours
Engaged as an independent contractor through Remote, our global contracting platform
Why people love this role
Pay at the top end of the South African market for this kind of work
Fully remote. No commute, no traffic, no office politics
Real scope and hands-on from day one, with real budget and real stakeholders
Direct access to the CTO and leadership team, not five layers of management
Exposure to a $6M+ paid media operation across four markets
Why people stay
We invest in learning. Tools, courses, conferences, if it makes you better at your job we want to hear about it
We already have a South African team and we treat them as part of the business, not as an outsourced function
You get to build production AI properly, with evals and guardrails, instead of shipping demos
The problems are real operational problems with measurable outcomes

Interested?

descriptions.title: Senior Internal Auditor - Data Analytics
descriptions.description:
Introduction

Abacus is an authorised financial services provider and a proud member of the Pepkor Group, comprising two separate insurance companies: Abacus Insurance, which provides non-life insurance products, and Abacus Life, which provides life insurance products.
We enable the Pepkor Group of companies to meet the insurance needs of its customers by providing affordable, accessible, and easy-to-understand insurance products.
Our purpose is to:
Provide easy and affordable insurance products
to our customers.
Support development and growth
of our team.

our team.
Grow income and contain costs
without compromising value for sustainability.
Contribute to the insurance industry
and uplift society for sustainability.
Contribute to the conservation
of the environment for sustainability.
Be readily accessible
to our customers.

Duties & Responsibilities

Job Purpose
The role delivers complex, high-risk internal audits across the organisation, with a particular focus on data analytics and continuous assurance. It is responsible for providing the Audit Committee, Board and executive management with independent and objective assurance on the adequacy and effectiveness of governance, risk management and internal control frameworks.
The role exists to move the internal audit function from sample-based, retrospective testing towards full-population, evidence-rich and continuous auditing. The role sets the analytics methodology for approval by the Head of Internal Audit, build and maintain the reusable analytics library, automate repetitive audit procedures and raise the analytical literacy of the wider audit team so that analytics becomes a default part of how everyday audits are planned, executed and reported.
The role consistently applies the internal audit methodology and quality requirements in line with the Global Internal Audit Standards (GIAS), while upholding the highest standards of professional ethics and integrity.
Job Responsibilities
Data analytics leadership and capability building
Own the internal audit data analytics strategy, roadmap and operating model, aligning these to the annual audit plan, the function's technology stack and the organisation's broader data strategy.
Build, curate and govern a reusable library of audit analytics routines and scripts by risk and process area.
Establish and maintain the audit data environment in partnership with IT and Data Engineering, including secure, auditable and repeatable data extracts, a governed analytics workspace and appropriate access controls over sensitive and personal information.
Act as the analytics champion for the function: give input to the annual analytics coverage target, track adoption across audits, remove technical blockers for internal audit and report progress on analytics maturity to the Head of Internal Audit and Audit Committee.
Mentor, coach and upskill internal auditors in analytics techniques and tools through structured training, pair-working on audits, code review and analytics playbooks.
Audit planning and risk assessment
Contribute to the development of the risk-based annual audit plan by using data to profile risk across processes and business units so that audit effort is directed where exposure is greatest.
Design analytics-led audit approaches during planning rather than as an afterthought, including identifying data sources, agreeing data requests early, testing data completeness and integrity and defining the full-population tests that will replace or supplement manual sampling.
Maintain an up-to-date view of the regulatory, legislative and industry environment affecting the organisation and reflect changes in audit scoping and risk assessment.
Audit execution and fieldwork
Lead and execute audit assignments end to end, including integrated audits that combine process, financial, regulatory and IT scope.
Investigate and corroborate exceptions raised through analytic reviews with substantive audit evidence before concluding; distinguish clearly between data anomalies, data quality issues and genuine control breakdowns.
Prepare and maintain audit working papers in the audit management system that are complete and cross-referenced and retain the scripts, query logic, parameters, data lineage and data versions used. All work must be in accordance with the Global Internal Audit Standards.
Perform and document root cause analysis for each finding rather than reporting symptoms and quantify the actual and potential financial, regulatory, customer and reputational impact.
Support forensic, special investigation and ad hoc management requests where analytic capability is required.
Continuous auditing, monitoring and automation
Design, build, deploy and maintain continuous auditing and continuous monitoring routines over high-risk, high-volume processes, with defined thresholds, run frequencies, ownership and escalation paths.
Automate repetitive audit and reporting procedures to reduce manual effort and audit cycle time and track the time and cost released as a measurable benefit.
Build and maintain audit dashboards and visualisations that give management and the Audit Committee a clear current view of control health, exception trends, finding status and audit plan progress.
Transition mature continuous monitoring routines to the first and second lines where appropriate with proper handover, documentation and retained audit oversight of the routine's effectiveness.
Monitor the performance of deployed routines, including false-positive rates, exception ageing and run failures and maintain them so that they remain useful and trusted.
Reporting, insight and stakeholder engagement
Draft clear, concise, balanced and well-evidenced audit reports that state the finding, root cause, risk, quantified impact and a practical recommendation, written in business language accessible to a non-technical reader.
Agree findings, ratings and remediation actions with process owners and executive management, holding firm on substance while remaining constructive and professional in the face of challenge.
Prepare sections of the Audit Committee pack, including thematic and analytics-driven insight that goes beyond individual audit results.
Track, validate and report on the implementation of management actions and use data to test whether remediation has actually corrected the underlying control weakness rather than accepting management assertion.
Build and maintain trusted relationships with business unit leadership, risk, compliance, finance, actuarial and IT, positioning internal audit as a source of insight and valued business partner.
Governance, quality and professional practice
Maintain independence and objectivity, declare conflicts of interest promptly and apply professional scepticism throughout.
Contribute to the internal quality assurance and improvement programme, including self-assessment, peer file review and the closure of external quality assessment actions.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of audit methodology, templates, tooling and the audit management system.
Maintain professional certification and complete the required annual continuing professional education and keep current with developments in audit practice, analytics technique and the financial services sector.
Model the organisation's values and contribute to a culture of ethical conduct, inclusion, knowledge-sharing and professional pride within the function.

Desired Experience & Qualification

Essential Qualifications
Matric / Grade 12 / National Senior Certificate
A completed Bachelor's degree, or equivalent NQF Level 7 qualification, in Internal Auditing, Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics or Actuarial Science.
A recognised professional designation: CIA, CISA or equivalent will be beneficial

Demonstrable formal training in data analytics, through either a completed qualification, a certification or substantive documented practical experience.

Description
![][1]![][2]![][1]![][2]![][1]![][2]
Job Specification
Systems Developer and Implementation Specialist
6-Month Fixed-Term Contract
+------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------+
| > Contract period | > 6 months fixed term |
+------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------+
| > Position | > Systems Developer and Implementation Specialist |
+------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------+
| > Maximum salary | > R50,000 per month |
+------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------+
Purpose of the Position
The client is modernising its internal operational systems and requires a hands-on specialist to develop, implement and roll out the new solutions across the business.
The successful candidate will replace an existing Microsoft Access system, continue development of the company's Supabase-based operational platform, migrate data, test and deploy the solutions, and train employees to use them effectively.
This is an implementation-focused role. Success will be measured by working systems that are adopted by users, supported by reliable data and properly documented.
1 Key Responsibilities
Legacy System Replacement
Assess the existing Microsoft Access system and replace it with a modern SQL-based or cloud-based solution. This will include:
Reviewing the current databases, forms, queries, reports and business logic.
Documenting existing workflows and identifying processes that should be improved.
Designing the replacement database and application architecture.
Cleaning, mapping, migrating and validating historical data.
Rebuilding the required workflows, forms, reports and dashboards.
Implementing suitable security, access control, backup and recovery measures.
Operational Platform Development
Continue development of the company's operational platform using Supabase and modern AI-assisted or Vibe Coding tools. Priority modules include:
Inventory and warehouse management, including receiving, serialised stock, locations, transfers, picking,
delivery, returns and barcode functionality.
Asset management, including customer asset identifiers, serial numbers, locations, warranties, movements,
swap-outs, repairs and lifecycle history.
Technical job management, including allocation, scheduling, site attendance, work records, photos, stock
usage, configuration details, customer sign-off and reporting.
Additional operational modules and workflows agreed during the contract period.
Database and Application Development
Develop and maintain Supabase, PostgreSQL and SQL database structures.
Create appropriate relationships, views, functions, validations and audit trails.
Implement authentication, role-based permissions and row-level security.
Develop or integrate APIs where required.
Use Git or GitHub to manage source code and changes.
Apply sound architecture, security, testing and coding standards when using AI-assisted development tools.
2 Business Process and Solution Design
Work directly with management and operational staff to understand requirements and convert them into practical system functionality. The candidate will map workflows, identify opportunities for automation, build prototypes, obtain user feedback and refine the solution into production-ready functionality.
3 Testing Implementation and Rollout
Complete functional, data, workflow, permission, mobile and desktop testing.
Coordinate user acceptance testing and resolve defects before deployment.
Prepare implementation plans and migrate the required operational data.
Set up users and permissions and roll out modules to the relevant departments.
Monitor adoption, resolve initial issues and improve the system from user feedback.
Retire the old system when the replacement is stable and approved.
A module will only be regarded as delivered once it has been tested, accepted, deployed and adopted by the business.
4 Training and Documentation
Prepare user guides, quick-reference material and training content.
Train employees, key users and system administrators.
Provide initial support after implementation.
Document the system architecture, database structure, business rules, permissions, integrations,
deployment process and backup procedures.
Maintain complete and current source-code repositories and administrator documentation.
All source code, database structures, documentation and related intellectual property developed as part of the employment relationship will belong to the company, subject to the employment agreement.
5 Required Experience and Skills
Practical SQL, PostgreSQL and relational database design experience.
Experience with Supabase or a comparable cloud backend platform.
Web application development and API integration experience.
Experience migrating data from Microsoft Access or similar legacy systems.
Practical experience with AI-assisted or Vibe Coding tools such as Lovable, Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub
Copilot or ChatGPT.
Experience with authentication, permissions, testing, deployment and reporting.
Strong business-process analysis, communication and user-training skills.
Experience developing inventory, warehouse, asset-management, field-service, job-management or ERP- related solutions will be highly advantageous.
6 Portfolio Requirement
Applicants must present examples of systems they have personally developed or substantially contributed to. They should be able to explain their role, the tools and database architecture used, the challenges addressed, how the system was deployed and how users work with it.
Where confidentiality prevents a live demonstration, the applicant should provide alternative evidence that clearly demonstrates their capability.
7 Personal Attributes
Self-driven, practical and solution orientated.
Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of deliverables.
Able to understand operational processes and translate them into working systems.
Comfortable working with senior management and non-technical users.
Detail orientated, organised and focused on implementation and completion.
Able to work effectively as requirements evolve through user feedback.
8 Remuneration
The maximum salary is R50,000 per month, consisting of a fixed portion and a performance-based portion.

Investment Data and Valuations Specialist
Claremont, Cape Town
Market related
Great investment decisions depend on great data. Put your analytical eye at the heart of valuations, pricing and investment operations.
Is this you?
Accuracy is second nature to you. You’re analytical, curious and quick to investigate discrepancies rather than simply process them. Deadlines keep you focused, while initiative, independence and strong relationships help you thrive in a collaborative investment environment.
What you’ll be doing (and why you’ll enjoy it)
Sitting within Data Management, you’ll execute and review instrument, portfolio and trade data across order management and fund accounting systems. Your day will span asset pricing, price scrubbing, OTC valuation models, reference data, cash and margin requirements, collateral oversight and resolving pricing breaks. You’ll also support controls, procedures and incident reporting. You’ll enjoy seeing how accurate data and valuations directly support sound investment administration.

Join an established Cape Town investment manager combining deep Southern African roots with the reach of a global investment business. You’ll be based in professional offices in Claremont with the option to work hybrid.

Bring a BBusSc, BCom Finance or equivalent degree and at least 3 years’ Data/Valuations Specialist experience. You’ll need investment administration and portfolio management knowledge, strong Excel skills and an understanding of fixed income and derivative valuations. InvestOne and/or Bloomberg experience will give you an advantage.
What you’ll get
A permanent opportunity to deepen your expertise across data management, instrument valuations and investment operations within a sizeable investment environment offering both local and global exposure. You’ll be working for a well known brand and your package will include medical aid, pension fund and flexibility.
How to apply
For a confidential discussion please contact Claudette Du Preez on LinkedIn, (021) 035 1433 or send your CV to c.dupreez[at]thetalentexperts.co.za - we appreciate that your CV might not be fully up to date. Conduct functional, data, workflow, permission, mobile and desktop testing
Coordinate user acceptance testing and resolve defects
Plan and execute system implementation and data migration
Configure users and permissions and roll out solutions across relevant departments
Monitor adoption and resolve issues following implementation
Prepare user guides, training material and technical documentation
Train employees, key users and system administrators
Document system architecture, databases, business rules, permissions, integrations, deployment and backup procedures
Maintain complete source-code repositories and administrator documentation

Practical experience with SQL, PostgreSQL and relational database design
Experience with Supabase or a comparable cloud backend platform
Web application development and API integration experience
Experience migrating data from Microsoft Access or similar legacy systems
Practical experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Lovable, Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or ChatGPT
Experience with authentication, permissions, testing, deployment and reporting
Strong business-process analysis and solution-design capability
Ability to work directly with senior management and non-technical users

Chartered Management Services is the operational backbone of Chartered Wealth Group, providing the shared services, support and infrastructure that enable Chartered Wealth Solutions and our related businesses to deliver thoughtful, relationship-led service. As one of South Africa’s leading independent financial planning practices, our work depends on the trust placed in us by our clients, colleagues and partners. We handle sensitive client, company and employee information every day, and we are committed to protecting it with the same care and integrity that guide everything we do.
We are looking for a Data Governance and Security Specialist to help strengthen how information is managed, protected and governed across the business. Reporting to the Business Analyst, you will work at the intersection of technology, compliance and business operations, helping to ensure that data is stored, shared and accessed in a way that is secure, practical and aligned with the needs of the business.

descriptions.title: ServiceNow Data and CMDB Specialist
descriptions.description:
Introduction

Please DO NOT contact any of the recruiters directly. A questionnaire will be sent via email if your CV is shortlisted. Please ensure that your CV has your email address.
If you have not received feedback in 2 weeks, please consider your application unsuccessful

Johannesburg

IT Service Management Applications

Market- Related
Working Hours and Working Arrangements
Working hours:
35 hours per week, 09h30–17h30.
Additional hours may be required.
The hybrid working approach allows for up to
40% of working time from home and 60% in the office
.
Role Overview
The ServiceNow Data and CMDB Specialist is responsible for the governance, quality and ongoing development of data held within the ServiceNow platform, with particular responsibility for the Configuration Management Database (CMDB), service data, and reporting and insight delivered through or sourced from ServiceNow.
The role ensures that Configuration Items (CIs), their relationships and supporting service data are accurate, complete and kept up to date. This provides a reliable source of information for service management processes, operational decision-making, risk management, automation and the introduction of new services and technologies.
The role also oversees the quality of data supplied to ServiceNow by other systems. Working with source-system owners and integration teams, the role holder establishes clear ownership, agreed data standards and appropriate controls. The role does not own the source systems but is responsible for identifying and coordinating the resolution of issues that affect the quality of data used within ServiceNow.
Requirements
Qualifications
Relevant practical ServiceNow CMDB, data-governance and reporting experience is more important than holding every listed qualification.
ServiceNow Certified System Administrator certification or equivalent practical platform experience would be beneficial.
ServiceNow training or certification relating to CMDB, CSDM, Discovery, Service Mapping, Performance Analytics or reporting would be beneficial.
Experience
At least five years' relevant ServiceNow experience, including practical experience in CMDB, configuration management and platform data.
Strong working knowledge of ServiceNow CMDB, including CI classes, relationships, lifecycle management, data quality and governance.
Good understanding of CSDM and how service, application and infrastructure data should be structured and related within ServiceNow.
Experience of ServiceNow Discovery, Service Mapping, Identification and Reconciliation Engine principles, imports and integration data sources.
Hands-on experience maintaining or improving a CMDB within a medium-to-large organisation, including work with CI classes, relationships, data sources, reconciliation, data-quality controls and remediation.
Practical experience creating ServiceNow reports and dashboards, turning business requirements into meaningful measures, and checking that reports, dashboards and performance measures are accurate.
Good understanding of data models, data relationships, data ownership, authoritative sources and data-quality management.
Experience of Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, SQL or another reporting and analytics tool.
Good understanding of IT service management and how reliable configuration and service data supports Incident, Problem, Change, Asset and Service Level Management.
Experience considering how data quality and governance underpin ServiceNow AI capabilities such as Now Assist is desirable.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex data issues and recommend practical solutions.
Experience governing data exchanged between multiple systems.
Experience working with technical and non-technical data owners to resolve data-quality issues and improve accountability.
Skills and Competencies
Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain data, CMDB and reporting concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
Builds positive and collaborative relationships across the company and adapts communication to suit the audience.
Takes ownership, follows through on agreed actions and uses evidence and sound judgement when making decisions or recommendations.
Acts with integrity when managing data, presenting results and raising risks or areas of non-compliance.
Responds positively to change and looks for practical ways to improve the quality and value of ServiceNow data and reporting.
Shares knowledge and helps colleagues make effective use of ServiceNow data and reporting, contributing to a supportive workplace where people can perform at their best.
Key Responsibilities
Own the governance, quality and ongoing maturity of the ServiceNow CMDB, ensuring CI data and relationships are accurate, complete, current and fit for purpose.
Maintain the CMDB data model, CI classes, attributes, relationships and lifecycle standards in line with ServiceNow best practice and the Common Service Data Model (CSDM).
Own the service mapping data model, governance and quality standards, working with service owners and Platform Engineering to ensure business applications, application services, technical services and supporting infrastructure are recorded and related at the appropriate level.
Work with service, application, infrastructure and data owners to agree ownership, data requirements and responsibilities for maintaining configuration and service data.
Maintain appropriate controls for creating, updating, reconciling, retiring and deleting CIs.
Monitor CMDB health through regular data-quality reviews covering completeness, correctness, compliance, duplication, stale records and missing or inaccurate relationships.
Investigate root causes and work with relevant owners to agree and track corrective action.
Establish governance standards for data supplied to ServiceNow by other systems, including authoritative sources, ownership, definitions, quality expectations and frequency of updates.
Maintain a clear record of the main data sources, owners, integration dependencies and agreed controls.
Work with source-system owners and integration teams to understand how data moves between systems.
Monitor and reconcile data received through inbound feeds and integrations and coordinate corrective action where issues are identified.
Consider data-governance requirements when new integrations, services and automation are being designed.
Work with relevant ServiceNow technical specialists to ensure integrations, discovery sources, imports and automated feeds update ServiceNow data correctly.
Define and validate CMDB and data requirements for platform changes and integrations.
Support the effective use of ServiceNow Discovery, Service Mapping and other tools used to populate and maintain the CMDB.
Work with asset owners to maintain appropriate alignment between configuration and asset data, without taking ownership of the underlying asset-management processes.
Represent CMDB, data-governance and reporting considerations in relevant project, design and change discussions.
Promote the effective use of CMDB and service data across Incident, Problem, Change, Asset and other relevant ServiceNow processes.
Own the standards and governance for ServiceNow reporting.
Develop shared, cross-platform and management reports, dashboards and performance measures.
Work with stakeholders to translate reporting requirements into agreed measures.
Agree definitions and calculation methods for key performance indicators and operational measures.
Validate reporting against the underlying data before it is released or materially changed.
Analyse platform and service-management data to identify trends, risks and opportunities for improvement.
Review existing reports and dashboards to remove or consolidate duplicated or outdated content.
Support the controlled use of ServiceNow data by reporting and analytics platforms such as Power BI or Microsoft Fabric.
Maintain consistent definitions, ownership and quality controls when data is shared or extracted.
Support the data-quality and governance foundations needed for approved ServiceNow AI capabilities such as Now Assist.
Maintain documentation covering the CMDB data model, data sources, ownership, governance standards, reporting definitions, controls and operating procedures.
Help users make effective use of ServiceNow data, reports and dashboards.
Keep up to date with relevant ServiceNow capabilities and industry practices relating to CMDB, CSDM, service mapping, data governance and reporting.
Act in accordance with the company's information security, data protection and records-management policies.
Report any potential or actual security risks or events.
Help build a supportive workplace where colleagues can do their best work and take part in the company's Responsible Business program.

, proudly positioned as

The
Software Developer is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining features across the full technology stack of our web platform. The role works across the React/TypeScript frontend, the Node.js/Express backend, and the PostgreSQL database layer, taking ownership of features from specification through to production deployment. Having grown beyond junior responsibilities, this role is expected to deliver production-ready features independently, contribute to technical decisions, handle deployments through our CI/CD pipeline, and integrate the platform with third-party services such as PayFast and transactional email providers.

Duties & Responsibilities

Minimum requirements (Advantageous):
Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree (BSc) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related field.
Experience
Minimum 8 years of professional software development experience.
Demonstrated experience building and maintaining production web applications across the full stack.
Proven track record of shipping features from specification through to deployment.
Experience working in a Git-based collaborative development environment.
Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and modern web development frameworks and tools, including React 18, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Vite, React Router, TanStack Query, React Hook Form, Zod, Framer Motion, and Leaflet.
Experience developing secure REST APIs, authentication, file uploads, transactional email, payment gateway integrations, and web application security best practices.
Understanding of REST API design principles and HTTP fundamentals.
Experience working with Git workflows, including feature branches, pull requests, and code reviews.
Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Ability to work independently and take ownership of features from concept through deployment.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to discuss technical trade-offs effectively.
Collaborative mindset with experience participating in code reviews.
Self-motivated learner who keeps up to date with modern JavaScript, React, and Node.js development practices.
Reliable, accountable, and proactive in identifying and communicating blockers or risks early.
Duties and responsibilities include, but not limited to:
Translate product requirements, specifications, wireframes, and UI/UX designs into high-quality, production-ready frontend features.
Design, build, and maintain modern web applications using React and TypeScript.
Develop reusable, maintainable, and well-structured components that can be shared across features and applications.
Build responsive, accessible, and intuitive user interfaces that work consistently across modern desktop, tablet, and mobile browsers.
Convert UI/UX designs into accurate, polished interfaces while maintaining a consistent visual language across the product.
Implement appropriate application architecture, component composition, state management, routing, data fetching, caching, and form-management patterns.
Build complex forms and user workflows, including validation, conditional behaviour, multi-step processes, error handling, and user feedback.
Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs and services, including authentication, file uploads, payments, mapping, notifications, and other third-party services.
Work with REST APIs and other service interfaces, correctly handling authentication, pagination, validation errors, loading states, retries, failures, and asynchronous operations.
Implement secure authentication and authorisation flows in conjunction with backend services, ensuring appropriate handling of sessions, permissions, and protected application areas.
Apply frontend security best practices, including input handling, dependency management, secure browser storage practices, and protection against common web application vulnerabilities.
Design frontend solutions that accommodate changing requirements and future functionality without unnecessary complexity or excessive coupling.
Optimise applications for performance, including rendering efficiency, network usage, application loading time, asset optimisation, and perceived user responsiveness.
Implement appropriate client-side error handling and provide clear, useful feedback when operations fail.
Integrate file and image upload functionality, including validation, progress indication, previews, and error handling where required.
Implement interactive functionality such as maps, dashboards, data visualisations, search, filtering, dynamic forms, and other rich application experiences as required by the product.
Work closely with backend engineers to define and refine API contracts, data structures, authentication flows, and integration requirements.
Collaborate with product owners, designers, engineers, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements and identify practical technical solutions.
Participate in technical discussions and contribute to decisions regarding frontend architecture, application structure, reusable components, and engineering standards.
Write clean, readable, maintainable, and appropriately documented TypeScript and React code.
Write and maintain appropriate automated tests for components, application logic, integrations, and critical user journeys.
Diagnose and resolve defects reported by users, internal stakeholders, automated testing, or application monitoring.
Investigate and resolve browser-specific, device-specific, performance, usability, and accessibility issues.
Refactor and improve existing frontend code to reduce technical debt, improve maintainability, and simplify future development.
Review code contributed by other developers and provide constructive feedback on correctness, maintainability, usability, security, and overall engineering quality.
Participate in source-control and code-review processes, including producing meaningful commits, pull requests, and supporting technical documentation.
Work effectively within automated build, testing, deployment, and CI/CD processes and assist in diagnosing issues affecting frontend releases.
Ensure frontend applications are configurable across local, development, staging, and production environments without embedding environment-specific configuration in application code.
Maintain awareness of modern React and TypeScript development practices and recommend improvements where they provide clear technical or product value.
Take ownership of assigned features from initial requirements through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.
Contribute to the continued improvement of frontend engineering standards, development practices, tooling, and overall product quality.

Shape the technology behind next-generation radar and sensing systems.
We are looking for an exceptional Senior Software Developer specialising in Signal Processing to join a highly specialised engineering environment in Stellenbosch.

descriptions.title: Full stack software developer
descriptions.description:
Description

Raizcorp is looking for a
mid-to-senior full stack software developer
to join its growing development team. The role may be remote (within South Africa), although you must be willing to visit Raizcorp's head office from time to time.
The role
This is a hands-on full-stack role working across four related applications. You’ll spend time extending and maintaining a large, mature multi-tenant SaaS platform, while also contributing to newer Laravel applications that are modernising legacy systems and introducing newer patterns. The work ranges from everyday product development and bug fixing to database changes, integrations, testing, documentation and occasional client-facing UAT support. You’ll need to be comfortable understanding an existing system before changing it, while also being able to build new functionality from a PRD or client brief.
What you'll do
Build and maintain production features across Laravel, Vue 3 and TypeScript applications, working across both backend and frontend code where required.
Work with Eloquent models, complex relationships, policies, queues, background jobs and database queries, with attention to performance and tenant data isolation.
Develop new functionality in both an established SaaS platform and newer applications, following existing architectural patterns rather than introducing unnecessary complexity.
Design and implement database changes, including safe migrations and data operations in PostgreSQL, with occasional work involving legacy SQL Server and Microsoft Access data.
Write and maintain automated unit, feature and browser tests, and investigate failures as part of normal development rather than treating testing as a separate phase.
Work through a PR-based development process: clarify requirements from briefs and PRDs, create focused changes, participate in code review and provide appropriate changelog entries.
Produce practical technical documentation, including build notes, architecture decisions and documentation of non-obvious behaviour, so that important system knowledge does not remain only in code.
Support client-facing UAT by preparing test scenarios and seeded data, helping explain changes and resolving issues identified during acceptance testing.
What you'll need
Solid commercial experience developing applications with PHP and Laravel, including Eloquent, queues, authorisation, migrations and automated testing.
Production experience with Vue 3 and TypeScript, ideally using Inertia.js or a similar server-driven application architecture.
Good relational database skills, preferably PostgreSQL, including schema design, query optimisation and safe production data changes.
Experience writing automated tests with Pest or PHPUnit as a normal part of development.
Comfort working in a large existing codebase: reading and understanding existing behaviour before making changes, and following established patterns.
Experience with Git and pull-request-based development, including reviewing other developers’ work and responding constructively to review feedback.
Strong written communication and the ability to discuss requirements and technical issues clearly with non-technical stakeholders.
A practical approach to development: knowing when to investigate further, when to ask questions and when a smaller change is safer than a large refactor.
Nice to have
Filament v3/v4 and Livewire.
Multi-tenant SaaS architecture and tenant-aware queues/caching.
Tailwind CSS v4, PrimeVue, SurveyJS, CKEditor, AG Grid or similar rich frontend components.
Domain-Driven Design and state-machine based domain models; ability to read F# is useful but not required.
Legacy data migration, particularly SQL Server / Microsoft Access to PostgreSQL.
LLM/AI feature integration, including tool-calling agents and prompt design.
Laravel Herd, Laravel Cloud, Laravel Forge and GitHub Actions.
Firebase Authentication, AWS S3, Redis and Laravel Horizon.
Experience in business-development, entrepreneurship or ed-tech software.
Our stack
Backend
PHP 8.3+
Laravel 12 / Laravel 13
Eloquent, Policies and Gates
Filament v3/v4, Livewire
Redis, Horizon, queues
Spatie Laravel packages
Laravel AI SDK / OpenAI PHP client
Frontend
Vue 3, Composition API,

Package & Remuneration

R780 000 - R900 000 per annum

For over 25 years, we’ve helped thousands of entrepreneurs across South Africa turn bold ideas into thriving businesses. From school-level entrepreneurial curricula to equity partnerships with scale-ready ventures, our eight specialist divisions stretch across industries, sectors and impact levels. descriptions.title: Front End Slot Game Developer
descriptions.description:
Introduction

We are looking for a Frontend Slot Game Developer to build and maintain the HTML5 game clients that power our casino slot titles. You'll work in TypeScript on top of a 2D rendering engine (Phaser 3 or Pixi.js, depending on the title), building the reels, animations, UI, and bonus features players interact with directly, and wiring that client to both our web-hosted Remote Game Server (RGS) and our physical cabinet (EGM) hardware for land-based deployments.

Duties & Responsibilities

The essential duties of the position include the following, and other duties may be assigned:
Build and maintain slot game front-ends in TypeScript using Phaser 3 or Pixi.js as the 2D rendering/animation engine, alongside React 19 and Redux Toolkit for UI shell and application state.
Keep Redux (or the project's equivalent state layer) as the single source of truth across the React/rendering-engine boundary, avoiding duplicated local state that can drift out of sync.
Implement win-celebration and character animation using Spine2D skeletal animation (spine-phaser / pixi-spine), GSAP tweening, Effekseer particle effects, and Howler.js audio.
Integrate the game client with the RGS over REST and WebSocket — session start, spin request/response, balance updates, and reconnect/error handling — and with physical cabinet hardware via the studio's cabinet SDK bridge for land-based (LPM) builds.
Build and maintain core slot features: autoplay (with configurable stop conditions), buy-feature/buy-spins, turbo mode, paytables and info popups, bonus wheels, expandable "penny game" mechanics, and multi-theme/reskin support.
Maintain layouts for both responsive desktop/mobile web play and fixed-resolution cabinet displays (including portrait cabinet layouts and rotate-to-play prompts).
Write and maintain automated regression tooling: outcome/math verification scripts and Puppeteer-driven browser probes that catch UI and payout-display regressions before release.
Build and ship titles with Vite (current titles) or Webpack/Babel (legacy titles still on that toolchain), and support Docker/Kubernetes/Nginx-based deployment of the built client.
Collaborate with the backend/math team, QA, and compliance to hit certification and submission deadlines, including coordinating fixes flagged during independent test-lab review.

Desired Experience & Qualification

Required:
3–5 years of professional experience building HTML5/canvas-based games or comparably interactive, animation-heavy web applications.
Strong TypeScript/JavaScript fundamentals, including asynchronous programming and state management patterns.
Hands-on production experience with Phaser 3 and/or Pixi.js (or a directly comparable 2D game engine such as Cocos2d-x or Construct).
Experience with React and a centralized state-management library (Redux Toolkit or equivalent).
Comfortable working with Git across Bitbucket, GitHub, and/or Azure DevOps.
Nice to have:
Prior experience specifically in slot, casino, or other regulated real-money gaming.
Experience integrating a client against a Remote Game Server (RGS) or similar real-time session/payment backend.
Spine2D (or comparable skeletal animation) pipeline experience.
Experience shipping software to physical gaming cabinets/EGMs or other constrained embedded display hardware.
Node.js scripting for build tooling, asset pipelines, or QA automation.
Language Ability
Ability to read and comprehend technical specifications, correspondence, and design documents. Ability to write clear technical documentation and communicate effectively with designers, backend engineers, QA, and compliance staff, one-on-one and in small groups.
Math Ability
A working understanding of probability as it applies to slot paytables, paylines/ways, and RTP is a plus. No specialized higher mathematics (e.g., calculus, differential equations) is required for this role — that lives with the backend/math engine role below.
Reasoning Ability
Ability to solve practical problems involving a variety of concrete variables where only limited standardization exists (e.g., reconciling animation timing against a variable-length server response). Ability to interpret feedback from QA, compliance, or non-technical stakeholders to identify the underlying issue and propose a fix. Comfortable working under the deadline pressure that comes with regulatory submission windows.
Computer Skills
Comfortable with modern browser developer tools, Microsoft Office / Google Workspace, and standard issue-tracking tools (e.g., Jira). Experience with Docker and basic CI/CD pipelines (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions) is an advantage.

Introduction

The South African Astronomical Observatory (SAAO) is the National Facility for Optical and Infrared Astronomy of the National Research Foundation (NRF). Its headquarters are in Cape Town, while its telescopes are at Sutherland in the semi-arid Northern Cape. Distributed between the two sites, SAAO employs roughly 130 people, many of them scientists and engineers, and is contracted to operate the 10-m Southern African Large Telescope (SALT), on behalf of the international SALT Foundation. SAAO is the premier optical/infrared research facility on the African continent, with global research and outreach collaborations and contributing human capacity development for South Africa.
Position:
SALT Graduate Software Engineer
Business Unit:
South Africa Astronomical Observatory (SAAO)
Location:
Cape Town, Western Cape

Position Details

Position Summary:
The SAAO, in partnership with SALT, invites applications from suitably qualified individuals for the position of Graduate Engineer Software Engineering/ Diagnostics and Control Systems to join our Software Engineering Team based in Cape Town. The successful candidate will support the team with the development, maintenance, and operational readiness of telescope and instrumentation software. The position is within a dynamic division, comprised of approximately three dozen staff, including astronomers, electrical, electronic, optical and mechanical engineers, technicians, and software developers.
Key Responsibilities:
Assist with software development and maintenance in accordance with the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
Support fault finding, debugging, and resolution of software issues under supervision
Participate in software testing and execution of Software Acceptance Test Procedures (ATPs)
Assist with integration of software with control systems, instrumentation, and electronic subsystems
Support preparation of telescope systems for night-time operations
Follow software configuration management and version control procedures
Work closely with engineers and multidisciplinary teams
Additional Notes:
Strong willingness to learn and develop engineering competence
Good communication and teamwork skills
Attention to detail and sense of responsibility
Problem-solving mindset and adaptability
Demonstrated interest in instrumentation, automation, scientific facilities, or astronomy will be considered desirable

Requirements

Qualification:
BEng/BSc (Eng) in Computer/Electrical/Electronic/ Mechatronics, NQF level 8
Experience:
0-2 years post-qualification experience
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
Basic understanding of software engineering principles, software version control and SDLC
Exposure to control systems, PLCs, embedded controllers, or RTOS environments
Exposure to LabVIEW or National Instruments platforms
Basic familiarity with Linux operating systems

Friday, 16 Oct 2026

descriptions.title: Software Tester
descriptions.description:
Description
Software Tester
**Overview:
**
The Tester plays a crucial role in ensuring the quality and reliability of software products or systems before their deployment. They are responsible for identifying defects, bugs, and other issues through rigorous testing
processes. The Tester collaborates closely with developers, designers, and product managers to maintain high
standards of quality throughout the development lifecycle.
Responsibilities:
Test Planning:
Develop comprehensive test plans based on project requirements and specifications.
Test Case Creation:
Create detailed and effective test cases covering all aspects of software functionality.
Test Execution:
Execute test cases manually and/or using automated testing tools to identify defects and
inconsistencies.
Defect Reporting:
Report bugs and issues accurately and promptly using designated tracking tools, providing necessary
information for resolution.
Regression Testing:
Conduct regression testing to ensure that previously identified issues have been addressed and that
new changes have not introduced additional problems.
Cross-functional Collaboration:
Collaborate with developers, designers, and product managers to understand requirements, discuss
defects, and ensure alignment on quality objectives.
Documentation:
Maintain documentation of test cases, test results, and testing processes for future reference and
knowledge sharing.
Continuous Improvement:
Contribute to the improvement of testing processes and methodologies by providing feedback and
suggestions based on experience and industry best practices.
Adaptability:
Adapt to changing project requirements, priorities, and timelines, while still maintaining a high level of
quality in testing activities.
Communication:
Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, providing updates on testing progress,
issues, and recommendations.
Quality Assurance:
Design and execute test cases that validate security requirements.
Collaborate with developers to retest and validate fixes for security defects.
Qualifications and Experience:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
Proven experience in software testing, preferably in a professional setting.
Familiarity with testing methodologies, tools, and techniques.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.
Knowledge of programming languages and scripting (e.g., Python, JavaScript) is a plus.
Experience with automated testing tools such as Selenium, JUnit, or similar is desirable.
Experience writing and executing SQL queries for testing and data verification purposes.
Personal Attributes:
Passion for quality and continuous improvement.
Proactive attitude towards problem-solving and learning.
Ability to adapt to changing priorities and project requirements.
Strong organizational and time management skills.
Team player with good interpersonal skills.
