descriptions.title: Senior Data Analyst
descriptions.description:
Cape Town
About Our Client
Our client is a fast-growing African technology company solving one of the most consequential problems in the region's digital economy, at scale and in high-stakes environments. Their platform is trusted by some of the continent's most demanding institutions precisely because it works. Their analytics function is small and growing, with strong foundations already in place: an expanding data warehouse, established governance and data quality practices, and reporting the business relies on. The gap now is capacity, not groundwork, and this role exists to close it.
The Role
As Senior Data Analyst, you will turn the business's data into decisions it can act on with confidence. Business questions rarely arrive fully formed, so your craft is to shape a broadly worded question into something that can genuinely be answered, answer it well, and land that answer with the people who need to act on it.
This is a senior, hands-on role that sits close to both the business and the data platform. You will be as comfortable interrogating a messy dataset in the morning as presenting a customer engagement analysis to leadership in the afternoon. You will work the lifecycle end to end: framing the question, modelling and interrogating the data, drawing out the insight, and seeing the recommendation through to a decision and its adoption.
Our client cares more about how well you think, how clearly you communicate and how curious you are about how data is built than about the particular tools you have used before. Strong analysts come from many backgrounds and industries, and they would like to hear from all of them.
What Success Looks Like In The First Six Months
You own the core business and client reporting, and the definitions behind those numbers are documented, consistent and trusted across teams.
Recurring reporting that is currently rebuilt by hand runs to a schedule, with quality checks attached.
At least one piece of analysis you initiated, rather than were asked for, has changed a product, operational or commercial decision.
Product, engineering and commercial teams see you as the person to ask about what the data actually says.
Key Responsibilities
Reporting, Dashboards and Self-Service
Own end to end reporting for key business metrics, keeping definitions consistent and trusted across teams.
Build and maintain dashboards and self-service tools that let teams find and act on insight independently.
Own recurring client reporting from definition and automation through to quality assurance, delivery and follow-up, and be credible explaining a number or a discrepancy directly to a client's team.
Handle ad hoc requests with sound judgement: establish the real question, deliver a clear and actionable answer, and prioritise sensibly when several arrive at once.
Match the right reporting and visualisation tool to the audience, the question and the shelf life of the answer.
Product and User Behaviour Analysis
Analyse user behaviour across products to identify trends, friction points and opportunities, and turn findings into concrete recommendations.
Track and report on engagement, retention and customer journey metrics, flagging risks and opportunities proactively.
Apply appropriate statistical rigour, including cohort analysis, significance testing, forecasting and seasonality, so that recommendations hold up under challenge.
Design and evaluate experiments with the product team, being clear about what a result does and does not prove.
Investigate anomalies and work out whether what you are seeing is genuine signal, a data quality issue or noise.
Automation and Data Foundations
Automate recurring analysis and reporting so that regular outputs run reliably to a schedule with quality checks.
Build and maintain analytical models and reusable assets on top of curated data, so that knowledge compounds rather than living in one-off queries.
Specify what the analytics layer needs from upstream data (sources, structures, definitions and refresh frequencies) and work with engineering to deliver it.
Understand the data platform well enough to be a genuine partner to engineering: where data comes from, how it flows, and what an upstream change will mean downstream.
Data Governance, Quality and Privacy
Work responsibly with personal and sensitive data in line with POPIA and client obligations, applying least-privilege access, aggregation and de-identification as a matter of course.
Identify and resolve data quality issues at the source rather than patching around them downstream.
Apply sound data security, governance and metadata management practices across pipelines, dashboards and datasets.
Contribute to lean, practical governance standards that balance rigour with the team's pace of delivery.
Stakeholder Engagement, Mentorship and Documentation
Partner with product, marketing, engineering and operations to ensure data is accessible, accurate and used effectively.
Communicate technical and analytical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Represent the analytics perspective alongside engineers, architects and leaders on the broader data platform roadmap.
Mentor junior and intermediate analysts as the team grows, and contribute to internal training and knowledge sharing.
Maintain clear documentation of data models, dashboards and workflows, so the team never depends on one person's memory.
AI-Augmented Ways of Working
Use AI as a standard part of your workflow: exploring data, drafting and optimising SQL, building reports, writing documentation and pressure-testing your own analysis.
Build reusable AI workflows and share them with the team, turning repeatable analysis into dependable automation.
Keep a critical eye: verify AI output, know where it goes wrong, and never present a number you could not derive and defend yourself.
Stay current with a fast-moving tooling landscape and bring what you learn back to the team.
What You Will Bring
Experience and Qualifications
At least 5 years' experience as a Data Analyst or in a similar analytical role.
At least 5 years' BI and data visualisation experience. The team is deliberately tool-agnostic (Power BI, Looker, Tableau, Qlik or similar); what matters is that you have built things people actually use.
A track record of delivering analytical work independently in an agile, fast-paced environment, from scoping and estimating through to stakeholder sign-off, while managing competing priorities.
A Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics or a related field, or equivalent demonstrable experience.
Exposure to a regulated or high-integrity environment such as banking, insurance, telco, fintech, identity or risk is strongly advantageous.
Technical And Analytical Skills
Advanced SQL, and Python for analysis and automation.
Strong applied statistics, including cohort analysis, significance testing, forecasting and seasonality.
Experience with the Azure data stack (Data Factory, Synapse, Databricks) or an equivalent cloud data platform is valuable but not essential.
Familiarity with CI/CD, version control and modern development practices applied to analytics is advantageous.
Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Application Insights, Azure Monitor or Grafana is a plus.
Governance, Communication and Ways of Working
A working understanding of data security, governance and metadata management principles, and comfort handling personal and sensitive data in a compliance-conscious environment.
Strong communication skills, with experience presenting your own analysis to senior stakeholders; experience presenting directly to external clients is advantageous.
Comfort owning work end to end, from framing a question through to seeing a recommendation adopted.
Experience supporting or mentoring less experienced analysts is a plus.
What's On Offer
Exclusive access to preferential financial benefits, including competitive rates on home loans, vehicle finance and personal loans.
A competitive compensation package designed to reward impact.
Enhanced family responsibility leave.
Annual leave entitlement that grows with your tenure.
A remote-first culture, with a preference for Cape Town based candidates.
A technically excellent, mission-driven team working at the frontier of its field, in a culture built on intellectual rigour, psychological safety, collaboration and a bias for action.
If you have not heard from us within one month of submitting your application, please consider your application unsuccessful. Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we are unable to respond to each applicant individually.

descriptions.title: Senior Data Scientist, Product Data
descriptions.description:
About Impact.com
impact.com is the world’s leading commerce partnership marketing platform, transforming the way businesses grow by enabling them to discover, manage, and scale partnerships across the entire customer journey. From affiliates and influencers to content publishers, brand ambassadors, and customer advocates, impact.com empowers brands to drive trusted, performance-based growth through authentic relationships. Its award-winning products—Performance (affiliate), Creator (influencer), and Advocate (customer referral)—unify every type of partner into one integrated platform. As consumers increasingly rely on recommendations from people and communities they trust, impact.com helps brands show up where it matters most. Today, over 5,000 global brands, including Walmart, Uber, Shopify, Lenovo, L’Oréal, and Fanatics, rely on impact.com to power more than 225,000 partnerships that deliver measurable business results.
About The Role
We're seeking a Senior Data Scientist specializing in Product Data Quality to join our Cape Town Data Science team. In this role, you'll own the analytical and technical foundation of product data quality across our ecosystem—spanning catalog hygiene, transaction matching, classification modeling, deduplication, and global product identity. You'll work across both the structured catalog universe and the messier, larger-scale sales transaction universe, building models and infrastructure that power search, recommendations, and business intelligence. This is a high-impact role that demands both analytical depth and strong engineering capabilities: you'll take models from research to production, build scalable data pipelines, and create the monitoring infrastructure that makes our product data foundation trustworthy and continuously improving. Your work will directly influence search relevance, recommendation quality, match rates, and reporting accuracy across the business.
Core Responsibilities
Product classification & taxonomy modeling
Develop, deploy, and maintain ML models for automated product categorization and taxonomy assignment across hierarchical category structures.
Improve classification accuracy through feature engineering (text, attributes, embeddings), model iteration, and robust evaluation on both catalog and sales transaction data.
Monitor production model performance; identify and remediate misclassification patterns that impact search, recommendations, and reporting.
Collaborate with category experts and Product teams to refine taxonomy definitions, handle edge cases, and adapt to new product types.
Catalog & sales universe data quality
Conduct deep-dive analyses into catalog completeness, consistency, and correctness across retailers, categories, and product attributes.
Own data quality analytics for the sales transaction universe—a larger, messier dataset than catalog—measuring match rates, diagnosing gaps (unmatched transactions, misattributed products), and identifying systematic failures.
Define and track catalog and transaction health KPIs (attribute coverage, schema compliance, match rates, GPID coverage, freshness); identify root causes and drive remediation.
Build monitoring systems and dashboards to track data quality trends across retailers, categories, and time periods.
Global Product ID (GPID) coverage & matching
Assess GPID (GTIN/UPC/EAN) coverage and accuracy across both catalog and sales transaction data; identify gaps by category, retailer, and brand.
Build and improve matching algorithms to link sales transactions to catalog products, handling missing GPIDs, naming inconsistencies, and category misclassification.
Quantify the impact of GPID enrichment and matching improvements on search, deduplication, and reporting accuracy.
Partner with external data providers and brands to improve GPID coverage and resolve identifier conflicts.
Deduplication & entity resolution
Identify product variants (size, color, packaging) and duplicates within and across retailer catalogs using clustering, entity resolution, embeddings, and similarity-based techniques.
Build scalable deduplication pipelines that handle catalog and transaction data at scale; define patterns, heuristics, and ML-based approaches for variant grouping.
Measure the impact of deduplication on search quality, recommendation accuracy, and reporting; iterate on models to reduce false positives and improve precision.
Support Data Engineering and Platform teams in productionizing deduplication and entity linking infrastructure.
Manufacturer data quality & brand engagement
Evaluate the consistency and accuracy of manufacturer-level attributes (brand name, MPN, manufacturer identifiers) across catalogs and transactions.
Detect systemic issues at the brand and retailer level; build scorecards and engage brands (via the Tiger Team) to drive data quality improvements.
Create feedback loops to measure manufacturer data quality and track progress on remediation initiatives.
Product search & retrieval infrastructure
Research and prototype improvements to product search and retrieval pipelines, including vector search, semantic similarity, and embedding-based matching.
Explore and implement vector database infrastructure (e.g., FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate) to support fast, scalable product retrieval and similarity search.
Contribute to the design and optimization of retrieval pipelines that combine text, attributes, and embeddings for search and recommendations.
Evaluate search relevance and ranking quality; iterate on indexing strategies, query preprocessing, and re-ranking models.
Product graph & relational modeling
Build and maintain product graph infrastructure that captures relationships between products, variants, brands, categories, retailers, and transactions.
Use graph-based techniques (community detection, link analysis, centrality) to identify product families, detect duplicates, and surface insights on product hierarchies.
Partner with Data Platform teams to design scalable graph storage and query patterns (e.g., Neo4j, graph extensions in BigQuery).
Insights, monitoring & reporting
Systematically identify, classify, and prioritize product data quality issues; create clear summaries, visualizations, and actionable recommendations for stakeholders.
Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reports for key product data KPIs (match rates, GPID coverage, duplicate rates, classification accuracy, attribute completeness).
Establish alerting and anomaly detection systems to proactively surface data quality degradation and model performance issues.
Engineering & production deployment
Take models and analytics prototypes from POC to production, with or without engineering partnership—owning deployment, testing, monitoring, and iteration.
Build robust, scalable data pipelines and ML workflows using production-grade tools and best practices (versioning, CI/CD, testing, observability).
Collaborate with MLOps and Data Engineering teams to ensure production readiness: reliability, latency, drift monitoring, and SLOs.
Qualifications
Required
Experience: 5+ years in data science, ML engineering, or analytics engineering, with at least 2+ years focused on product data, catalog quality, entity resolution, search/retrieval, or e-commerce/marketplace analytics.
Engineering strength: Proven ability to build production-grade data pipelines and deploy ML models independently; strong software engineering fundamentals (code quality, testing, version control, CI/CD).
Data quality expertise: Demonstrated experience analyzing and improving large-scale structured data quality (completeness, consistency, accuracy, deduplication, entity resolution).
ML & classification experience: Track record building and deploying classification models, ranking systems, or search/retrieval pipelines in production.
Technical skills:
Strong Python and SQL; proficiency with ML libraries (scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, PyTorch/TensorFlow) and data manipulation tools (pandas, PySpark).
Experience with entity resolution, fuzzy matching, clustering, embeddings, and similarity-based techniques (Levenshtein distance, cosine similarity, nearest-neighbor search).
Familiarity with production ML workflows (model versioning, monitoring, evaluation, retraining, A/B testing).
Experience with data profiling, anomaly detection, and exploratory analysis at scale.
Analytical rigor: Strong foundation in statistics and ML; ability to design experiments, validate models, interpret results, and communicate insights with business context.
Stakeholder collaboration: Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and business teams; ability to translate technical work into actionable recommendations.
Education: Bachelor's in a quantitative field (CS, Statistics, Math, Engineering, or similar); Master's/PhD preferred.
Preferred / Nice To Have
Experience with vector search and embeddings (sentence transformers, OpenAI embeddings, BERT-based models) and vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector).
Familiarity with search and retrieval systems (Elasticsearch, Solr, semantic search, BM25, hybrid ranking) and understanding how data quality impacts relevance.
Experience with graph databases and graph analytics (Neo4j, NetworkX, graph algorithms for clustering and link prediction).
Knowledge of NLP techniques for product data (text classification, named entity recognition, attribute extraction, title/description parsing, semantic similarity).
Experience with multimodal modeling (combining text, images, and structured attributes for classification or retrieval).
Familiarity with global product identifiers (GTIN/UPC/EAN, MPN, SKU hierarchies) and standards organizations (GS1, GDSN).
Experience with deduplication and record linkage at scale (blocking strategies, probabilistic matching, hierarchical clustering).
Familiarity with GCP tools (BigQuery, Vertex AI, Dataflow, Cloud Run, Looker) and/or Databricks/Spark for large-scale processing and deployment.
Exposure to master data management (MDM) or data governance practices in product or catalog contexts.
Experience with recommendation systems or understanding how product data quality impacts personalization and ranking.
What sets you apart
Product data obsession: You care deeply about data quality and understand how poor catalog hygiene cascades into user experience, business reporting, and operational inefficiencies.
Engineering mindset: You don't just build prototypes—you ship them. You write clean, tested, production-ready code and can own the full lifecycle from research to deployment.
Detective instincts: You love digging into messy data, finding patterns, and uncovering root causes—whether it's a systematic retailer issue, a subtle duplicate cluster, or a classification edge case.
Pragmatic prioritization: You balance comprehensiveness with impact, focusing on the 20% of issues that drive 80% of quality problems and business value.
Search & retrieval intuition: You understand how product data powers search and recommendations, and you know how to build infrastructure (embeddings, vector DBs, graphs) that makes these systems work at scale.
Stakeholder fluency: You translate messy data findings into clear, actionable recommendations and build trust with brands, retailers, Product, and Engineering teams.
Comfort with ambiguity: You thrive in evolving data ecosystems, defining your own quality metrics and technical roadmaps when the problem space is still being shaped.
Benefits and Perks:
At impact.com, we believe that when you’re happy and fulfilled, you do your best work. That’s why we’ve built a benefits package that supports your well-being, growth, and work-life balance.
Flexible Working: Our Responsible PTO policy means you can take the time off you need to rest and recharge. We're committed to a positive work-life balance and provide a flexible environment that allows you to be happy and fulfilled in both your career and your personal life.
Health and Wellness: Your well-being is a priority. Our mental health and wellness benefit includes up to 12 fully covered therapy/coaching sessions per year, with additional dependent coverage. We also offer a monthly gym reimbursement policy to support your physical health.
A Stake in Our Growth: We offer Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) as part of our total compensation, giving you a stake in the company's growth with a 3-year vesting schedule, pending Board approval.
Investing in Your Growth: We’re committed to your continuous learning. Take advantage of our free Coursera subscription and our PXA courses.
Parental Support: We offer a generous parental leave policy, 26 weeks of fully paid leave for the primary caregiver and 13 weeks fully paid leave for the secondary caregiver.
Technology Financial Support: We provide a technology stipend to help you set up your home office and a monthly allowance to cover your internet expenses

descriptions.title: Data Migration Architect
descriptions.description:
Location: Centurion, Gauteng (provisional – to be confirmed)
Positions Available: 5
Salary: Market-related
Employment Type: To be confirmed
Job Overview
We are seeking experienced and technically proficient Data Migration Architects to design, plan and oversee complex enterprise data migration and modernisation initiatives.
The successful candidates will be responsible for defining data migration architectures, developing migration strategies, designing data transformation and integration solutions, and ensuring the accurate, secure and reliable movement of data between legacy systems, enterprise applications, databases and modern cloud platforms.
This role requires strong hands-on expertise in enterprise data migration architecture, data mapping, ETL/ELT processes, SQL, database technologies, data quality, reconciliation, migration testing and cutover planning.
The ideal candidates will have successfully designed and delivered large-scale data migration programmes involving complex source and target systems, substantial data volumes, multiple business stakeholders and strict operational requirements.
Candidates must demonstrate the ability to assess existing data environments, develop migration roadmaps, define transformation rules, resolve data quality challenges and design migration solutions that minimise business disruption.
The role requires close collaboration with enterprise architects, data architects, data engineers, database administrators, application specialists, business analysts, project managers and business stakeholders.
This is a specialist architecture role requiring proven experience designing and leading enterprise data migrations. General data analysis, reporting, routine database administration or ETL development without substantial migration architecture experience will not be sufficient.
Key Responsibilities
Data Migration Architecture and Strategy
Design and maintain enterprise data migration architectures and technical strategies.
Assess legacy systems, source databases and target data environments.
Develop migration roadmaps, approaches and implementation plans.
Define migration patterns, frameworks, standards and reusable components.
Design migration solutions for on-premises, cloud and hybrid environments.
Evaluate migration complexity, dependencies and technical risks.
Define full-load, incremental, phased and parallel migration approaches.
Establish migration architecture principles and technical design standards.
Ensure migration designs align with enterprise architecture and business objectives.
Provide architectural leadership throughout migration programmes.
Source and Target System Assessment
Analyse source systems, databases, data structures and integration dependencies.
Assess target platform capabilities, constraints and data requirements.
Identify data inconsistencies, duplication, integrity issues and structural differences.
Evaluate data volumes, complexity, quality and transformation requirements.
Assess legacy data models and identify modernisation opportunities.
Document source-to-target relationships and technical dependencies.
Identify migration constraints affecting availability, performance or security.
Collaborate with system owners to validate data structures and business rules.
Assess archival, retention and historical data requirements.
Recommend appropriate migration technologies and implementation approaches.
Data Mapping and Transformation Design
Develop comprehensive source-to-target data mapping specifications.
Define data transformation, cleansing, enrichment and standardisation rules.
Design mappings between legacy and modern data models.
Establish data type conversion and schema transformation requirements.
Define business rules for migration processing.
Address referential integrity, relationships and dependency sequencing.
Design solutions for handling incomplete, inconsistent or duplicate records.
Ensure transformation logic is documented and traceable.
Collaborate with business analysts and subject matter experts to validate mappings.
Review mapping specifications for accuracy and completeness.
ETL/ELT and Data Integration Architecture
Design scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and migration integration frameworks.
Define data extraction, staging, transformation and loading approaches.
Select appropriate migration tools and integration technologies.
Design batch, incremental and change data capture migration patterns.
Support high-volume data processing and performance optimisation.
Establish error handling, logging, retry and recovery mechanisms.
Design secure connectivity between source and target environments.
Define data pipeline orchestration and scheduling requirements.
Review data engineering designs and migration implementation approaches.
Ensure integration solutions meet operational and technical requirements.
Database and Platform Migration
Architect migrations between relational and non-relational database platforms.
Support database consolidation, upgrades and platform modernisation.
Design migrations from legacy databases to cloud-managed database services.
Assess database schema compatibility and conversion requirements.
Define data movement and replication strategies.
Address performance, indexing and database optimisation considerations.
Support migration of large and complex enterprise datasets.
Evaluate database availability and downtime constraints.
Collaborate with DBAs on database migration and recovery procedures.
Ensure target environments are technically prepared for migrated data.
Cloud Data Migration and Modernisation
Design migrations to Microsoft Azure, AWS or equivalent cloud platforms.
Support modernisation of enterprise data warehouses and data platforms.
Architect migrations to cloud databases, data lakes and lakehouse environments.
Define cloud data ingestion and transformation patterns.
Evaluate migration options for hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
Support migration to platforms such as Azure SQL, Azure Synapse, Microsoft Fabric, Amazon RDS, Redshift, Snowflake or Databricks.
Ensure cloud migration designs consider scalability, performance and cost.
Implement appropriate data protection and access control requirements.
Design migration approaches that support future platform integration.
Collaborate with cloud architects and infrastructure teams.
Data Quality and Reconciliation
Establish data quality standards and migration acceptance criteria.
Define profiling, cleansing and validation requirements.
Design automated reconciliation and data integrity controls.
Ensure completeness and accuracy of migrated records.
Define record count, checksum, control total and business-rule validation approaches.
Identify and resolve data discrepancies between source and target systems.
Establish exception management and remediation processes.
Monitor data quality throughout migration execution.
Ensure migration outcomes meet agreed business and technical requirements.
Provide evidence of successful reconciliation and validation.
Migration Testing and Validation
Define migration testing strategies and quality assurance requirements.
Develop technical migration test scenarios and validation approaches.
Support functional, integration, performance and regression testing.
Design repeatable migration test cycles and rehearsal processes.
Establish acceptance criteria for migration readiness.
Validate data transformation logic and migration results.
Support testing of data volumes, throughput and processing times.
Identify defects and coordinate corrective actions.
Review migration testing evidence and readiness reports.
Ensure migration solutions meet business and operational expectations.
Cutover Planning and Production Migration
Develop detailed migration cutover strategies and execution plans.
Define migration sequencing, dependencies and critical milestones.
Assess downtime requirements and business continuity implications.
Establish rollback, recovery and contingency procedures.
Coordinate migration rehearsals and production readiness assessments.
Define go/no-go criteria and migration acceptance checkpoints.
Support production migration execution and technical coordination.
Monitor migration progress and resolve critical technical issues.
Validate post-migration data integrity and system readiness.
Support stabilisation and transition into business-as-usual operations.
Data Governance, Security and Compliance
Ensure migration architectures comply with organisational data governance standards.
Incorporate appropriate data security and privacy controls.
Define secure data extraction, transfer, staging and storage requirements.
Protect sensitive and confidential information during migration.
Apply data encryption and access control principles.
Support compliance with POPIA and other applicable regulatory requirements.
Establish data lineage and traceability throughout migration.
Address data retention, archival and disposal requirements.
Ensure appropriate audit trails and migration evidence.
Collaborate with security, risk and compliance teams.
Architecture Governance and Technical Leadership
Produce migration architecture documents and technical design specifications.
Present architecture proposals to technical stakeholders and governance forums.
Review migration solution designs and implementation plans.
Provide technical guidance to data engineers, developers and migration teams.
Establish reusable migration standards, templates and best practices.
Identify technical risks and recommend mitigation strategies.
Ensure migration designs align with enterprise data architecture.
Support architecture reviews and technical decision-making.
Resolve complex migration design and integration challenges.
Contribute to continuous improvement of migration capabilities.
Stakeholder and Project Collaboration
Work with business stakeholders to understand migration requirements.
Collaborate with data owners to define data quality and acceptance standards.
Support project planning, estimation and migration scheduling.
Communicate migration dependencies, risks and technical constraints.
Coordinate with application, database, infrastructure and cloud teams.
Support vendor and technology partner engagements.
Provide technical input into migration status reporting.
Participate in programme governance and planning meetings.
Ensure alignment between migration activities and business readiness.
Support knowledge transfer and post-migration handover.

Typically 7+ years of relevant experience in enterprise data environments, database technologies, data engineering or data integration.

Demonstrated involvement in successful end-to-end migration programmes, including architecture, mapping, testing, cutover and reconciliation.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with complex relational databases.
Practical expertise in source-to-target data mapping and transformation design.
Experience architecting ETL/ELT solutions and data migration pipelines.

Experience developing migration strategies, execution plans and rollback procedures.

Experience working with legacy enterprise systems and modern target platforms.

Strong technical documentation and solution design capabilities.

descriptions.description:
Who We Are
VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore.
VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.
For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on  LinkedIn #WeAreVML.
At VML, we are architects of connected brands and experiences for a changing world. We believe in the powerful synergy of creativity, technology, data, and culture to build brands that not only grow faster but also resonate deeply and personally with their customers. We are experts in marketing transformation, marketing science, and advanced marketing automation and personalization, relentlessly pushing the boundaries of what's possible.
We power over 350 million personalized experiences between brands and their customers every day. We achieve this by applying our deep expertise, leveraging strategic partnerships with the biggest technology platforms in the world, and by harnessing cutting-edge advancements in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Large Language Models. We work closely with our clients as true growth partners, helping them not just achieve their goals but redefine them for the future. This particular opportunity offers the chance to work directly with one of our tier-one automotive clients, a global brand powerhouse, helping shape their digital future.
Our global team of 4,000+ data specialists serves more than 150 markets across the globe. We operate with unwavering integrity, a profound respect for data privacy, and complete transparency. We champion new ideas and diverse perspectives, fostering a culture of creative bravery, open listening, positivity, and collective strength in all that we do. We are constantly evolving, empowering our clients to stay ahead in a rapidly accelerating digital landscape. Please note that UK working hours will be required for this role.
Overview
The Data Engineer, Marketing & Analytics, is a key technical contributor responsible for designing, building, and maintaining robust data pipelines and infrastructure that power VML's digital and media reporting and product analytics for our tier-one clients. This role focuses on ensuring high-quality, reliable, and accessible data for analysis, reporting, and advanced analytical initiatives, including feeding platforms like Amplitude.
You will leverage a modern data stack including Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Matillion for ETL/ELT, Snowflake as our cloud data warehouse, and Rudderstack for customer data ingestion. Your work will directly enable our analytics and data science teams to derive critical insights, fuel AI/ML applications, and provide robust data to product analytics platforms like Amplitude. Beyond pipeline development, you will also be responsible for monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimizing data workflows. This position requires strong engineering principles, a meticulous approach to data quality, and a collaborative spirit to work with cross-functional teams.
Responsibilities
As a Data Engineer, your duties will include, but will not be limited to, the following:
Data Pipeline Development: Design, develop, and implement scalable and reliable ETL/ELT pipelines using Matillion and GCP services (e.g., Cloud Functions, Cloud Storage, Big Query, Composer/Airflow) to ingest, transform, and load digital and media data into Snowflake.
Data Ingestion & Integration: Configure and manage data streams from various sources, including customer data platforms like Rudder stack, APIs (e.g., ad platforms, analytics tools), and other raw data feeds. Understand and integrate data from advanced omnichannel tagging and data collection systems, ensuring data readiness for tools like Amplitude.
Data Transformation & Modeling: Develop complex SQL transformations within Snowflake to clean, enrich, and model data for optimal performance and usability by reporting tools (e.g., Tableau, Amplitude) and analytical applications. Design and implement data schemas (star, snowflake, data vault) to support business requirements.
Infrastructure Management: Monitor, maintain, and optimize the performance, security, and cost-efficiency of our data infrastructure components across GCP and Snowflake.
Quality Assurance & Monitoring: Implement robust data quality checks, validation rules, and automated monitoring solutions for all data pipelines to ensure accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of data delivered to various platforms, including Amplitude. Troubleshoot and resolve data discrepancies and pipeline failures promptly.
Reporting & Visualization Support: Collaborate with analytics specialists and data visualization experts (e.g., those using Tableau and Amplitude) to ensure data models meet their reporting needs and are optimized for query performance.
Documentation & Governance: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for data pipelines, data models, schemas, and data dictionaries. Adhere to data governance best practices, including data privacy (GDPR, CCPA) and security standards.
Collaboration & Innovation: Work closely with data analysts, data scientists, product managers (who often use Amplitude), solution architects, and client teams to understand data requirements and translate them into technical solutions. Stay informed on emerging data engineering technologies, AI/ML data preparation techniques, and best practices.
Automation: Automate routine data management tasks, monitoring, and deployments where possible using scripting languages like Python.
Requirements
Minimum 5 years’ engineering and development experience
Strong Client-facing skills – responsive, results-driven, dedicated to customer support, and adept at consulting on complex technical and strategic data challenges.
Strong attention to detail, excellent organization skills, and ability to work independently and manage multiple projects/responsibilities and small teams in a fast-paced environment.
Exposure to enterprise-level clients and understanding of complex web/app ecosystems, privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA), and best practices for data governance.
In-depth knowledge and understanding of various client websites, mobile apps, their business models, and online marketing/product strategy.
Technical & Development Expertise
Cloud Platforms: Proven experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), particularly BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Cloud Functions, and orchestration tools like Cloud Composer (Apache Airflow).
Data Warehousing: Solid expertise in Snowflake including data loading, SQL querying, performance tuning, and schema design (star schema, snowflake schema).
ETL/ELT Tools: Strong hands-on experience designing and building data pipelines with Matillion (or similar tools like Fivetran, Stitch).
Customer Data Platforms (CDPs): Experience with Rudder stack for event collection, data routing, and destination management.
Product Analytics Platforms: Familiarity with or experience integrating data with Amplitude (or similar product analytics tools like Mixpanel, Pendo).
Programming & Scripting: Advanced proficiency in SQL for data manipulation and transformation. Experience with Python for scripting, automation, and API integrations.
BI & Reporting: Experience supporting data consumers using BI tools like Tableau (or Looker Studio, Power BI), understanding the data needs for dashboarding, and the data structures required by Amplitude.
Data Collection & Integration: Experience integrating data from various sources, including APIs (REST, GraphQL), SFTP, and understanding of event-driven data architectures, especially from advanced tagging and data collection systems.
Data Modeling: Practical experience with data modeling techniques for analytical databases.
Version Control: Proficiency with Git and modern software development practices.
Beneficial: Experience with other cloud platforms (AWS, Azure), knowledge of containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), or exposure to streaming data technologies (Kafka).
Functional & Domain Expertise
Marketing & Product Data: Strong understanding of digital marketing data (e.g., ad impressions, clicks, conversions), media reporting metrics, product usage data (e.g., events, user flows as seen in Amplitude), and customer journey data.
Data Governance: Familiarity with data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) and best practices for data security and compliance.
Analytics Ecosystem: Understanding of how data engineering supports analytics, reporting, and machine learning initiatives across various platforms including Amplitude.
Leadership & Interpersonal Skills
Client Engagement: Demonstrated experience as a senior consultant, engaging directly with clients to gather requirements, present solutions, and manage expectations.
Communication: Exceptional written and oral communication skills, capable of authoring complex technical specifications, blueprints, and proposals, and confidently leading technical discussions.
Problem-Solving: Proven ability to work collaboratively as part of a team to solve complex problems in varied, fast-paced environments.
Project Management Acumen: Experience working effectively within a project management office framework.
Methodologies: Familiarity and experience with best practice development methodologies.
Adaptability: Ability to instill confidence through maturity, expertise, and impeccable communications.

Job Description
Junior Data Engineer — EasyPay
Location: Cape Town, hybrid
Type: Permanent, full-time
Reports to: Head of Data
About Lesaka
Lesaka Technologies is a Southern African fintech building the connected ecosystem for financial inclusion — transactional banking, lending, insurance, payments and cash management for merchants, consumers and enterprise clients across the region. We're publicly listed (Nasdaq: LSAK / JSE: LSK) and growing fast. EasyPay powers airtime, data, electricity, lotto and 600+ bill payments through the largest retail footprint in South Africa.
The role
EasyPay's transaction volumes generate data at serious scale, and that data needs to be clean, reliable and fast to query. You'll join the data team to build and maintain the pipelines that move transaction, merchant and reconciliation data from source systems into our warehouse — giving product, finance and risk teams data they can trust.
What you'll own
Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest transactional data into our warehouse
Write and optimise SQL to transform raw data into usable, well-modelled tables
Monitor pipeline health and fix data quality issues before they reach downstream users
Support data engineers and analysts with clean, documented datasets
Contribute to version-controlled, tested data pipeline code
Help maintain data pipeline documentation and lineage
What you bring
1-2 years' experience in a data engineering, analytics engineering, or backend data role
Strong SQL skills — comfortable writing and debugging complex queries
Working knowledge of Python for scripting and data transformation
Exposure to a modern data warehouse (e.g. Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar)
Understanding of version control (Git) and basic CI/CD concepts
Comfortable working with large, messy, real-world transactional data
Nice to have
Experience with orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, or similar)
Exposure to streaming data (Kafka, Kinesis)
Interest or background in payments, fintech, or transaction processing
Our culture — what we expect from you
Lesaka is a fast-paced fintech. The people who thrive here have a few things in common:
Ownership. You don't wait to be asked. If something is broken or unclear, you call for the ball and fix it.
Fast adaptation. Priorities shift, markets move, regulations change. You don't flinch — you re-plan and move.
Execution mindset. Ideas are cheap. Shipping is the job. You walk slow, run fast: think it through, then move with urgency.
Customer first. The merchant, consumer or enterprise client is why we exist. Your decisions trace back to them.

We employ approximately 13,000 people and operate in 60 countries. Through our pioneering and sustainable share-and-reuse business model, the world’s biggest brands trust us to help them transport their goods more efficiently, safely and with less environmental impact.
What does that mean for you? You’ll join an international organization big enough to take you anywhere, and small enough to get you there sooner. The Master Data Analyst (MD Analyst) position delivers support to internal and external customers for the efficient creation and maintenance of CHEPs Customer Master Data across the AMETA region. The role of the Master Data Analyst is to manage and ensure the accuracy, integrity, and consistency of an organization's master data. The Master Data Analyst plays a critical role in data governance and data management initiatives, ensuring that master data is accurately maintained and consistently applied though auditing of Customer and Pricing Master.

descriptions.title: Senior Data Analyst
descriptions.description:
We're an Irish retail business starting an end-to-end process optimisation and data & technology modernisation programme. Over the next three years we'll map how we actually operate across retail, supply chain and business operations, fix what's broken in the data underneath it, and build the data warehouse and reporting layer that finally lets us see the whole business at once.
You'd join at the start, as part of the core programme team, and stay for the journey. Fully remote from South Africa.
WHAT YOU'D DO
- Map the current data landscape and every source system, side by side with the Business Analysts
- Profile every source properly – what exists, who owns it, how complete and accurate it actually is – measured from the data itself, not from what people believe is true
- Start fixing it: data cleansing and integrity work at source, rather than patched downstream
- Feed what you find back into the process design – a field that's half populated is a capture problem, not just a reporting gap
- Provide a limited, bounded ad hoc analysis service to the business while discovery runs
- Quantify the improvement opportunities so the business case rests on measured numbers, not estimates
- Work with the project team through the data warehouse build, AI automation work and new reporting – modelling, source-to-target validation, testing, and reporting the business will actually use
WHAT YOU'D BRING
- 5+ years as a Data Analyst across multiple source systems, not inside a single application
- Strong SQL – you profile data yourself rather than waiting for someone to send you an extract
- Real data profiling and quality assessment experience, and the judgement to say plainly what a source can and cannot support
- Data cleansing and remediation, including getting things fixed at source
- A BI tool to production standard – Power BI, Tableau, Qlik or equivalent
- Practical dimensional modelling – facts, dimensions, grain, hierarchies
- Comfortable building without an existing data model, warehouse or reporting layer
- A track record of working well in a distributed team, across countries and functions
- Based in South Africa with the right to work here
NICE TO HAVE
Retail, supply chain or distribution background · cloud data platform exposure (Azure or Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, GCP) · Python or R · client-side data warehouse implementation · platform or vendor evaluation · data governance or master data · dbt or similar · ERP or core retail systems data
THE OFFER
- Three-year fixed term, with the possibility of extension or permanent placement
- Market-related package
- Fully remote from anywhere in South Africa
- Core overlap 09:00–16:00 Irish time – we're only an hour or two apart, so you get a full working day with the team rather than a window at the edge of it
- Travel to Ireland at our cost

descriptions.title: Data Quality Assurance Analyst
descriptions.description:
Position Overview:
One of our prestige clients is seeking a detail-oriented Data Quality Assurance Analyst to help ensure the accuracy, completeness, consistency, and reliability of data products.
The Data Quality Assurance Analyst will review and validate large datasets, investigate potential data quality issues, document findings, and work closely with data engineering, data science, product, and operations teams to improve data.
This position requires someone who enjoys investigating data, identifying anomalies, understanding why errors occur, and establishing systematic processes to prevent them from recurring.
The successful candidate will combine careful manual investigation with data analysis and automated quality-control techniques.
Key Responsibilities:
Perform quality assurance testing on our datasets and data products before and after production releases.
Evaluate data for accuracy, completeness, consistency, validity, uniqueness, timeliness, and referential integrity.
Identify anomalies, missing information, duplicate records, incorrect classifications, inconsistent values, and other potential data quality problems.
Validate business and entity information against authoritative or reliable external sources.
Conduct sample-based and systematic testing across large datasets.
Investigate reported data issues and determine their root causes.
Develop and maintain data-quality rules, validation criteria, test cases, and QA procedures.
Work with data engineers to translate identified problems into automated validation and monitoring rules.
Perform regression testing following changes to data pipelines, matching algorithms, source data, schemas, or transformation logic.
Monitor data-quality metrics and identify unexpected changes or deterioration in data quality.
Evaluate entity matching, deduplication, standardization, classification, and record-linkage results.
Review company names, addresses, identifiers, industry classifications, geographic information, entity relationships, and other key attributes for logical consistency.
Document data issues clearly, including examples, severity, potential causes,affected records, and recommended remediation.
Maintain issue logs and track data-quality problems through resolution.
Help establish measurable data-quality benchmarks and acceptance thresholds for BQ products.
Collaborate with Data Engineering, Data Science, Product, and Operations teams to continuously improve data quality.
Required Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in data analytics, information systems, computer science, economics, statistics, business, accounting, or a related field.
Strong attention to detail and ability to identify subtle inconsistencies in data.
Strong analytical and investigative skills.
Experience working with structured datasets, databases, spreadsheets, or data-management systems.
Ability to understand relationships among businesses, legal entities, locations, people, and other real-world entities.
Ability to document findings clearly and communicate technical data problems to both technical and nontechnical colleagues.
Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple QA investigations simultaneously.
Ability to work independently while following established QA procedures and escalation processes.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience with one or more of the following is highly desirable:
SQL and relational databases
Python or another scripting language
Data profiling and validation
Data cleansing and standardization
Entity resolution and record linkage
Master Data Management (MDM)
Knowledge graphs or graph databases
Business and legal-entity data
Address standardization and geospatial data
Data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes
Automated data testing
Statistical sampling
Data-quality monitoring and dashboards
Government, financial, economic, or commercial datasets
AI, machine learning, RAG, or Graph RAG data preparation
Key Data Quality Dimensions
The employee will help systematically measure and improve: Accuracy — Does the data correctly represent the real-world entity? Completeness —Are important attributes and relationships present?
Consistency — Does the same information agree across records, datasets, and sources? Validity — Does the data conform to expected formats, ranges, schemas, and business rules? Uniqueness — Are duplicate entities appropriately identified and resolved?
Timeliness — Is the information sufficiently current for its intended use?
Referential Integrity— Are relationships among entities and identifiers valid?
Traceability — Can important data elements be traced to their sources and processing history?
Performance Measures
Success in this role may be evaluated using measurable indicators such as:
Data-quality issue detection rate
Accuracy of QA findings
False-positive and false-negative rates
Percentage of identified issues successfully resolved
Recurrence rate of previously identified problems
Coverage of automated validation rules
Dataset accuracy and completeness metrics
Time required to investigate and resolve data-quality issues
Quality and completeness of QA documentation
Improvements in data-quality metrics over time
Ideal Candidate:
The ideal candidate has an investigative mind set and is naturally skeptical of data that does not make sense.
They do not simply identify that a value is wrong—they want to determine why it is wrong, how many records are affected, where the problem originated, and how we can prevent the problem from happening again.
This person should be comfortable moving between detailed record-level investigation and broader analysis of millions of records. They should understand that high-quality AI and analytics ultimately depend on high-quality underlying data.
Where to Apply:
Send CV's to: Joshua.dukhi@officebeacon.com

Location: Stellenbosch/Remote

BACKGROUND
Founded in 1997 by President Nelson Mandela, HRH Prince Bernhard of the Netherlands and Dr Anton Rupert, Peace Parks Foundation is a non-profit organisation pioneering conservation at scale across southern Africa.
Working through Transfrontier Conservation Areas that span national borders, Peace Parks connects protected areas, supports biodiversity conservation and ecological resilience, strengthens local economies and promotes regional peace and stability. Its holistic approach is built on three pillars: conservation at scale, community development and conservation finance, ensuring that protected areas deliver long-term ecological and economic value.
To date, Peace Parks has supported governments in establishing 780 000 km² of Transfrontier Conservation Areas across southern Africa. It also co-manages eight parks where wildlife populations have rebounded fivefold and supports more than 280 000 people annually through its interventions. With formal government mandates and strong community partnerships, Peace Parks offers a proven model for building resilience for people and nature across southern Africa’s most significant landscapes.
The Foundation’s Vision 2050 is to secure 17 fully functional transboundary landscapes spanning
980 000 km², making it one of the world’s largest land-based conservation initiatives.
www.peaceparks.org
Job Purpose
The Data Coordinator is a specialist technical role within the Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning Department, reporting to the Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning Manager, responsible for managing, maintaining, and optimizing foundational data systems, impact tracking tools, and reporting dashboards. The role ensures the efficient collection, cleaning, validation, and reporting of accurate and timely field-level and program data in alignment with organizational standards. Through direct collaboration with field and program teams, the Data Coordinator maintains reliable data collection methods, provides practical operational support, and generates reports, visualizations, and analytical insights to inform program management, support strategic decision-making, and drive continuous organizational learning and operational improvements.

Document system workflows, structures, and updates to ensure continuity and sustainability.

Ensure data submission protocols are followed and support field teams in strengthening data accuracy and completeness.
Conduct basic-intermediate data analysis to identify trends, errors, and insights.
Produce routine reports, visualisations, and summaries for program teams and management decision-making.
Undertake regular field visits to verify data quality, understand operational contexts, and strengthen local data systems.
MEL Coordination & Support

descriptions.title: ServiceNow Data and CMDB Specialist
descriptions.description:
Keen to become part of a truly global, collaborative team of professionals? Your journey begins here.
Role Overview
The ServiceNow Data and CMDB Specialist is responsible for the governance, quality and ongoing development of data held within the ServiceNow platform, with particular responsibility for the Configuration Management Database (CMDB), service data, and reporting and insight delivered through or sourced from ServiceNow.
The role makes sure Configuration Items (CIs), their relationships and supporting service data are accurate, complete and kept up to date. This provides a reliable source of information for service management processes, operational decision-making, risk management, automation and the introduction of new services and technologies.
The role also oversees the quality of data supplied to ServiceNow by other systems. Working with source system owners and integration teams, the role holder establishes clear ownership, agreed data standards and appropriate controls. They do not own the source systems but are responsible for identifying and coordinating the resolution of issues that affect the quality of data used within ServiceNow.
ServiceNow is an enterprise-wide platform supporting Business Teams and functions across the firm, including Information Technology, M&BD, Finance, People, Knowledge, the Office of the General Counsel, Operations and Communications. It operates across one production and four sub-production instances and includes a broad range of ServiceNow products, custom scoped applications and enterprise integrations. The Service Portal is available to all users across the firm.
The right candidate brings practical ServiceNow CMDB and reporting experience, strong analytical skills and the ability to build effective working relationships. They are comfortable managing their own workload, investigating complex data issues and making recommendations based on the available evidence.
Key Responsibilities
Specific duties or responsibilities may be reviewed from time to time to reflect changes in personnel and management structure, staff location or services. All members of the firm participate in our Responsible Business program. 
Own the governance, quality and ongoing maturity of the ServiceNow CMDB, making sure CI data and relationships are accurate, complete, current and fit for purpose, and maintain the CMDB data model, CI classes, attributes, relationships and lifecycle standards in line with ServiceNow best practice and the Common Service Data Model (CSDM). 
Own the service mapping data model, governance and quality standards, working with service owners and Platform Engineering to make sure business applications, application services, technical services and supporting infrastructure are recorded and related at the appropriate level. 
Work with service, application, infrastructure and data owners to agree ownership, data requirements and responsibilities for maintaining configuration and service data, and maintain appropriate controls for creating, updating, reconciling, retiring and deleting CIs. 
Monitor CMDB health through regular data-quality reviews covering completeness, correctness, compliance, duplication, stale records and missing or inaccurate relationships, investigate root causes and work with the relevant owners to agree and track corrective action.
Establish governance standards for data supplied to ServiceNow by other systems, including authoritative sources, ownership, definitions, quality expectations and frequency of updates, and maintain a clear record of the main data sources, owners, integration dependencies and agreed controls. 
Work with source-system owners and integration teams to understand how data moves between systems, monitor and reconcile data received through inbound feeds and integrations, and coordinate corrective action where issues are found. 
Consider data-governance requirements when new integrations, services and automation are being designed, and work with the Principal ServiceNow Developer, ServiceNow Solutions Developer and Senior ServiceNow Platform Specialist to make sure integrations, discovery sources, imports and automated feeds update ServiceNow data correctly. 
Define and validate CMDB and data requirements for platform changes and integrations, and support the effective use of ServiceNow Discovery, Service Mapping and other tools used to populate and maintain the CMDB. 
Work with asset owners to maintain appropriate alignment between configuration and asset data, without taking ownership of the underlying asset-management processes. 
Represent CMDB, data-governance and reporting considerations in relevant project, design and change discussions, and promote the effective use of CMDB and service data across Incident, Problem, Change, Asset and other relevant ServiceNow processes. 
Own the standards and governance for ServiceNow reporting, and develop shared, cross-platform and management reports, dashboards and performance measures, working with stakeholders and the ServiceNow Engagement and Enablement Lead to translate requirements into agreed measures. 
Agree definitions and calculation methods for key performance indicators and operational measures, validate reporting against the underlying data before it is released or materially changed, and analyse platform and service-management data to identify trends, risks and opportunities for improvement. 
Review existing reports and dashboards to remove or consolidate content that is duplicated or no longer needed and support the controlled use of ServiceNow data by reporting and analytics platforms such as Power BI or Microsoft Fabric, keeping definitions, ownership and quality controls consistent when data is shared or extracted. 
Support the data quality and governance foundations needed for approved ServiceNow AI capabilities such as Now Assist, making sure CMDB and service data are accurate and well-structured enough to be used reliably by AI-driven search, insight and automation. 
Maintain documentation covering the CMDB data model, data sources, ownership, governance standards, reporting definitions, controls and operating procedures, and help users make effective use of ServiceNow data, reports and dashboards. 
Keep up to date with relevant ServiceNow capabilities and industry practices relating to CMDB, CSDM, service mapping, data governance and reporting, act in accordance with the firm's information security, data protection and records-management policies, and report any potential or actual security risks or events. 
Help build a supportive workplace where colleagues can do their best work and take part in the firm's Responsible Business program.
Skills & Experience
Experience 
Typically, at least five years' relevant ServiceNow experience, including practical experience in CMDB, configuration management and platform data. 
Strong working knowledge of ServiceNow CMDB, including CI classes, relationships, lifecycle management, data quality and governance. 
Good understanding of CSDM and how service, application and infrastructure data should be structured and related within ServiceNow. 
Experience of ServiceNow Discovery, Service Mapping, Identification and Reconciliation Engine principles, imports and integration data sources. 
Hands-on experience maintaining or improving a CMDB within a medium-to-large organisation, including work with CI classes, relationships, data sources, reconciliation, data-quality controls and remediation. 
Practical experience creating ServiceNow reports and dashboards, turning business requirements into meaningful measures, and checking that reports, dashboards and performance measures are accurate. 
Good understanding of data models, data relationships, data ownership, authoritative sources and data-quality management. 
Experience of Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, SQL or another reporting and analytics tool. 
Good understanding of IT service management and how reliable configuration and service data supports Incident, Problem, Change, Asset and Service Level Management. 
Experience considering how data quality and governance underpin ServiceNow AI capabilities such as Now Assist is desirable, including an understanding of the data foundations that AI-driven search, insight and automation depend on. 
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex data issues and recommend practical solutions. 
Experience governing data exchanged between multiple systems. 
Experience working with technical and non-technical data owners to resolve data-quality issues and improve accountability.
Qualifications 
Relevant practical ServiceNow CMDB, data-governance and reporting experience is more important than holding every listed qualification. 
ServiceNow Certified System Administrator certification or equivalent practical platform experience would be beneficial. 
ServiceNow training or certification relating to CMDB, CSDM, Discovery, Service Mapping, Performance Analytics or reporting would be beneficial.
Skills 
Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain data, CMDB and reporting concepts to technical and non-technical audiences. 
Builds positive and collaborative relationships across the firm and adapts their communication to suit the audience. 
Takes ownership, follows through on agreed actions and uses evidence and sound judgement when making decisions or recommendations. 
Acts with integrity when managing data, presenting results and raising risks or areas of non-compliance. 
Responds positively to change and looks for practical ways to improve the quality and value of ServiceNow data and reporting. 
Shares knowledge and helps colleagues make effective use of ServiceNow data and reporting, contributing to a supportive workplace where people can perform at their best.

descriptions.title: Data Governance Analyst (Group Technology)
descriptions.description:
About the role
The Data Governance Analyst is accountable for designing and implementing data governance frameworks that optimise the integrity, compliance, and value of data assets. The role translates business policies into controls, ensuring Alexforbes’ data management solutions are secure, auditable, and aligned with evolving regulatory requirements, internal standards, and industry best practices. Working with technology and business stakeholders, the role develops, maintains, and enforces data governance standards, ensuring every activity from definition to disposal of data meets regulatory mandates. The role ensures regular assessment of protocols, processes, and procedures, collaborating on drafting new policies to address legal, operational, and technology risks.
Central to the role is ensuring ongoing risk management, with documented strategies for monitoring, reporting, and controlling emerging data-related risks. The role proactively assesses regulatory changes, coordinates timely updates to all governance documentation, and owns the identification, escalation, and remediation responsibilities related to data risk and compliance exposures. A key responsibility includes audit management, wherein the analyst facilitates regulatory reviews, internal audits, and external assessments.
The role supports preparation, documentation, and post-audit action planning, ensuring all findings are incorporated into governance frameworks and staff are informed and supported to remediate any detected gaps.
The role builds comprehensive data quality management programs, defining benchmarks, developing quality monitoring processes, and reporting data health metrics to interested business and technology stakeholders. The role identifies root causes for data anomalies, facilitates intervention by data stewards, and helps embed continuous improvement into every data pipeline and workflow.
Qualifications:
National Senior Certificate - Matric/Grade 12 or equivalent
Bachelor’s Degree - Information Technology or related field (3 years - 360 credits)
Certification - Relevant industry specific DAMA and ISACA training and professional certification would apply to this role.
Experience:
3 - 5 years’ experience in data quality management, policy governance updates, risk compliance oversight, audit management support and capability maturity evaluations.
Experience Required:
Essential
Data quality management - 3 Years experience
Policy governance updates - 3 Years experience
Risk compliance oversight - 3 Years experience
Audit management support - 2 years’ experience
Capability maturity evaluations - 2 years’ experience
Waivers Breach Management - 2 years’ experience
Governance Forum Leadership - 3 Years experience
Stewardship Session Facilitation - 2 years’ experience
Logical Access Management - 3 Years experience
Advantageous
Data Usage Analytics - 2 years’ experience
Capability maturity evaluations - 2 years’ experience
Key Performance Area:
Data quality management
Develop and enforce data quality programs, set monitoring standards for accuracy and completeness, report integrity metrics to business stakeholders, investigate anomalies, and drive process improvements to deliver reliable, valuable analytics and informed business decisions.
Staff training effectiveness
Design, deliver, and continuously improve staff training and awareness for governance, compliance, and data handling. Track engagement, effectiveness, and knowledge retention to develop enterprise data culture in alignment with regulatory requirements and business objectives.
Risk compliance proactivity
Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate data governance risks by developing, monitoring, and updating compliance controls. Partner with legal and risk teams to resolve gaps and ensure accountable performance to GDPR, POPIA, etc., or other regulatory requirements for data management.
Audit management outcomes
Manage audit readiness and responses, facilitate regulatory/internal/external review cycles, prepare mandated records, track findings, and lead remediation planning, ensuring all corrective improvements are documented, communicated, and embedded into governance protocols and frameworks.
Data standards drafting
Draft, update, and communicate data standards, policies, and classification protocols for metadata, lineage, definitions, and usage. Ensure standards reflect evolving regulatory, operational, and business requirements, monitor their application, and measure outcome effectiveness for compliance.
Policy governance updates
Author, review, and maintain data governance policy documentation, ensure all updates are communicated and accessible, track implementation, drive change management, and collaborate with stakeholders to close policy gaps, securing adherence and best-practice data governance outcomes.
Waiver breach management
Administer waiver, breach, and dispensation management for data governance exceptions. Monitor requests, justification, and approval cycles, report incidents, coordinate remediation, and maintain transparent records of exceptions to support audit, compliance, and ongoing risk reduction efforts.
Maturity assessment execution
Lead regular capability maturity assessments using DAMA methodology. Evaluate strengths, gaps, and overall progression of governance practices, report findings to stakeholders, and coordinate improvement initiatives to enhance organisational data maturity and governance robustness.
Governance forums leadership
Facilitate cross-functional forums to align data governance goals, clarify responsibilities, discuss risks, track progress, and escalate decisions. Document actions, monitor follow-up, and ensure transparent stakeholder engagement and performance accountability for forum-deliberated priorities.
Stewardship sessions facilitation
Create, lead, and track data stewardship working sessions. Set measurable objectives, document actions, enable skills transfer, monitor attendance and results, and ensure stewardship responsibilities are integrated into workflow processes for ongoing enterprise data quality improvement and compliance.
Logical access management
Oversee assignment and periodic review of data system access, validate data virtualisation controls, audit level changes and removals, ensure compliance to access policies, and promptly revoke unneeded rights to maintain secure, reliable, and compliant enterprise data infrastructure.
Data usage monitoring
Track, analyse, and report on enterprise data usage, patterns, anomalies, and trends. Provide insights to stakeholders, signal root causes for unexpected spikes or issues, recommend changes to governance controls, and inform investment priorities for robust, secure data infrastructure.
