descriptions.title: Business Analyst (Private Markets)
descriptions.description:
Sonata One is a rapidly scaling, regulated fund services and technology (fintech) business. We're The Private Funds Clearinghouse, connecting more than 53,000 investors with 6,500 funds and 180 fund managers around the globe. Our vision is to change the paradigm of private markets investing through harmonising the end-to-end investment process within one platform. Investors benefit from a seamless, one & done experience across the fund lifecycle (from fund selection and subscription through to settlement and reporting) underpinned by a globally compliant KYC passport and 24/5 support. Fund managers can raise capital faster at a lower cost from a wider pool of pre-approved investors. Founded in 2015, Sonata One has a presence in eight locations worldwide including the US, UK and Luxembourg, Guernsey, South Africa and Mauritius.
We operate as #OneGlobalThread in line with our values: We challenge the norm, we change the way we think and work, by connecting systems and people, while committing to our vision and each other. We are now looking to recruit a Business Analyst to join our global team.
Position Overview:
We are hiring a Business Analyst to play a key role in the implementation and ongoing management of Sonata One's solutions for our clients.
This is an internally focused role within our Implementation team, responsible for how Sonata One itself operates. The BA is responsible for design, documentation and improving our internal processes, so that every service line runs in a consistent, controlled and scalable way. This includes working alongside our learning and development team ensuring our people are trained to deliver those processes well.
This is a varied role sitting at the intersection of implementation, operations, CRM and technology. You will work directly with our internal stakeholders, namely the technology and operations function to understand their requirements, processes and objectives, translating these into clear business requirements and actionable plans.
This is a critical role to the scaling and success of Sonata One. We are transforming into a larger business which requires structure at all levels. You will be a trusted internal advisor, helping senior members of the team understand how Sonata One works, identifying and opportunities to improve processes and ensuring that implementations are delivered effectively.
The role will suit someone who is structured, logical, enjoys working with people, asking questions, understanding how businesses operate and turning complex requirements into clear, structured solutions.
Responsibilities
Process Mapping
Map current-state processes across service lines: Subscription, KYC/AML, Tax, Transfer Agency and investor portal
Understand and identify the gaps that exist in our existing processes, specifically between teams and the interplay between functions
Design target state processes that are standardised, efficient and scalable. We operate as one global team and do not necessarily need different procedures for different jurisdictions
Revamp and maintain our central process library: process maps, standard operating procedures, guides, and policies, including any newly developed documentation.
Working with the implementation manager to define an effective client lifecycle. Map workflow from business development to Implementation and ongoing BAU
Build strong relationships with client stakeholders and act as a key point of contact throughout implementation projects
Gather, document and analyse business and functional requirements
Translate internal requirements into clear actions, processes and deliverables for internal teams, specifically technology and operation
Identify dependencies, risks, issues and potential blockers and work collaboratively to resolve them
Gap analysis and continuous improvement
Find gaps, bottlenecks, manual workarounds and control weaknesses in how we operate today.
Prioritise improvements by impact, risk and effort, and build the business case where investment is needed.
Track improvement initiatives through to delivery and measure the benefits.
Turn feedback from client implementations, passed on by the external BA, into internal fixes.
Internal training and enablement
Work with the learning and development lead to design and deliver training for Sonata One staff on processes, systems and controls.
Build onboarding pathways for new joiners in each team
Check understanding and adherence through refreshers and spot checks, in partnership with team leads
Technology and data
Work with the externally facing BA to define requirements for system enhancements, and automation
Work with technology and product teams on testing and roll-out of internal changes
Support management information (MI) and KPI reporting on process performance.
Business Analysis
Facilitate workshops, meetings and discovery sessions with internal stakeholders
Work with the CTO, Head of Product, Director Of Operations and MD of Growth to establish business priorities for any system changes required to deliver
Map and document current-state and future-state processes
Translate business requirements into clear and actionable documentation
Ensure requirements are understood consistently across clients, Implementation, Operations, CRM and Technology
Experience Required:
Experience working as a Business Analyst in an operational, process improvement or business transformation environment
Proven experience mapping, redesigning and documenting internal processes, ideally across multiple teams or service lines
Strong understanding of change delivery and the ability to manage multiple improvement initiatives and priorities at once
Experience working with internal stakeholders, including operations, compliance and technology teams
Ability to understand complex operational processes and turn them into clear process maps, and training materials
Comfortable working with team leads and senior stakeholders, and bringing people along through process change
Ability to balance the needs of individual teams with consistency, control and scalability across the wider business
Strong understanding of:
Business analysis methodologies and techniques, including translating complex requirements into practical steps
Client implementation and onboarding
Process mapping and process improvement
Stakeholder management and client communication
Technology-enabled business processes
Financial services or fintech environments
Experience within fintech or financial services is important for this position, particularly where candidates have worked with regulated environments, complex client onboarding or technology-enabled financial processes. Experience within private markets, fund administration, investor onboarding or adjacent financial services environments would be advantageous.
Personal Attributes
Highly client-focused, with a genuine desire to understand and solve client problems
Naturally curious and comfortable asking questions to get to the root of an issue
Strong communicator who can build relationships with both clients and internal stakeholders
Highly organised with strong attention to detail
Comfortable managing multiple projects, priorities and stakeholders simultaneously
Commercially aware and able to understand the wider impact of decisions
Confident challenging existing processes and suggesting better ways of working
Proactive, solutions-focused and comfortable working in an environment where things are continually evolving
Collaborative and willing to work across functions to get things done
Hungry to learn, develop and make an impact within a growing business
Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Technology or a related field preferred but not essential with relevant experience
Business Analysis, Project Management or related professional qualifications are advantageous
Relevant experience within fintech, financial services or another regulated industry is highly desirable
Being part of Sonata One provides a collaborative and inclusive work culture that values innovation and diversity. We believe in the power of our unique mission and we all work together towards that one single goal. We also believe in being real. We're not a big corporate. Everyone has an important role to fulfil, and your contribution will be an integral part of our success story.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Our Travelstart team is looking for an experienced Python Developer to join our Technology team and help build, improve and support the systems that power Travelstart’s products, platforms and operational services.
This is a hands-on engineering role with a strong focus on backend development, APIs, integrations and automation.
You’ll work as part of a cross-functional technology team, collaborating with Engineering, Product, Data and Operations to turn business and product requirements into reliable, scalable software.
We’re open to appointing at either mid or senior level, depending on your experience and technical capability.
For a strong mid-level developer, this is an opportunity to broaden your technical ownership and work across increasingly complex systems.
For a senior developer, we’re looking for someone comfortable operating independently, influencing technical design and helping raise engineering standards across the team.
Location: Cape Town, South Africa (Our office is located in Gardens)
What you’ll do
In This Role, You’ll
Design, develop and maintain backend applications and services using Python.
Build and support APIs and integrations across internal and third-party systems.
Develop software that is scalable, maintainable, secure and suited to a high-volume transactional environment.
Translate product and business requirements into practical technical solutions.

Participate in technical design and solution discussions.
Write automated tests and participate in peer code reviews.
Work within our established source-control, CI/CD and deployment processes.

Improve system performance, reliability, monitoring and observability.
Work within an Agile delivery environment and contribute to continuous team and process improvement.
Work with third-party technology providers, platforms and suppliers.
Share knowledge and contribute to the broader capability of the Engineering team.
At senior level, you’ll also be expected to contribute meaningfully to architecture and solution-design decisions, identify technical risks and improvement opportunities, and provide guidance and mentoring to less experienced developers.
What we’re looking for
You’ll Ideally Bring
Strong professional experience developing software using Python.
Experience building backend applications, APIs and integration services.
Experience with Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Django, Flask or similar.
A solid understanding of REST APIs and service-based architectures.
Good SQL and relational database experience.
Experience with Git and modern source-control practices.
Experience with automated testing.
Exposure to CI/CD pipelines.
Experience working in containerised environments such as Docker.
Experience working with cloud-based applications or deployment environments.
A good understanding of application performance, scalability and security.
Experience developing and supporting production software.
Experience working in an Agile or iterative development environment.
A relevant tertiary qualification in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline is advantageous, but practical experience and demonstrated capability matter more to us than a specific qualification.
We would typically expect around 4+ years of professional software-development experience, although we place greater value on the complexity of the work you’ve done, the ownership you’ve taken and the quality of your technical judgement than on an exact number of years.
Nice to have
Experience With Any Of The Following Would Be Advantageous
PostgreSQL, MySQL or similar relational databases.
Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka or similar caching, messaging or event-driven technologies.
Distributed systems or microservice architectures.
High-volume transactional platforms.
Travel, e-commerce or fintech environments.
AI tools and AI-enabled development workflows.
What matters to us
Beyond the technical skills, we’re looking for someone who:
Takes ownership and follows problems through to resolution.
Thinks beyond the immediate coding task and considers the wider system impact.
Approaches complex problems logically and pragmatically.
Makes sensible technical trade-offs rather than over-engineering solutions.
Cares about reliable, maintainable software.
Communicates technical issues clearly with both technical and non-technical colleagues.
Raises risks, dependencies and concerns early.
Is comfortable learning new technologies and adapting as our technology environment evolves.
Contributes positively to the team and shares knowledge with others.
Mid or Senior?
We’re intentionally keeping the role open across both levels.
As a Mid-Level Python Developer, you’ll generally be comfortable working independently on well-defined features and services, taking ownership of applications or components and contributing effectively to technical discussions and code reviews.
As a Senior Python Developer, we’ll expect greater autonomy across complex or ambiguous requirements, ownership of significant services or systems, contribution to architecture and solution design, and the ability to guide and support other developers.
For us, seniority is about more than years of experience. It’s about the complexity of problems you can solve, the level of ownership you can take and the quality of your technical judgement.
Why Travelstart?
You’ll be working in a technology environment that supports a large, established travel business with multiple products, customer segments, platforms and integrations.
That means real technical complexity, plenty of problems worth solving, and meaningful opportunities to improve systems, automate processes and influence how our technology evolves.
If you enjoy building practical solutions, taking ownership of what you put into production and working in an environment where technology is continuously evolving, we’d like to hear from you.

descriptions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend - Data Streaming
descriptions.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.
Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.
Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.
About The Role
As a Senior Software Engineer on Camunda's new Data Streaming team, you'll help build a foundational new piece of architecture that changes how customers and internal products access process data. Today, customers have no first-class way to stream their own process data out of Camunda, and Camunda's own analytics product is bottlenecked by querying the same storage the live engine depends on. You'll be part of a greenfield team rebuilding how process data is consumed and served at scale, built on top of a durable, continuously-written streaming layer that decouples data consumption from the live engine. You'll be part of a small team from day one, with real room to shape both the architecture and the team's scope as it matures.
At Camunda, we approach engineering in a holistic manner. As such, you will form strong partnerships with product management, the Data Layer and Distributed Systems teams, QA, and support, and work closely with your peers to not only deliver but directly influence how our data streaming architecture evolves to meet our customers' needs.
What You Will Do
Help rebuild how Camunda's analytics product consumes and serves process data at scale, moving it off the engine's critical path entirely.
Design and build the core streaming infrastructure that decouples process data access from the live execution engine, backed by durable, object storage.
Build customer-facing data streaming capabilities, including a supported way to integrate with systems like Kafka, so customers can reliably get their process data into their own tools.
Make foundational architecture decisions as part of a small, high-ownership team, including how the system guarantees consistency and durability across a distributed streaming pipeline.
Participate in L3 support and on-call rotations, partnering with Support and SRE to investigate data layer production issues, and feeding what you learn back into the product.
Must Haves
What You Will Bring to the Role:
7+ years of experience as a backend engineer, in Java, with a strong focus on distributed or data-intensive systems.
Hands-on experience building or operating an analytical serving layer over a table format such as Apache Iceberg or Delta Lake - including experience with an embedded/lightweight query engine (e.g. DuckDB, or similar), or a stateful stream-processing framework (e.g. Flink, Kafka Streams).
A track record of working with object storage systems (S3/GCS/Azure or similar) and building reliable, idempotent upload/commit protocols against them.
Solid grounding in the reasoning behind correctness and consistency in data-intensive systems (e.g. concurrent writes, atomicity, idempotency).
A demonstrated track record of driving a technical initiative through genuine ambiguity in a still-being-designed system, not just extending an established one.
Proven experience leading medium-to-large engineering initiatives (3+ months) end-to-end, from solution design, project planning, and coordinating across teams, right through to driving predictable delivery.
Strong communication and collaboration skills in a remote-first environment: you translate requirements into actionable technical work with Product, and give and receive clear, direct feedback in code review.
Nice To Haves
Experience with Kafka or a similar streaming/event-log system
Experience with embedded state stores (RocksDB or similar) for projection/checkpointing workloads.
Experience with stream processing frameworks (e.g. Apache Flink), particularly stateful processing with local state backends and checkpointing.
Familiarity with object-storage-native streaming architectures (e.g. systems like WarpStream) is a plus, even without direct hands-on experience.
This role is an existing vacancy
#C1

descriptions.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.
Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.
Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.
About The Role
As a Backend Senior Software Engineer on the Data Layer team, you'll help build and evolve the storage and query layer that keeps Camunda 8's process data fast, accurate, and available at scale. Spanning both relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, the data layer and its data pipelines power everything from process monitoring to the new agent-driven automation capabilities we're rolling out.
As part of the Data Layer team, you will work on both technically challenging and rewarding projects, such as reshaping how we store and retain process data, streaming data to external systems, and evolving our secondary storage systems to perform at ever greater scale.
At Camunda, we approach engineering in a holistic manner. As such, you will form strong partnerships with product management, design, QA, and support, and work with your peers to not only deliver but directly influence how our data layer evolves to meet our customers' needs.
Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale
What You Will Do
Design, build, and maintain backend services for the data layer that stores and serves Camunda 8's process data, spanning relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, with an eye toward correctness, performance, and scale.
Own the end-to-end delivery of engineering initiatives, working with Product Management and colleagues across the business to break down requirements into concrete solution designs, driving projects to timely and high-quality delivery.
Help evolve how we process, retain, and expose process data, so customers can work with their data the way they need to.
Invest in making our secondary storage systems more performant and scalable as usage grows, and build tooling that makes it easier to understand, troubleshoot, and safely operate the data layer in production.
Participate in L3 support and on-call rotations, partnering with Support and SRE to investigate data layer production issues, and feeding what you learn back into the product.
Must Haves
What You Will Bring to the Role:
At least 7 years of experience as a backend engineer, with a strong focus on backend systems and production data stores
Deep experience with both Relational Databases (ideally PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, or MSSQL), and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, with a practical understanding of query performance, indexing, and data modeling trade-offs
Proven experience leading medium-to-large engineering initiatives (3+ months) end-to-end — solution design, project planning, coordinating across teams, and driving predictable delivery.
Comfortable investigating slow queries, execution plans, and index usage to root-cause data-related production issues.
Strong communication and collaboration skills in a remote-first environment: you translate requirements into actionable technical work with Product, and give and receive clear, direct feedback in code review.
Nice To Haves
Experience building workflow automation or process orchestration software.
Experience building or maintaining CI pipelines.
Understanding of database migration tooling (e.g. Liquibase, Flyway) and schema evolution in a live system.

descriptions.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Asset Sales
descriptions.description:
Join our expanding engineering team!
We're hiring a permanent Senior Backend Engineer to join our Asset Sales group as we scale one of the most important parts of M-KOPA's FinTech platform. Build distributed, event-driven microservices and help shape what AI-native engineering looks like at M-KOPA.
The Impact 💚
Your code will directly power the systems that put smartphones and e-motorbikes into the hands of Every Day Earners across Africa. We've already helped over 10 million customers access more than $2 billion in credit. It's your chance to be part of something that's literally transforming lives across an entire continent 🌍
The Opportunity
🎯 Mission-driven engineering: Every service you build helps expand financial inclusion for under-banked populations
🏆 Global recognition: Join a company named by the Financial Times as one of Africa's fastest-growing companies for five consecutive years (2022–2026)
🚀 Scale challenges: Build backend systems serving millions across multiple African markets
🤖 AI-native from day one: We're actively embracing AI as part of the engineering craft, not bolting it on
🌍 Fully distributed: Work remotely with diverse teams across UK, Europe, and Africa
What You'll Do
At M-KOPA, you'll build and operate distributed C# and .NET microservices on Azure, working within an event-driven architecture at significant scale. This is an outcomes-driven role: we care far more about the value you create than where you sit or how many hours you're online. You'll own what you build end-to-end — from idea, through implementation and deployment, into production and iteration.
Technical Environment 💻
Modern C# stack: Distributed C# and .NET microservices
Cloud & orchestration: Hosted on Azure using Kubernetes
Architecture: Event-driven, supporting products used at significant scale
Observability: Grafana, Azure Application Insights, logs, traces, and metrics
AI tooling: Claude and other AI tools used throughout the engineering workflow — design exploration, code generation and review, test writing, incident investigation, and technical communication
Our Engineering Approach 🚀
AI-native engineering: We want engineers who tinker — experimenting with new tools, agents, and workflows, and sharing what works
Guardrails as we accelerate: Automated tests, SLOs, alerting, observability, and deployment safeguards around everything we ship
Own it beyond the pull request: Design for idempotency, retries, out-of-order events, and failure modes, and know how your services behave in production
The Campfire Rule: Leave the systems you touch a little better than you found them
On-call as feedback, not heroics: Engineers who build our systems also help operate them, using incidents to make the platform more resilient
What You Need
We're looking for a senior engineer who's curious, autonomous, and highly trusted. You're comfortable owning the entire software stack — including supporting infrastructure — throughout its lifecycle, and you see production data, not just deployment, as the real measure of "done."
Required Experience:
Strong grasp of C# and .NET development
Experience with event-driven systems - We use Azure Service Bus, but would love to hear from you if you have experience with similar messaging technology (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.)
Microservices architecture experience, ideally on Azure and Kubernetes
Experience using observability tooling (e.g. Grafana, Application Insights) to understand production behaviour
Comfort using AI tools as part of a daily engineering workflow (design, code review, testing, incident investigation)
DevOps culture mindset, including on-call/production ownership
Proven ability to collaborate effectively in distributed teams across time zones
Continuous learning mindset and openness to feedback
Location & Benefits
Fully remote role, collaborating during core GMT working hours
Work with diverse teams distributed across UK, Europe, and Africa
Personalised training budget to support your development
Home office setup budget
Professional development programs and coaching partnerships
Family-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements
Well-being support and career growth opportunities
Our Mission 🌍
We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer-centric financing model. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low-income communities.
Our Impact 💚
Our technology has created measurable change:
Connected 📱: 2.5 million first-time smartphone users connected
Prosperous 💰: 70% of customers use M-KOPA products for income generation, with 35,000 livelihoods created for agents
Green 🌱: 2.155 million tonnes of CO₂ avoided since 2010 through clean energy, refurbished devices, and e-mobility
Ready to build C#/.NET systems — with AI as part of your craft — that create real-world financial inclusion? Apply Now!
Why M-KOPA?
At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.
Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at m-kopa.com.
Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.
Important Notice
M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.
M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships.
M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.
Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.
If your application is successful M-KOPA undertakes pre-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.

descriptions.title: Junior Software Quality Analyst
descriptions.description:
Job Description
Defect Management
Regression Testing and Maintenance
Development and Execution of Test Cases
Software Quality Assurance
Responsibilities
Job responsibilities:
Analysis and Design: You will examine documentation like business requirements and specifications. This review helps you derive appropriate test estimates and formulate a strategic test approach, ensuring thorough test coverage.
Implementation: You are responsible for developing manual functional test cases that adhere to internal standards and best practices. The development and execution of these tests should be meticulously managed within our test management tool to ensure both organization and efficiency.
Execution: You will execute tests using the relevant tools, ensuring that each test is conducted methodically and accurately.
Defect Management: A key aspect of your role involves formally logging any defects found during testing. You will follow up on the progress of these defects and retest them once they are addressed.
Retesting and Regression Testing: You are tasked with conducting both retesting and regression testing to ensure that software changes have not adversely affected existing functionality. This includes maintenance of the regression test pack.
Reporting: You are responsible for creating test progress and test completion reports leveraging automated reporting capabilities as far as possible.
Documentation and knowledge sharing: You will create documentation to facilitate knowledge sharing within the team.
Living The Spirit
The ideal candidate for this role exhibits a dynamic and positive attitude, coupled with a solution-focused mindset to tackle challenges. Key attributes include:
Collaborative Teamwork: Engages actively in team efforts to achieve collective objectives, fostering a cooperative work environment.
Adaptability and Openness to Change: Demonstrates flexibility and a willingness to adapt to evolving circumstances and environments.
Eagerness for New Challenges: Shows enthusiasm for taking on new tasks and learning new skills, contributing to personal and professional growth.
Promotion of Continuous Improvement: Encourages a culture of ongoing development and learning within the team by sharing insights and knowledge.

descriptions.title: Software Quality Assurance Analyst
descriptions.description:
The Software Quality Assurance Analyst is Pedros’ internal software-quality specialist, responsible for establishing and executing structured, independent quality assurance and testing practices across the Group’s technology and digital transformation projects. The role ensures that software applications, integrations, workflows, reports and digital solutions meet approved business requirements, operate reliably across interconnected systems and are sufficiently stable for implementation.
Reporting to the Group Project Manager, the role works closely with project managers, business analysts, developers, vendors and business stakeholders to identify quality risks, develop test strategies, execute testing, manage defects and support User Acceptance Testing. It supports web and mobile applications, internally developed systems, vendor solutions, Microsoft Power Platform applications, POS integrations, transactional platforms, reporting solutions and operational systems across Pedros and its associated brands.
The role establishes consistent QA standards, templates, quality gates and reporting, giving project teams and decision-makers clear visibility of test coverage, open defects, quality risks and release readiness before systems are implemented.
Responsibilities
Test Execution, Integration & Transactional Testing
Execute manual functional, system, integration, end-to-end, regression, smoke, sanity, usability and compatibility testing across relevant browsers, devices, operating systems and user roles
Test integrations between internal systems, vendor platforms, APIs, POS systems, payment services, databases, Microsoft 365 services and reporting platforms
Validate successful and unsuccessful transaction paths (error handling, retries, timeouts, cancellations, duplicates), data synchronisation and reconciliation outputs, with particular focus on financial, voucher, payment and loyalty flows.
Record test results with supporting evidence and perform exploratory testing to identify issues not covered by predefined test cases.
Quality Assurance Strategy, Planning & Standards
Develop and maintain test strategies, test plans and schedules, defining scope, test types, environments, dependencies, risks and entry and exit criteria for each testing cycle
Apply risk-based testing principles to prioritise high-impact business processes, financial transactions, security controls, integrations and customer-facing functionality
Estimate testing effort and provide realistic input into project plans, sprint plans and release schedules.
Requirements Review & Test Design
Review requirements, user stories, process maps, business rules and acceptance criteria to confirm they are clear, complete, consistent and testable
Identify gaps, ambiguities, edge cases, control weaknesses and quality risks before development is completed, working with the Business Analyst and Project Manager to resolve them
Design and maintain test scenarios, test cases, scripts, checklists and test-data requirements covering positive, negative, boundary, exception and end-to-end scenarios.
Link test cases to the relevant requirements, user stories or acceptance criteria to maintain traceability.
Defect Management
Log defects with clear reproduction steps, expected and actual results, evidence, environment details and business impact
Classify defects according to agreed severity and priority definitions
Facilitate defect-triage sessions with developers, business analysts, project managers, vendors and business representatives.
Track defects through investigation, resolution, retesting and closure, identifying whether defects originate within an application or at an integration boundary.
UAT Support & Release Readiness
Work with the Business Analyst, Project Manager and business stakeholders to prepare the UAT approach and business-focused UAT scenarios
Confirm UAT environment, user access and test data readiness, and brief business testers on the UAT process and defect-logging requirements
Support users during execution and help distinguish defects from requirement changes, training needs, configuration issues or enhancement requests.
Track UAT progress, defects, decisions and sign-offs, and provide evidence-based release-readiness recommendations, ensuring outstanding defects and accepted risks are communicated before business approval.
Regression Testing
Develop and maintain regression packs for business-critical applications and recurring release cycles
Identify existing functionality that may be affected by new development, configuration changes or defect corrections
Execute regression testing before significant releases and after material changes, and track regression coverage and gaps across releases.
Recommend suitable candidates for test automation based on frequency, stability, risk and repeatability.
Qualifications
Requirements :
Diploma or degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering or a related discipline
ISTQB Foundation certification.
Experience
5–10 years’ experience in software quality assurance, software testing, test analysis or a comparable role
Preparing test strategies, test plans, test cases, test scripts and regression packs
Testing web applications, mobile applications, enterprise systems or transactional platforms
Performing functional, system, integration, end-to-end and regression testing
Managing defects through the complete defect lifecycle
Working directly with developers, business analysts, project managers, business users and external vendors in Agile, Waterfall or hybrid environments
Producing clear testing reports and presenting quality risks to stakeholders.
Advantageous
Experience within QSR, retail, hospitality, franchising or multi-site operations
Testing POS, voucher, loyalty, payment, ordering or other high-volume transactional systems
Testing APIs and integrated systems
Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power Automate, SharePoint and Dataverse

Employ logs and records so that actions and events can be proven to have taken place and cannot be disputed/ repudiated later Ensure wherever possible actions can be traced uniquely to the entity which performed it.
Ensure wherever possible the identify of an entity can be proved to be the correct one.
Implementation - Ensure the Solution is Maintainable.
Ensure the solution and its relevant code base supports ease of modification for future maintainers.
Ensure the use of appropriate standards and methods.
Ensure where possible (without affecting performance/security) the solution caters for maintenance by support teams rather than developers.
Ensure modularity where the solution consists of discrete components so that a change in one component has minimal impact on other components.
Ensure relevant documentation is provided to support teams to reduce development support burden.
Apply a strategy of reusability so an asset can be used in more than one solution or in building other assets.
Where possible provide a mechanism for the solution to analyse its own faults and provide reports prior to a critical failure.
Develop the solution in a manner which supports modification for future developers thereby reducing the numbers of defects or negatively affecting system quality.
Testing, verification and deploying
Ensure the solution is test friendly by creating effective mechanisms for test data, automated testing hooks and simulations.
Ensure the solution is delivered completely and with the additional assets which are required to make installation/deployment as seamless and easy as possible.
Ensure the adaptable solution delivered is appropriate for different or evolving hardware, software or other operational usage environments.
Respond to Outages & Failures
Provide proactive support to Peers, Testing, Dev Support and Operational teams so number of escalations to the development team is reduced, thereby maximising development time.
Provide support to the Dev Support when required during operational events and create or assist with the creation of SOP’s.
Be available to handle emergency outages and failures for your or your teams’ solutions.
Perform trouble shooting and effectively resolve issues to increase solution stability and reduce intervention required over time.
Recommend and execute approved improvements to development methods and solutions.
Provide quick resolutions to app/system issues, driving stability, efficiency and effectiveness.
Maintain solutions which have completed development and are in the operations phase.
Develop technical support documentation and where possible/necessary, maintain the documentation.
Assess risk and impact of production issues/changes and take appropriate steps to mitigate risk.
Coaching/Mentoring

Mentors and contributes to the growth of junior and intermediate Team Members.
Designs and delivers end-user training and training materials.
Living The Spirit

Actively promotes authenticity and drives the spirit of diversity, inclusion, equity and belonging within the team.
Actively drives a culture of versatility and adaptability by modelling and encouraging Team Members to support each other not only within the department, but within the business as a whole.
Actively become a change agent and drive continuous learning within the team thus ensuring that the team approaches all tasks or challenges with enthusiasm and proactivity.

descriptions.title: Senior Software Engineer - GoLang (FinCore)
descriptions.description:
WE ARE BASH
Bash is South Africa's largest omnichannel shopping platform. We connect over 500 brands across the physical and digital world, for millions of South Africans, every day. We're building something with real scale and real consequence.
We're founder led, a team of true owners and humble learners. We work hard, hold a high bar, and show up for each other. The problems aren't easy and the pace is real but when you break through, the impact is felt across the business and by the customers who rely on us.
If that sounds like the kind of place where you'd do the best work of your career, we'd like to meet you.
Help build the financial backbone behind one of South Africa's largest omnichannel transformations.
The FinCore division owns the financial infrastructure and customer experiences behind payments, refunds, credit usage, tokenisation, stored value, reconciliation, and fraud. We're not a fintech incubator dabbling in ideas, and we're not a platform team quietly keeping the lights on. We own these capabilities end to end and are accountable for the systems that reliably scale across every Bash channel.
We're hiring Go Engineers
FinCore has two teams. Both own customer-facing and backend services, but they solve different problems and suit different engineers.
Payments: We own the systems that take money, reverse it, and prove afterwards that both happened correctly, across every Bash channel and every payment provider.
Wallet: We own the systems that provide customers with stored value. A balance customers can hold and spend, with or without credit.
What you'd actually work on
Real-time, distributed systems where being correct and being fast are both non-negotiable, regardless of the system load.
Instrumentation good enough to answer "what actually happened here, for this customer" without guessing. Every meaningful state change is its own event with its own timestamp, because the next decision reads through it.
Payment flows where correctness is not negotiable. Authorisation, capture, refund and settlement across multiple providers, each with its own idea of what a timeout means. Retries, idempotency and partial failure are routine here, not edge cases.
Reconciliation. Matching what we think happened against what the provider, the bank and the ledger think happened.
Credit origination against external systems where a single call can take tens of seconds, a customer is waiting on the other end, and duplicate submissions carry regulatory consequences.
The road to a spendable balance. Funding a balance, holding it, controlling where it can be spent, and the refund paths that have to exist alongside it. Some of this is unbuilt and some of the design questions are still open, you'll help form this.
The Stack
Go for backend services.
Around it: AWS, CloudFlare, Kubernetes, Temporal, Redis, RDS, Prometheus, Sentry.
Internal tools and admin surfaces are built in Retool, and we plan and track work in Linear.
You'll fit well if you have
4+ years building production backend systems, ideally in Go - or you're strong in another language (Java, C#, Python, Node, Rust, whatever) and keen to go deep on Go.
A real curiosity about distributed systems - consistency, failure modes, and what happens at 2am when one node disagrees with the rest. You don't need to have all the answers here yet. You do need to find the questions interesting.
The ability to take a feature and drive it to completion. You can break it down, spot the ambiguity, ask the right person the right question, and ship.
A habit of writing code others can live with. Well-tested, readable, debuggable. You give useful code review feedback, not just an approve button.
A bias toward observability and monitoring - you'd rather know than guess. You care whether the thing you shipped actually worked, and you know how to check.
Clear communication. You can explain a technical trade-off, flag a delay before it becomes a surprise, and write a runbook that saves the next person a day.
An instinct to understand why before building the how - you'd rather help steer a solution than wait for one to arrive.
Comfort with agentic coding tools, but you still read and validate everything "you" commit.
A BSc in Computer Science (or equivalent) is a nice-to-have, not a gate. Strong, demonstrable experience speaks louder.
How we work
We're a cross-functional, agile team, but we care less about ceremony and more about how engineers actually operate day to day:
You run your own day. You manage your own work, unblock yourself where you can, and shout early and clearly when you can't.
You build to last. Resilient, maintainable, observable. You hold a high bar on testing and code review - and you'll be surrounded by people who hold it too, which is the fastest way to raise your own.
You share the load. That includes pitching in on operational work and an on-call rotation for critical alerts - because the people who built the systems are the people best placed to keep them healthy. We take on-call seriously and it’s our job to not make it miserable.
You get better, and you help others get better. We rotate on solution ownership, we collaborate within and across teams, we take part in engineering Guild sessions, we write RFCs, we mentor where it’s welcomed.
You'll know what "next" looks like. We have a progression framework and growth is a conversation, not a guessing game.
We ask a few optional demographic questions to monitor fairness in hiring and comply with South Africa’s Employment Equity requirements. Your responses are confidential - stored separately from your application and never shown to hiring panels. We review the data only in aggregate to strengthen our sourcing so pipelines are diverse and all candidates receive equitable support. You can skip any question.
JOINING THE BASH TEAM
We believe in autonomy and self-driven individuals who thrive within some uncertainty so that they can fill those gaps with their uniqueness. The qualities that allow you to thrive are curiosity, proactivity and a bias to action. If you are these things, joining the Bash team will catapult your career and ensure you do the best work, pushing past your preconceived boundaries.
We don't believe in padding this section with things that sound good on paper. Here's what working at Bash actually looks like:
BASH PERKS
The people around you. We hire to a high standard, and you'll feel it. The talent at Bash will push your thinking, raise your game, and genuinely surprise you.
Real growth. A place that expands what you're capable of. You'll own more, stretch further, and build in ways a traditional corporate can't offer.
Top-of-market pay. The best people, in the right roles, earning at the top tier.
Time that's yours. We are flexible and don't measure time. We look at output.
Shopping perks. An exclusive discount across 500+ brands in-store and on bash.com.
